verses.text: Yahdah kumpite ahi Uzziyah (Azaryah), Yahtham, Ahaz, leh Hezekyah hun lai-in Yahdah leh Yerusalem tawh kisai-in Amoz’ tapa Isayah’ mangmuhna ahi hi.
Vantungte aw za un, leitung aw, na bil ngat in; bang hang hiam cihleh hih in Yahweh gen ahi hi: Tate ka khoi a, ka pantah khin hi; ahih hangin amaute in kei hong lehdo uh hi.
Bawngtal in a neipa thei a, laa in a neipa’ an piakna mun thei hi; ahih hangin Israyl in thei lo hi; Ka mite in a theitel kei uh hi.
Ah! A mawh minam, khialhna netcip minam, siatna gamtate’ suan, a gamtatsia tate ahi uh hi! Amaute in Yahweh nusia khin uh a, Israyl’ Siangtho Pa hehsak khin uh hi; amaute in lam khial khin uh hi.
Bang hangin note sat thuak behbeh lai ding na hi uh hiam? Bang hangin lehdo behbeh lai ding na hi uh hiam? Na lutang buppi na a, na lungtang buppi a zawm hi.
Na khe nuai panin na lu zang dong a hoihna om lo hi; liamnate, sanim gawpnate leh meima muatte bek a om hi. Tuate pen a nai kisaal lo, kitun lo, sathau tawh kinomsak lo hi.
Na gam uh khing a, na khuapite uh mei tawh kihal hi. Na muh tangpi mahun gamdang mite in na gam uh netum uh a, gamdang mite lotthalsa-in a kisia hi.
Zion’ tanu pen leenggui lo-a succah; buk, khat bang, tangmai huan sunga hampeng bang, a ki-umcih khuapi khat bangin kinusia hi.
Vanglianpen Yahweh in eite a omlai sun tawmno khat hong sit lo hileh, Sodom i bang khin ding a, Gomorrah i bang khin ding hi.
No Sodom ukpite aw, Yahweh’ kammal za un! No Gomorrah mite aw, i Pa’ Thukham ngai un!

Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Kei tungah na biakpiakna honpite a deihna bang hiam? Tuutal leh a kivak ganhing’ sa a thau-in meihal biaknate tawh ka kidim hi; Bawngtalte, tuunote leh keeltalte’ sisan ah ka lung a kim kei hi.
Keima mai-ah kilaak dingin nong pai uh ciangin Ka huang sung teng na tuatcil gawp nadingun kua in na khut panun hihte hong ngen ahi hiam?

Bangmah-a kimang lo biaknate hong paipih nawn kei un! Na paknamtui uh Kei aa dingin kihhuai hi! Kikhop ni-in na neih uh ahi kha thak nite leh shabbat nite ka thuakzo nawn kei hi! A thupi kimuhna nangawn mawhna hi!
Na khadet nite leh a kisehsa na pawite uh Ka mudah hi! Tuate in Kei aa dingin vangikpi khat ahi hi! Tuate ka puakna-in ka gim hi!
Tua ahih ciangin na khut na zakkhiat ciangun note kong kimuhmawh bawl ding hi. Hi hi, sisan tawh na khut kidim ahih manin thu tampi nong nget hangun ka ngai kei ding hi.
Kisil unla, kisiangsak un; Ka muhna panin na gamtat siatna paaikhia inla, gamtat siatna khawl un.
Thumaan-a gamtat ding kisin unla, thutang zong un; a kisimmawhte hanthawn-in, pa nei lote hu unla, meigongte aa dingin thuumsak un.
Tu-in hong pai un, thu kikum khawm ni, Yahweh in ci hi; na mawhnate uh a san ziazua zongin vuk bangin ngo ding hi; na mawhnate uh sisan bangin a san hangin pat hong bang ding hi.
Note ut-in na thuman’ uh leh, note in na gam sunga singgahte na ne ding uh hi;
Ahih hangin note in nial-in na lehdo uh leh, Yahweh’ kam in hong gen khin ahih manin namsau in note hong netum ding hi.
Bang ci bangin a muanhuai khuapi a paktat khat suakkhin ahi hiam? Thutanna tawh kidim a, thumaanna a teng hi; ahih hangin tu-in mi thatte bek a om hi.
Na ngunte ngun-ek suakkhin a, na leenggahzute tui tawh kihelkhin hi.
Na uliante in mi lehdo hi a, gutate’ pawl ahi uh hi. A kuamah peuh in letsong deih a, a mawk piakte nungzuih uh hi; amaute in pa nei lote hu loin, amau kiang a zuan meigongte’ thu zong panpih lo hi.
Hih thu hangin eite’ Pa, tungnungpen Yahweh, Israyl’ Vanglian Pa in hih bangin ci hi: Ka langte kiang panin Keimahmah ka kilungnuamsak tawm ding a, Ka galte tungah phu ka la ding hi.
Tua ciangin note langah Ka khut ka vik ding a, na kekseu-na teng uh ka silsiang ding a, na nitna khempeuh uh ka hemkhia ding hi.

Tua ciangin a masa lai-a mah bangin na thukhente a ngei ka bangsak ding a, a kipat cil-a mah bangin na thudotte ka hisakkik ding hi. Tua khit ciangin nang pen Thumaanna Khuapi, a thutak khuapi hong kici ding hi.
Thutang tawh Zion kitankhia ding a, a sunga a kikhelte zong thumaanna tawh kitankhia ding hi.
Tua ciangin thupalsatte leh mi mawhte kisusia khawm ding a, Yahweh a nusia mite kibeimangsak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh na lunggulh uh tawsaw kungte; thahatna, hangin na maizum ding uh a, na teelsa uh huante; kidalna, hangin na amkham ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh a teh a vul tawsaw kung leh tui a ngah lo huan tawh na kibang ding uh hi.
A thakhauhte in patlom tawh kibang ding a, ama nasepna in mei-ek a bang ding hi; amaute a nih tuakin kangtum khawm ding a, kuamah in phelh lo ding hi.
Yahdah leh Yerusalem tawh kisai-in Amoz’ tapa Isayah muh kammal ahi hi.
Ni tawp nite ah hong piang ding inah: Yahweh’ Inn mual, mual liannte lakah a sangpen-in kikipsak ding a, mual neute tungah kitawisang ding hi; tua ciangin tua lai-ah minam khempeuh pai ding uh hi.

Mi tampite pai-in, “Hong pai un, Yahweh’ mual, Yaaqob’ Pa Inn ah paito ni, Amah in a lampite hong hilh ding a, eite in Ama zawi i tawn ding hi,” a ci ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Zion panin Thukham kizelkhia a, Yerusalem panin Yahweh’ kammal hong paikhia ding hi.

Amah in minamte lakah thu khen ding a, mi tampi a tai ding hi; amaute in a namsaute uh lokaihna tu-in seek ding uh a, a teipite uh phiaukawi-in a seek ding uh hi; minam khat in minam khat langpanin namsau lik nawn lo ding a, galsim dingin zong a kisin nawn kei ding uh hi.
Yaaqob innkuante aw, hong pai unla, Yahweh’ khuavak sungah kalsuan un.

Nangmah in Yaaqob’ innkuan, na mite na nusia khin hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute, nisuahna lama-te’ ngeinate kidim uh a, Philistine mite bangin aisante ahi uh hi; amaute in khual mite’ tate tawh nuamsa uh hi.
A lampi uh ngun leh kham lomtang tawh zong kidim a, amau vanmanphate in mong nei lo hi. Amau gam sakol tawh kidim a, a sakolleengte uh zong bei hun om lo hi.
A lampi uh pasian (elohim) lomtang tawh zong kidim a, amaute in amau khut mah tawh a sep, a khume-kawkte tawh a bawl teng mah bia uh hi;
Khiatna nei lopi-in tuate mai-ah mihing kun a, mi liante zong hih pasiante kiangah kiniamkhiat tawm uh hi. Hih thu hangin amaute maisak kei in.
Yahweh a lipkhaphuai-na leh a thupi a minthanna hangin suangpi sungah lut unla, leivui sungah kibu un.
Mihing kiliatsakna pen kiniam koih ding a, mihing’ kiphatsakna pen kiniamkhiat ding hi; tua ni ciangin Yahweh bek kiliansak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh a tungnungpen Yahweh’ ni pen a kiphasakte leh a kiliansak mi khempeuh tungah tung ding a, a kiliansak khempeuh kiniamkhoih ding hi—
Sangin a kilamsang Lebanon-a tamtak kungte khempeuh tung leh Bashan-a tawsaw kungte khempeuh tung,
a sang mual lian khempeuh tung leh a kilamsang mual neute khempeuh tung,
tausang khempeuh tung leh kulh muanhuai khempeuh tung,
Tarshish tembawte khempeuh tung leh tembaw hoih khempeuh tungah Yahweh’ ni tung ding hi.
Mihing’ kiliatsakna kiniam koih ding a, mihingte’ kiphatsakna a kiniamsak ding hi. Tua ni ciangin Yahweh bek kiliansak ding hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh Amah in pasiante (elohim) phiatsiang kiuhkeuh ding hi.
Lipkhaphuai takin leitung liingsak dingin a thawh ciangin, Yahweh’ lipkhaphuai-na leh a thupi ama minthanna hangin amaute, suanghawm sungah lutin, leitung-a kuahawm teng ah lut ding uh hi.
Tua ni ciangin mihing in ama biak ding mahin a bawl a ngun pasiante, a kham pasiante uh buite leh bakte tungah paaikhia mang ding uh a,

Lipkhaphuai takin leitung liingsak dingin a thawh ciangin Yahweh’ lipkhaphuai-na leh a thupi ama minthanna hangin suanghawmpi sung leh suang sangpi sung tengah a a taimang theih nadingun tuate a paaikhia ding uh hi.
Tua bang mite kiang panin nangmah kikhenkhia tawm in; amah pen banga simtak ahi hiam?
Bang hang hiam cihleh en un, eite Pa, tungnungpen Yahweh in Yerusalem leh Yahdah panin huhna leh huhna puakna, an nek ding leh tuidawn ding a sik khempeuh,
mi thahatpa leh galhangpa, thukhenpa leh kangsangpa, a mi ciimpa leh tangmi; upapa,
sawmnga uk galkap bupa leh mi zalianpa, thulamlakpa leh khutsiampa leh thugensiam dangnalpa lakhia mang ding hi.
Amaute’ ulian dingin naupangte ka pia ding a, naungekte in amaute uk ding hi.
Mite khat le khat kinengniam ding uh a, mi khatin khat langpanin a vengpa in a vengpa langpan ding hi. Uhamte tungah nuapangte kiphasak ding a, mi zahtakhuaite tungah mi nautangte kiphasak ding hi.
Tua hi a, mi khat in a pa’ inn ah a sanggampa manin, “Nangmah in puansilh na nei hi; kote ukpa hong hi in; hih a siatna teng nangma lamlahna nuai-ah om tahen,” a ci hi.

Tua ni ciangin amah in a khutte lam-in kiciam ding a, “Hih natnate aa dingin damsak theihna ka nei kei hi. Ka inn sungah an ahi a, puansilh ahi zongin a om kei hi. Mite’ ukpa hong hisak kei in,” a ci ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yerusalem kisia a, Yahdah a puk hi; ahang in Yahweh’ mit vanglian a sukha dingin amau leiite leh amau gamtatna in Yahweh langpan hi.
A maipuakzia un amaute langah teci pang a, amaute in a Sodom mawhnate uh tangko-in a im kei uh hi! Amaute dahhuai hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amau le amau siatna a kipia uh hi.
Thumaan mite in amau gamtatna gah ne ding uh ahih manin amaute kiangah, “Amau tungah thu hoih ding hi,” ci in.
Migilote dahhuai hi! Amau tungah khut-in a sepna thaman kipia ding ahih manin amau tungah thu sia tung ding hi.
Ka mite ahih leh, amau a nengniamte naupangte hi a, numeite in amaute uk hi. Kala, ka mite! No hong makiahte in note lam hong pialsak a, na lampi zuih uh a susia hi!
Yahweh in thu a panpih dingin dingto a, mite thu a khen dingin a kithawi hi.
Yahweh in a mipi upate leh amau uliante tawh thu khen ta ding hi; “Note in leenggui lo na netum khin uh a, mizawngte’ van kisutte, note inn sungah a om hi.
Ka mite na sukcip gawpna uh leh mi zawngte’ maitang gawina uh, bang na cih nopna uh ahi hiam?” tungnungpen Yahweh in ci hi.
Yahweh in ci lai hi: Zion’ tanute kiphasakin ngawng doksa-in lam pai a, kiphatsakna tawh a mit uh hei pampamin, hi tuihtuihsa-in pai uh a, a khe uh tawh gingsak sualsuak ahih ciangin,
Yahweh in Zion’ tanute’ lutang meimasak ding a, Yahweh in a zum huaina teng uh a pholak ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin Yahweh in amau hoihna teng lakkhiatsak ding hi: a khebuh hoihte, a samtuamte leh khade lim ngawng-awhte,
a khi-te, taute leh mai-khuhnate,
lu zepnate, khe buhte, kawngtente, paknamtui thawlte leh bilbahte,
khutbuhte leh nakbahte,
pawi puantualte leh puanza neu, puanpite lehkhutkhai ipte,
limlangte, saihadial puan hoihte, dialkhipte leh kikhuhna puante lakhia mang ding hi.

Hi bangin hong piang ding hi: a gim namtui tangin uihna om ding a, kawngten tangin khauhualpi, limtaka kizem sam tangin lu kolh, puan hoih tangin puan hampi, mel hoihna tangin maizumna hun hong tung ding hi.
Na mite namsau-in si ding uh a, na mi thahatte gal sungah puk ding hi.
A kulh kongpite thuumin tau ding a, a hawm guakin tuanu leilak ah a tu ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin numei sagih in pasal khat lenin, “Pawite ka bawl ding uh a, ka puan siangthote uh kong sik ding uh hi; pasal neih loin maizumna lakkhiat nadingin nangma zi cih min hong puasak in.
Tua ni ciangin Yahweh’ hiang mel hoih-in minthang ding a, leitung gah in Israyl ah a suakta mite aa dingin thupi-in hoih mahmah ding hi.
Zion ah a kinusiate leh Yerusalem ah a teng lai—Yerusalem-a a nungtate lakah a kiciamte peuhmah—a siangtho a kicih ding hun hong tung ding hi.
Yahweh in Zion’ tanute’ nitna a sawp siang khit ciangin thukhenna kha leh a kuanglai kha tawh Yerusalem laizang panin sisan a siangsak ding hi.

Yahweh in Zion Mual tung a kitenna mun khempeuh tung, Amah in a kaihkhop mite tungah sunin meii leh meikhu, zanin meikuang tang piangsak ding a, amau minthanna khempeuh tungah dalna a piangsak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Zion Mual tung tua lai-ah tua ni-in a satna pan niliim ding, huihpi leh guahpi panin buk nading leh belh mun dingin biakbuk hi ding hi.
Ama leenggui lo tawh kisai-in ka Itpa’ la khat, ka It-mahmahpa tungah ka sa ding hi. Ka It-mahmahpa in lei hoih mahmahna mual tung khat ah leenggui lo khat a nei hi.

Amah in lei to-in suangte paikhia a, leenggui hoihpente a suan hi. Amah in a laizangah tausang khat lam a, a sungah leenggah sukna khuk khat zong a bawl hi. Amah in leenggah hoih hong gah dingin lamen a, ahih hangin gam leenggah hong gah mawk hi.
Tu-in Yerusalem-a tengte leh Yahdah mite aw, Kei leh Ka leenggui lo kikal ah thu khen dih un.
Ka leenggui lo sungah ka hih loh, bang kihih lai ding ahi hiam? Tua hi a, Keimah in leenggah hoih a gah dingin ka lamet kawmkalin bang hangin gam leenggah gah ahi hiam?
Tu-in Ka leenggui lo ah ka sep ding thu note kong gen ding hi: A kinektum theih nadingin a dai ka phel ding a, a kituatcil gawp nadingin a kiimkot-a kulh teng ka susia ding hi.
Lotul ka suaksak ding a, kipuah loin kikho lo ding hi. Tua lai-ah lingkungte leh thangling kungte po ding a, a tungah guah a zuk loh nadingin zong meiite thu ka pia ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh tungnungpen Yahweh’ leenggui lo in Israyl innkuan hi a, Yahdah mite pen nuamsakna tawh a suan kungte ahi hi. Amah in thutanna lamen a, ahih hangin simmawhna om hi; thumaanna lam en a, ahih hangin kahna om hi.
Mi dangte aa dingin mun om loh zah dongin inn khat leh inn khat zomin lo khat leh lo khat a zom, leitang laizangah no guak a teng mite aa dingin dahhuai hi.
Ka bil mahmah ah tungnungpen Yahweh in hong gen inah: A man thu in, inn tampite kisia a, a lianpite leh a hoihte nangawn ah kuamah teng lo ding hi.
Hi hi, ni khat-in bawngtal kapsawm in a sep zawhna cia leenggui lo ah leenggah-zu bath khat piang ding a, khaici omer khat ah ephah khat piang ding hi.
Zu phual a delh dingin thobaih-in, leenggahzu in amaute a satsak pialpual matengin nitak dong a tut kho mite tungah gimna tung hen!
Harp leh lyre, khuangta leh tamngai leh leenggahzu-te a pawite sungah om a, ahih hangin amaute in Yahweh’ nasepna phawkkha loin, a khut tawh a bawlte zong ngaihsun kei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Ka mite in thutheihna a neih loh manin sal suak uh hi! A mi thupite uh gilkialin sidek ding a, mihonte dangtakin keucip ding uh hi.
Hih thu hangin Sheol; hankhuk, kizaisak a, tehzawh loh-in a kam ka hi; amau minthanna, a mihonte, thupi muh theihte, leh nuam a sa mi, tua sungah kumsuk ding uh hi.
Mi niamte zong kiniam koih-in, miliante zong kiniamkhiat ding a, a kiphasak mitte zong kiniamkhiat ding hi.
Ahih hangin tungnungpen Yahweh pen thukhenna ah kitawisang ding a, a Siangtho eite Pa, thumaanna ah a siangtho a hi ding hi.
Tua ciangin tuunote in amau tatna ngeina mun bangin lopa ne ding uh a, a thaute tatna mun siate ah khualte in a ne ding uh hi.

“I muh theih nadingin Amah manlangsakin, Ama nasepna kinawhsak ni; Israyl-te’ Siangtho Pa’ deihna i theih theih nadingin naisakin, tungsak ni!” a ci, leeng khauhualpi bangin mawhna khauhual tawh khialhna a kai mite in gim thuak hen!
A phate sia ci-in, a siate pha ci a, khuavak dingin khuamial koih-in, khuamial dingin khuavak koih a, a khum dingin, a kha koih a, a kha dingin a khum a koih mite in gim thuak hen!
Amau mah pil a kisa, amau muhna ah ciim a kisate in gimna thuak hen!
-23 Leenggahzu hai na mite, zu khuah hel siam pen, sumgolh hangin mi mawhte a khahkhia, thumaan mite a dikna a khem na uliante un gimna thuak hen!

Tua ahih ciangin mei in buhkung a kat tum bang, meikuang in lopa a kattum bangin amau zung pen a muat bang ding a, a pakpalhte pen leivui bangin lengmang ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in tungnungpen Yahweh’ Thukham paaikhia uh a, Israyl’ Siangtho Pa’ kammal a simmawh uh hi.

Hih thu hangin, Yahweh’ hehna a mite tungah kitawhkuang a, amaute’ langpanin a khut zankhia-in, amaute a vat hi; mualte liing a, amau luanghawmte pen kongzing laka nin tawh kibang hi. Tua ni napi-in hihte khempeuh hangin, Ama hehna veng lo a, a khut kizan lai hi.
Amah in gamlapi-a om minamte theihsakna lim khat lak a, leimong panin hong paina dingin a sam hi. En un, amaute manlang takin hong pai ding uh hi!
Amaute lakah kuamah zawm loin kuamah muktu lo ding hi. Kuamah lusu loin ihmu lo ding hi. A kawnga a kawnggak uh kol loin, a khedap khau uh zong kitat lo ding hi.
Amau’ thaltangte hiam a, a thal khempeuh uh keksa ahi hi; amau sakol’ khecinte pen meisung tawh kibang ding a, amau leengpeite pen pingpei tawh kibang hi.

Amau kikona in humpinelkai hawk tawh kibang ding a, humpinelkai khanglai bangin amaute a hawk ding uh hi. Hi hi, amaute humhamin a sa nek ding uh man ding uh a, amaute in puakhia mang-in kuamah in amaute honkhia lo ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin tuipi gin-ngaih bangin amaute in Israyl-te ngik gawp ding uh hi. Mi khatpeuh in tua gam a et leh, amah in khuamialna leh lungzinna bek mu ding a, meiite in khuavak mialsak hi.
Kumpi Uzziyah (Azaryah) a sih kumin, a sangna, a kitawisangna, kumpi-tokhom tungah Yahweh a tu ka mu a, Ama puantualpi kizal in biakinn sung teng dim hi.
Ama tungah seraphim; seraph-te, ding a, tuate khat ciat in kha guk nei-in, a kha nih tawh a mai khuh-in, a kha nih tawh a khe khuh-in, a kha nih tawh leeng uh hi.
Amaute khat le khat kisamin, “A honpite’ Yahweh in Siangtho, siangtho, siangtho hi! Leitung buppi ah Ama minthanna dim hi!” ci-in a awng uh hi.
A kikona aw hangin kongkhak khuampite kiling a, Yahweh’ Inn in meikhu tawh kidim hi.

Tua ciangin keimah in, “Gim ngahpa hi tangh ei! A kisia ka hi ta hi; bang hang hiam cihleh keimah in muk sianglo pa ka hi a, muk siang lo mite lakah ka teng a, ka mit-in Kumpipa, tungnungpen Yahweh ka mukhin hi!” ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin ka kiangah seraphim khat hong lengin, biaknatau panin taiteh tawh a lak mei-am lai khat a khut sungah tawi-in,
ka kam ah hong koih a, “En in, hih in na mukte bi khin a, na khialhna teng lakhia hi; na mawhna teng sawp siang hi,” hong ci hi.
Keimah in Yahweh’ awging zong ka za a, “Kua sawl ding a, eite tangin kua va pai ding hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin keimah in, “Keimah hiah om ing! Kei hong sawl in,” ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin Amah in, “Pai inla, hih mite tungah hi bangin gen in: Note in na zaza ding uh a, ahih hangin na tel kei ding uh hi. Na mumu ding uh a, ahih hangin na theician kei ding uh hi.

Hih mite’ lungsim khuahsakin, a bilte uh ngongsak inla, a mitte uh sisak in; tua bang hi keileh amaute in a mit uh tawh mu-in, a bil uh tawh za-in, a lungsim uh tawh tel kha ding uh a, amaute kikhelin, a kidamsak kha ding hi,” hong ci hi.

Tua ciangin keimah in, “Yahweh aw, bang tanvei sawt ding ahi hiam?” ci-in ka dong hi. Tua ciangin Amah in, “Khuapite kisia-in kuamah teng nawn loin, innte ah mi om loin, gam sung teng gamkhing a suakin,
Yahweh in a gamlapi ah mite hawlkhia-in, tua gam kinusiatna lianpi a om dong hi ding hi.

Tua gam sungah mi sawm ah khat a om lai zongin a kisusia kik lai ding hi. Tua hi napi-in nahli kung ahih keileh tawsaw kung a kiphuk khit ciangin a bulsumte a cian lai niloh mah bangin tua bulsum mah bangin a siangtho khaici cianlai veve ding hi,” ci-in hong dawng hi.

Tu-in Uzziyah’ (Azaryah) tapa, Yahtham, a tapa Yahdah kumpi Ahaz uk hun sungin hih bangin a piang hi: Aram kumpi Rezin leh Remalyah’ tapa Israyl kumpi Pekah in Yerusalem a sim dingin kuan a, ahih hangin a zozo kei uh hi.

Tua ciangin David’ innkuan tungah, “Ephraim gam sungah Aram in guahphual satkhin hi,” ci-in thu kipuak hi. Tua ahih ciangin huih mutsa gamlak-a singkungte bangin Ahaz’ lungsim leh a mite’ lungsim liinglawng uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in Isayah kiangah, “Ahaz tawh a va kimu dingin nang leh na tapa Shear-Yashub pai in. Puansawppa’ Lo zuatna lam lianpi kianga Bual Tungnung tuilakna tuilam mong ah amah tawh kimu inla,
ama kiangah, “Kidawm khikhe inla, dai takin om in. Ansing tumbang khu tawh a kibang hih singtawng nihte hang, Rezin leh Aram’ hehna leh Remalyah’ tapa hehna hangin lau kei inla, lungneu kei in.
Aram, Ephraim leh Remalyah’ tapa in nangma tungah thusia geelkhin uh a,
“Yahdah simin, va buaigawpsak ni. Eite kikalah tua gam va balkhia nila, tua gam ah kumpi dingin Tabeel’ tapa koih ni,” a ci uh hi.
Hih in Yahweh i Pa gen ahi hi: “Tua thu kip loin tangtung lo ding hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh Aram’ lutang in Damascus hi a, Damascus’ lutang in Rezin ahi hi; kum sawmguk le kum nga sungin Ephraim kitamkham ding a, minam khat hi nawn lo ding hi.
Ephraim’ lutang in Samaria hi a, Samaria’ lutang in Remalyah’ tapa ahi hi. Na up kei leh, nang hong kikipsak lo ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua banah Yahweh in Ahaz tungah genkik lai a,
“Yahweh na Pa kiangah lim khat ngen in; a thukpi sung pan ahi zongin tunglam a sangna pan ahi zongin ngen in,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Ahaz in, “Ka ngen kei ding a, Yahweh ka ze-et kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Isayah in, “David’ innkuante aw, tu-in za un: Mite lunggimsak ding phamawhsa lo na hi uh hiam? Note in Yahweh’ lungduaina zong ze-et lai ding hilo na hi uh hiam?

Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh mahmah in etsaknalim khat hong pia ding hi: En un, nungak khat gai-in, Tapa khat hong nei ding a, Immanuyah ahi Vanglianpen Yahweh in eite hong ompihna lim tawh hong pai ding hi.
Amah in gitlohna nialin, thumaanna a teel zia ding a theih nadingin amah in bawngnawi thau leh khuaizu ne ding hi.
Ahih hangin naupang in gitlohna nialin, thumaan a teel zia ding a theih ma-in, na kihtak gam pen a kumpi tenih in nusia ding hi.
Yahdah panin Ephraim a taikhiat ni-a kipanin a tung ngei nai lo tua bang nite tungin, nangma tung, na mite tung leh na pa’ innkuan tungah Yahweh in Assyria kumpipa hong puak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ni ciangin hi bangin hong piang ding hi: Yahweh in Egypt’ gun a gamlapen-a om thote leh Assyria gam sunga om khuaipite sapna phit a mut ding hi.
Amaute hong pai-in, kenhawmte leh suangheng kawm, lingkung lak khempeuh leh sawlbawk lak khempeuh ah a tawlnga ding uh hi.
Tua ni mahin Yahweh in a kikawm mulkiatna tem tawh—Euphrates Gun gal pana mite leh Assyria kumpipa tawh—sam leh khemul khiatkhia ding a, khamul zong a khiatsiang ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin mi khat in bawngla khat leh tuu nih bang bek a khawi ding hi.
Tuate in nawi tampi a piakna hangun, amah in nawi khal ne ding a, nawi khal leh khuaizu ahih leh gam sunga a omlai a kuamapeuh in ne ding uh hi.
Tua ni ciangin hih bang hong hi ding hi: nguntang shekel tulkhat a man leenggui tul khat a omna mun khempeuh ah thanglingkung leh lingkung bek om ding hi.
Gam sung khempeuh ah thanglingkung leh lingkung dim ding ahih manin mite in tua lai-ah thaltang leh thal tawh pai ding hi.

Khatvei lai-a tupeek tawh a kikawh ngeina mual neute khatpeuh ah, thanglingkungte leh lingkungte kihtakna hangin na pai ngam nawn kei ding uh hi. Tua munte pen bawng khahna leh tuute’ gamtatna mun suak ding hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in keima kiangah, “Laizial golpi khat la inla, Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz tawh kisai-in mite’ laikung mawkmawh tawh a tungah gelh in,” hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in hih kamsanna ciamteh nadingin kei aa dingin a muanhuai teci ahi siampi Uriyah leh Yeberechyah’ tapa Zecharyah ka sam hi.
Tua ciangin kamsang numei khat kiangah ka pai a, amah na gai-in tapa khat a nei hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh in keima kiangah, “A min Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz, ci-in phuak in;
Bang hang hiam cihleh naupang in, ‘Papa, Nunu!’ a cih theih ma-in, Damascus khua’ hauhna leh Samaria khuate’ van suhsate, Assyria kumpipa in laksak mang ding hi,” hong ci hi.
Yahweh in kei tungah hong gen lai-a, a gen inah:
“Hih mite in a luang sialsial Shiloah-a tuite nialin, Rezin leh Remalyah’ tapa sungah nuamsa uh ahih manin,

tu-in, en in, Yahweh in a khauh a thahat Euphrates Gun tuite, Assyria kumpipa leh ama minthanna khempeuh amau tungah puak ding hi! A hawkguam khempeuh leh a piau khempeuh dimletin amah a paito ding hi.

Amah in Yahdah nawk ding a, dimletin pai suaksuakin, ngawng ciang dong tum ding hi; a kizalkhia ama kha in na gam a vailam tuam khin ding hi; ahih hangin Immanuyah; a Honpite’ Yahweh in eite hong ompih hi!” hong ci hi.

No minamte aw, kithehthang unla, kitamzan un! Gamlapi-a om no gamte khempeuh aw, na bil ngat un. Kawnggakin kigak un; ahih hangin na kitamzan veve ding uh hi. Kihencip un; ahih hangin na kitamzan veve ding uh hi.
Kikum khawm un; ahih hangin a mawkna suak veve ding hi. Thu genkhia un; ahih hangin kip lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh a Honpite’ Yahweh in eite hong ompih hi; Immanuyah!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in hih mite lampi ka zuih het loh nadingin a khut khuah tawh hih bangin kei hong gen-in kei hong hilh hi:
“Hih mite sawmsim ding thu khempeuh ah sawm khawm kei in; amau zahtakte’ lau-in nei kei inla, zong kihta kei in.
Tungnungpen Yahweh bek siangthosakin, na zahtak Amah hisak inla, na kihtak Amah hisak in.

Tua ciangin Amah pen munsiangtho khat hi ding hi. Ahih hangin Yerusalem-a tengte aa dingin thang leh thangzak bangin Amah pen Israyl innkuan tenih aa dingin puk theihna suangtum leh langpanna suangtum ahi ding hi.
Amaute lakah mi tampi kitukin, pukin, kitamzanin, thang ah awkin, kiman ding hi,” hong ci hi.
Kamsangna thu tun inla, Ka thuzuite lakah Thukham ciamtehna tum in.
Yaaqob’ innkuan tungah a maitang a seel Yahweh ka ngak ding a, Amah ka lamen ding hi.
En in; kei leh Yahweh hong piak tate pen Zion Mual-a teng a honpite’ Yahweh kiang panin Israyl sungah limte leh kihilna ka hi uh hi.

Amaute in no kiangah, “Khate tawh a kizawlte, a phun sausau a ciakciak aisante zong un,” hong cih ciangun mite in a Pa uh a zon zawk ding uh hi lo ahi hiam? Amaute in a nungtate tangin a site a zong uh hilo ahi hiam?
Thukham leh Kamsanna kan un. Amaute in hih kammal tawh kituak loin thu a gen uh leh, amaute sungah khuavak a om loh man ahi hi.

Nakpi-in lungkhamna leh gilkialna tawh gam sung teng nawk ding uh a, amaute a gilkial ciangun amaute a heh uh suakin, a kumpipa leh a pasiante uh samsia ding a, huhna deih-in a tunglam a nga ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in leilam enin, lungkhamna leh khuamial, lungzin-a gimna mu ding uh a, khuamial sahpi sungah amaute kiphum ding hi.

Ahi zongin a masa-in Yahweh in Zebulun gam leh Naphtali gam tawmno cik tawisang a, a nung ciangin minamte omna Galilee gam, Yardan gungal, tuipi kiangah nasia takin a thuaksak lai-a bangin lunggimna sunga om mite tungah lungzinna a om kei ding hi.
Khuamial sunga a pai mite in khuavak lianpi a mukhin uh hi; Sihna liim omna gam sunga a teng mite tungah khuavak a tang khin hi.
Nangmah in minam na pungsak khin a, a nuamna uh na khangsak hi; Anlak hun-a amau lungdam bangin leh mite in vansuhte a hawm uh ciangin a lungdam bangin Nangma mai-ah amaute lungdam uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Midian mite a kizawh ni-a bangin Nangmah in amau vangik puakna hakkol, a liangko tunga ciangtawn, amah a kibawlsiatna ciangduai na kuaihtansak hi.
Galhangte’ zat a buai khedapte leh sisan a bang puansilhte kihalin, mei-in kicih ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh eite aa dingin Naupang khat hong suak a, eite tungah Tapa khat hong kipia hi; Ama liangko tungah ukna om ding hi. Ama min pen a Lamdang Thulakpa aa, Vanglian Tawntung-Pa’ kipsak Thukhenpa, Kilemna Kumpi-tapa kici ding hi.

David’ kumpi-tokhom tung leh Ama kumpigam tungah thu a pia ding leh tua hun-a kipan tua khit a tawntungin thukhenna leh thutang tawh a kipsak dingin Ama ukna leh kilemna khang ding a, mong a nei kei ding hi. Tungnungpen Yahweh’ deih luatna in hih thu a sem ding hi.
Yahweh in Yaaqob sungah thu khat puak a, tua in Israyl tung teng a tangsakkhin hi.
Kiphatsakna tawh a pau, lungsim ki-uangsak uh ahi: Ephraim leh Samaria-a tengte nangawn leh mi khempeuh in tua thu thei ding uh hi.
Leiseekte kicimkhin a, ahih hangin suangsekte tawh kilamkik ding hi; theithek singte kisattan khin a, ahih hangin eite in tamtak kung tawh i suankhawm kik ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in Rezin’ galte amah a do dingin koih ding a, a galte a pawlpih ding uh hi.

A mai-ah Aram mite; Syria-te, leh a nunglam ah Philistine mite om a, amaute in a kam uh ka-in Israyl a netum ding uh hi. Tua hi napi-in hihte khempeuh hangin Ama hehna veng tuan loin a khut a kizan lai ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh mite in amau a vat Yahweh lamah kihei lo uh a, tungnungpen Yahweh zong a zong kei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in ni khat sungin Israyl, a lu leh a mei, a hiang leh a kung a satkhia ding hi.
Upate leh a zahtak-huai mite pen a lu hi a, zuau thu a hilh kamsangpa pen a mei ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh mipi makaite in amaute lamkhialsak uh a, amaute’ makaihsa-a om mite kisusia hi.

Tua ahih ciangin a khangnote sungah Yahweh in lungdamna nei lo ding a, a pa nei lote leh a meigongte uh zong a hehpih kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh a kuamapeuh pen mi hoih kineihkhem leh siatna gamta vive hi uh a, kam khempeuh in haina thu gen hi. Tua hi napi-in hihte khempeuh hangin Ama hehna veng lo a, a khut kizankhia lai hi.
Ahih hangin gitlohna pen meikuang bangin kuang a, tua in thanglingkungte leh lingkungte kangtum a, gammang tulak gamphapi tawh-kuang ding a, meikhu kahto bangin a kizial to ding hi.
Tungnungpen Yahweh’ hehna hangin gam sung kangtum a, mite pen mei-a kicih ding sing tawh kibang ding a, kuamah in a sanggampa zahtuan lo ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a tanglam khut tawh man ding a, ahih hangin a gil kial lai veve a, a veilam khut tawh netum ding a, ahih hangin a gilvah tuan kei hi; mi khempeuh amau ban sa mah a ne ding uh hi.
Menasheh in Ephraim ne ding a, Ephraim in Menasheh ne ding hi; tua tegel in Yahdah langpan khawm ding uh hi. Tua hi napi-in hih thu khempeuh hangin Ama hehna veng lo a, a khut kizankhia lai hi.
Meigongte a mat theih nading leh pa nei lote a suh gawp theih nadingun thutang panin mi cimawhte a heikhia ding leh Ka mite laka mizawngte’ hamphatna a lakkhiat theih nadingin,
thukhenna man lo a pia mite tung leh a dahhuai thukhun zuih dingin a gelh mite tungah gimna tung ta hen!
Gamlapi pana hong pai dan piak ni leh kisiatna sungah bang cih ding na hi uh hiam? Kua kiangah huhna ngenin tai ding na hi uh hiam? Koi tengah na minthanna nusia ding na hi uh hiam?
Kei tawh loin thongkiate lakah amaute kiniam lot gawp ding uh a, a kithat mite lakah kihel ding uh hi. Tua hi napi-in hih thu khempeuh hangin Ama hehna veng lo a, a khut kizalkhia lai hi.
A khut sungah Ka thangpaihna ciangtawn a tawi, Ka hehna ciangduai Assyria mite tungah gimna tung hen.
Mi hoih kineih khem minam langpanin amah ka sawl ding a, Kei hong hehsak mite’ neihsa a sut ding, a man ding leh kongzing laka buante bangin amaute a tuancil dingin amah thu ka neisak ding hi.
Ahih hangin hih pen ama sawm hi loin, a lungsim sunga om zong a hi kei hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh ama ngaihsutna in minam tawmno bek suksiat ding leh beisak ding ahi kei hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in, “Ka uliante pen kumpi vive hi lo ahi hiam?
Calno zong Carchemish khua mah tawh kibang hilo ahi hiam? Hamath zong Arpad tawh kibang hilo ahi hiam? Samaria pen Damascas tawh kibang hilo ahi hiam?
Pasiante’ kumpigamte, Yerusalem leh Samaria-a omte sangin a lianzaw a kiseek milim a nei kumpigamte ka khut in a ban khin hi.
Samaria leh a pasiante uh tunga ka bawl bangin Yerusalem leh a pasiante uh tungah bawl lo ding ka hi hiam?

Tua ahih ciangin hi bangin hong piang ding hi: Yahweh in Zion Mual tung leh Yerusalem ah a sep ding khempeuh a sep khit ciangin, Assyria kumpipa kiphatsakna lungtang gah leh a kihihsak mit-hekna teng ka dantat ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in, “Keima thahatna ngiat tawh hih teng ka sem a, ciim ka hih manin keima pilna ngiat tawh ka hih ahi hi! Keimah in mite’ gamgite zong ka lakhia a, amau van manphate la-in, a thahat mi khat bangin gam sunga tengte ka niam khoih hi.

Vasa bu lak bangin mite’ hauhna teng keima khut tawh ka la a, mite in a pi loihsa vasa tui a khop bangin leitung buppi ka khawm hi; A kha a zap ngam, a kamka ngam leh a ham ngam khat beek a om kei hi,” a ci hi.
Molhtum in amah a liik mipa a zat bang kekin, ciangkhut in sing a hilo mipa a vei bang kekin, amah a zangpa langpanin heitang kiphasak ahi hiam? Amah a zangpa langpanin sing-at-tem kiphasak ahi hiam?
Hih thu hangin eite Pa, tungtungpen Yahweh in tuapa mi thaute lakah tuapa mi thaute lakah tha bei-na tungsak ding a, Ama minthanna nuai-ah meikuang bangin a kuangsak ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israyl’ Khuavak pen mei hi ding a, Ama Siangtho Pa pen meikuang hi ding hi. Tua in ni khat thu-in ama lingkungte leh thanglingkungte kangin beitum ding hi.
Tua in a gammang tulak hoih teng leh, a lo lei hoih teng, a nuntakna leh a pumpi a nih tuakin netum ding a, a gawnggawp micina khat tawh a kibang ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin a gammang tulak-a om singkung omlaite, naupang khat in a phazah a gelh zo zah dong dingin a tawmlua mahmah ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin hih bang hi ding hi: Israyl a omlai sunte leh Yaaqob’ innkuan a suakta laite in amau a vattukpa tungah kinga nawn loin, a thuman, Israyl’ Siangtho Pa, Yahweh tungah kinga ding uh hi.
A omlai sunte, Yaaqob sunga omlai sunte, Vanglian Pa kiangah ciahkik ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin Israyl aw, na mipite pen tuipi gei-a sehnal tawh a kibat hangin amaute laka a omlai sunte bek kilehkik ding uh a, suksiat ding thukhenna pen thumaanna tawh a dimlet ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh a honpite’ Pa, Yahweh in suksiatna khat leh leitung khempeuh laizangah khensatsa a tawpna khat a bawl ding hi.
Tua hi a, hih in a honpite’ Pa, Yahweh gen ahi hi: Zion-a teng Ka mite aw, Assyria mite kihta kei un. Egypt-te hih bangin amah in molhtum tawh hong satin, note tungah a ciangkhut hong liik ding hi.
Tua hi napi-in tomno sungin note tungah thangpaihna veng ding a, Keima hehna in amau siatna ding lam a zuan ding hi.

Tungnungpen Yahweh in Oreb-a suangpi ah Midian mite a thahmang bangin ama tungah dantatna khauteep a vik ding hi. Ama molhtum in tuipi tung a vat bangin Egypt mite thuak bangin a molhtum a liik ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin hi bangin piang ding hi: Note liangko tunga ama vangik kilakhia ding a, na ngawng uh panin ama hakkol kilakhia-in, sathau hong kihilhna hangin tua hakkol a kisusia ding hi.
Aiath ah amah tung khin a, amah in Migron a kheng khin hi. Michmash ah a van teng a khol hi.
Amaute in mualciang kantanin, Geba ah giak uh hi. Ramah lau mahmah a, Shaul’ tenna Gibeah a taikek hi.
Gallim’ tanu aw, na aw sangsak in! A hehpihhuai Anathoth aw, Laish khua zasak in.
Madmenah taikhin hi; Gebim-a tengte in bukna mun zong hi.
Tua ni-in Nob ah amah omlai ding hi napi-in, amah in Yerusalem mualneu ahi, Zion’ tanu mual, a khuttum a sinsan ding hi.
En un, Yahweh, a honpite’ Yahweh in kihtak-huaina tawh a hiang sattan ding a, a kung sang teng kiphukin, a kisangsakte a kiniamkoih ding hi.
Tua ciangin Amah in gammang tulak sing honpi teng sik tawh sattan ding a, Vanglian Pa hangin Lebanon puk ding hi.
Yishai kung tung panin a Meeng khat hong sel khia ding a, a zung panin a Hiang hong khangkhia ding hi.
Ama tungah Yahweh’ Kha teng ding a, pilna leh thu theihtelna Kha, thu lamlah siamna leh vangliatna Kha, thutheihna leh Yahweh’ zahtakna Kha Ama tungah a om ding hi.
Tua in Amah thu telbaihsak ding a, Ama nopsakna pen Yahweh zahtakna sungah a om ding hi. Amah in a mit tawh a muh bangin thu khen lo ding a, a bil tawh a zakna bangin taii ziau lo ding hi.

Ahih hangin Amah in thumaanna tawh mi zawngte thukhen ding a, leitung-a a kiniamkhiatte aa dingin tang takin thu a khen ding hi. Amah in a kam pana ciangpum tawh leitung sat ding a, a muk pana husan tawh migilote a that ding hi.
Thumaanna in Ama kawnggak hi ding a, cihtakna in Ama dialkaih hi ding hi.
Keivom nangawn tuuno tawh tengkhawm ding a, gialbem zong keelno tawh lum khawm ding hi. Bawngno leh humpinelkai no leh ganhing thaute omkhawm ding a, naupangno khat in tuate a makaih ding hi.
Bawngpi leh vompi in an ne khawm ding a, amau note lum khawm ding hi. Humpinelkai in bawngtal bangin buhkung ne ding hi.
Gul gupha kuavang gei-ah a kikhoi lai naungek kimawl ding a, naupangnote in gul gu nei bu a khutin a sawk ding hi.
Ka mual siangtho buppi tungah amaute khatlekhat kinasak loin, kisusia lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tuipi a tuam tuite mah bangin Yahweh’ thutheihna leitung hong kidim ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin Yishai’ Zung khat hong om ding hi. Tua in mite aa dingin lim khat bangin ding ding a, Gentile mite’ zon hi ding a, Ama tawlngakna minthang ding hi.

Tua ni ciangin hi bangin piang ding hi: Assyria pan, Egypt pan, Pathros pan, Cush pan, Elam pan, Shinar pan, Hamath pan leh tuipi gei-a tuikulhte panin a omlaite ahi Ama mi a omlai sunte a hotkik nadingin Yahweh in a nih veina a khut zankik ding hi.
Amah in minamte aa dingin lim khat koih ding a, Israyl mi a kihawlkhiate kaikhawmin, leitung kiu li panin Yahdah mi a kikhenthangte a kaikhawm ding hi.
Ephraim-te’ hazatna bei ding a, Yahdah’ galte kisusia ding hi. Ephraim in Yahdah haza lo ding a, Yahdah in Ephraim simmawh lo ding hi.

Ahih hangin amaute in nitumna lam Philistia mualdung teng ah lengsuk mang ding uh a, amaute in nisuahna lam mite buluh khawm ding uh hi. Amaute in Edom leh Moab-te tungah a khut nga ding uh a, Ammon mite in amau’ thu mang ding hi.
Yahweh in Egypt’ Tuipi’ leii susia kiuhkeuh ding a, Ama huih thahat tawh Nile Gun tungah a khuttum singin, a lui sagihte vatin, khedap bulh-in mite a kantansak ding hi.
Egypt gam panin Israyl hong paitoh niin ama aa dingin lam lianpi a om mah bangin a kinusia Ama mi a omlai sunte aa dingin Assyria pan lam lianpi khat om ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin note in, “Yahweh aw, kei tungah nong heh hangin na hehna vengin, kei hong hehnem na hih manin Nang kong phat ding hi.
En in, Yahweh in keima kihotkhiatna hi a, Amah muangin, ka lau kei ding hi. YAHWEH, Yahweh pen ka thahatna leh ka zaila hi a, keimah hong honkhiapa hong hizo hi,” na ci ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin lungdamna tawh hotkhiatna tuikhukte panin tui na khai ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin note in, “Halleluyah! Yahweh phat un! Ama Min lo un. Mite lakah Ama nasepnate genkhia unla, Ama Min lian hi, ci-in tangko un.
Yahweh in na hoihpente sem ahih manin Ama tungah la sa un; leitung khempeuh hih thu kitheisak un.
No Zion-a tengte aw, note lakah Israyl’ Siangtho Pa lian ahih manin kiko-in awng un,” na ci ding uh hi.
Amoz’ tapa Isayah in Babylon tunga vangik a muhte:
Kongpite ah Sap Tuamte a lut theih nadingin mual sang tungah theihsakna dialkhai khai unla, amau tungah na aw sangsakin, na khut van un.
Keimah in ka siansak tuamte thu ka pia khin a, Ka hehna a sem dingin Keima tawisangna ah nuam a sa ka mi thahatte ka sam khin hi.
Mi honpi gamlumna bangin mual liante tunga a honpi gamlumna ngai dih un; a kikaikhawm minam kumpigamte’ gamlumna ngai un; Tungnungpen Yahweh in galsim dingin galkapte a kaikhawm hi.
Gam buppi a susia dingin Yahweh leh Ama thangpaihna galvante gamlapi gam pan, vantung mongte panin hong pai uh hi.
Yahweh’ ni hong nai lua ta ahih manin nakpi-in kap un. Vanglianpa; Shaddai, kiang panin suksiatna hong tung ta ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin khut khempeuh zawmin, mi khempeuh lungsim tuisuak ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh vantung aksite leh a sunga aksi honpite in khuavak pia lo ding a, ni pen a paina teng ah kimialsak ding a, khapi in khuavak a taangkhiasak kei ding hi.

Ama sungah cikmahin kiteng nawn loin, khang khat panin khang khat a kiten lohna hi ding a, Arabia mite in zong tua lai-ah puanbuk lam loin, tuucingte kuamah in tua lai-ah a tuute uh lumsak lo ding hi.

Tua ni ciangin hi bangin hong piang ding hi: Yahweh in na dahna uh pan, na launa uh pan leh a haksa nasep hong kisepsak salsuahna panin tawldamna hong pia ding hi.
Note in Babylon kumpipa tungah hih zahpihna paunak na cih theih nading uh ahi hi. Tua in, “Mi nengniampa manta diang ei! Kham khuapi zong man ei!”
Yahweh in migilote’ ciangkhut leh gam-ukte’ kumpi-ciangkhut a sutan khin hi.
Tawlnga loin hehna tawh mite a sat mipa, gitlohna tawh minamte a uk mipa tu-in amah kibawlsia a, kuamah in kham lo hi.

Hi hi, taksingte in Lebanon-a tamtak kungte tawh nangma tungah nuamsa uh a, “Nang hong kiniam koih nungsang, kote kiangah singphuk kuamah hong pai nawn lo hi,” a ci uh hi.

Nang na pai ciangin nang hong dawn dingin nuai lam sheol; hankhuk, lawp a, nang aa dingin misite, leitunga ulian ahi ngeite khempeuh thosak a, tua in amau kumpi tokhomte aa dingin minamte’ kumpite khempeuh thotosak hi.
Amaute khempeuh in nang hong hopih-in nangma kiangah, “Kote bangin nang zong thakia na hi hiam? Kote tawh kibang ta na hi hiam?” hong ci ding uh hi.
Na harp awgingte tawh hankhuk ah na kiphatsakna kipaipihsuk a, nangma nuai-ah than dimin, thante in nang hong tuam hi.
Nang Hillel, khuavak’ ta aw, vantung panin na kiasukkhin zen hi! Minamte a thazawmsak Nangmah, leilak ah hong kikhiasuk mawk hi!

Bang hang hiam cihleh nangmah in na lungsim sungah, “Vantungte’ tungah ka kahto ding a, Yahweh i aksite’ tunglam ah ka tokhom ka sangtosak ding hi. Mihonpite kikhopna mual siangtho tung a sangpen mun ah ka tu ding hi.
Meiite’ tung pek ah ka kahto ding a, Sangpen Pa bangin ka om ding hi,” na ci hi.
Ahih hangin nang pen Sheol ah, gum thukpi sungah hong kipaipihsuk ding hi.
Nang hong mute in hong sal gega ding uh a, amaute in nangma thu genin, “Leitung lokgawpin, kumpigamte a liinglawngsak amah ahi hiam?
Leitung pen sehnel gam suaksakin, a sunga khuapite a susia, a saltangte a khahkhia nuam lo hih in amah hilo ahi hiam?” ci ding uh hi.
Minamte kumpite khempeuh, amaute khempeuh, amau inn ciat ah thupi takin a lum uh hi.

Ahih hangin namsau tawh kidawt letin a si mite’ puan bangin, khe nuai-a a kituancil misi luang bangin suang dum sunga a tuak mite bangin, a kihhuai singhiang bangin na hankhuk panin hong kilawnkhia ding hi.
Nang pen amaute tawh na kivui khawm kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh nangmah in na gam na susia khin a, na mite na that khin hi; Siatna bawlte’ suan pen cikmah hunin kigen kik nawn lo ding hi!
A pu a pate uh mawhna hangin a tate aa dingin thahna ding gelkhol in; tua hi leh amaute tho zo nawn loin, leitung luah loin, lei maitang ah khuapite a dimin a omsak kei zo kei ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute langah ka pang ding hi, Tungnungpen Yahweh in ci hi. Babylon panin min leh a omlaite, tate leh suanlekhakte ka susia ding hi, Yahweh in ci hi.

Tungnungpen Yahweh in ciam khin a, “Ka geelsa bang teekteekin, piang ding a, ka ngimsa bang teekteekin kip ding hi:

Ka gam sungah Assyria mite ka gawizan ding a, Ka mual liante tungah ka tuancil gawp ding hi. Tua khit ciangin Ka mite tung panin ama hakkol ka lakhia ding a, amau liangko tung panin ama vangik ka hemkhia ding hi.
Hih in leitung buppi aa dingin ngimna hi a, hih in minam khempeuh tunga a kizankhia khut ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Tungnungpen Yahweh in geel khin a, kua in phiat thei ding ahi hiam? Ama khut kizankhia a, khua in khepsakkik thei ding ahi hiam?
Hih vangik pen Kumpi Ahaz sih kum-a piang ahi hi:

No Philistia-te khempeuh aw, note hong sat mipa’ ciangtawn a kitankhit na hangin nuam se kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh gulpi’ zung panin gul gupha hong mengkhia ding a, ama suanlekhak pen a leng thei gul gupha hong hi ding hi.
Mizawngte’ tacil in an kham ding a, micimawhte lungmuang takin lum ding hi; ahih hangin Keimah in kialpi tawh na zungte ka sisak ding a, amah in na neihlai sun teng that lum ding hi.

Kulhkongpi aw, kapin tau in! Khuapi aw, kap in! No Philistia-te khempeuh tuisuak mang un! Bang hang hiam cihleh leilu lam panin meikhu khat hong suakkhia a, a kisehsa ama mun panin a tangkaikhia kuamah a om kei ding hi.
Tua minam kamtaite tungah bang a kici dawn ding hiam? ‘Yahweh in Zion kipsak khin a, Ama mi a zawngte in tua sung bukna-in nei ding hi,’ ci ding uh hi.
Moab tawh kisai-in vangik: zan hun sungin Moab-a om Ar bangmah lo kisuah ahih manin gamdaihna kitun a, zan hun sungin Moab-a om Kir bangmah lo kisuah ahih manin gamdaihna kitun hi;
A kap dingin mun sanga inn ah Dibon paito khin a, Moab in Nebo leh Medeba a kah ding hi. Amau luzang khempeuh kikiattol ding a, khamul khempeuh kimetmai ding hi.
A kongzing lakah amaute in puanhampi silh ding uh a, amau innkum zangte leh a kongzing lakah mi khempeuh kap-in nakpi-in a tau ding uh hi.
Heshbon leh Elealeh kap ding a, Yatzah ciang dong a aw uh kiza ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin galvan tawh kithawi Moab galkapte kiko ding uh a, amau aa dingin nuntakna a thuak-hak ding hi.

Moab aa dingin ka lungsim kapkhia ding a, a galtai mite Zoar leh Eglath Shelishiah ah taimang ding uh hi. Kap kawmsa-in Luhith zuatna lampi ah paito ding uh a, siatna a thuakna hangun Horonaim zuatna lampi ah amaute nakpi-in kap ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nimrim-a tuite kangin, lopa vul mang a, gampa a keu hi. A niim khat beek a om nawn kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in a ngahsa uh tampite leh a kholsate uh Gialhek Lui ah puakhia ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Moab gamgi kiimkot khempeuh ah kahna om a, a kahna in Eglaim banin, a kahna in Beer Elim ban hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Dimon-a tuite sisan tawh kidim ding a, ahih hangin Dimon ah ka tunsak beh lai ding hi—Moab panin a taikhiate leh gam sunga a omlai sunte, humpinelkaite in bawhgawp ding hi.
Sela panin sehnel gam dongin, gam-ukpa tung, Zion’ tanu mual tungah tuuno khak un.
Bang hang hiam cihleh a bu a kipaihkhiatsak a lauthawng gawp vasate bangin Arnon-a lui kantanna ngahmun ah Moab’ tanute zong a tua ci ding uh hi.
Kuppih unla, thu khen un; sunkim laitakin zan bangin na liim uh ngahsak un, a kipaaikhiate seel unla, a suaktate lehhek kei un!

Moab aw, Ka paihkhiate nang tawh teng khawm henla, suhgawpna panin amaute aa dingin liahna hi in. Bang hang hiam cihleh mi zawhthawhpa om nawn loin, vansutgawp-pa khawlin, mi bawlsiate gam sung panin a kibeitum hi.
Hehpihna tawh kumpi-tokhom kikipsak ding a, thumaan sep ding manlangin thutang kanin thu a khen mipa pen David buk sunga tua tungah thu man tawh tu ding hi.
Eite in Moab’ kiphatsakna—a kiliatsakna, a kiphatsakna, a lungsona—thu i za khin a, amah kiphasak mahmah hi; ahih hangin ama zuau-na om beh nawn lo ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moab in Moab kah ding hi. Note in Kir Hareseth’ bulkipte na kah ding uh hi; amaute in a thuak taktak ahi uh hi.
Heshbon lote leh Sibmah leenggui vul ahih manin, minamte’ tote in Yazer ciang a ban, sehnel gam sung dong a zam a gui hoih tata sattan hi. A hiangte zamkhia a, tuate in tuipi a kheng hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Yazer-a a kapte tawh Sibmah leenggui ka kah ding hi. Heshbon leh Elealeh aw, ka khituite tawh note tui kong pia ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh na khuakhal singgahte leh na anlakte hangin na awtnate uh dai khin hi.

Tua ahih ciangin lo-a lawhcinna panin kipaakna pen lungnopna tawh kilakhia mang a, leenggui lote ah lasakna om loin, lungdamna awtna zong a om kei ding hi. Leenggah sukte in leenggahzu sukkhia lo ding uh hi: leenggah lawh huna lungdam kikona aw ka khawlsak khin hi.
Hih thu hangin Moab aa dingin harp khat bangin ka lungsim kithawn a, Kir Haresh aa dingin ka sungah kithawn hi.
Hi bangin hong piang ding hi: mun sangna ah Moab a gimna a kimuh ciangin thungen dingin a munsiangtho ah amah pai ding a, ahih hangin a lawhcing kei ding hi.
Hih in tua hun-a kipanin Moab tawh kisai-in Yahweh in a gen khitsa hi a,
ahih hangin tu-in Yahweh in, “A kicial nasempa kum hunte bangin kum thum sungin Moab’ thupitna, a mihon tampi khempeuh tawh kisimmawh ding a, a omlai sunte tawm mahmah-in a thanem ding uh hi.
Damascus’ vangik: En un, Damascus khuapi hi nawn lo ding a, ninbulomtang khat suak ding hi.

Tua ciangin mihing in amah a Bawlpa en ding a, ama mittang in Israyl’ Siangtho Pa tungah zahtakna a nei ding hi.

Nangma hotkhiatna Pa mangngilh khin-in, na thahatna Suangpi phawk lo na hih manin, nangmah in kung hoihte suanin, gamdang leengguite na suan ding a,
tua ni mah-in na kungnote na khangsak ding a, zingsangin na khaici-te na pakkhiasak ding a, ahih hangin na anlakte pen dahna leh lamet bei-in khasiat ni-a siatna lompi a suak ding hi.
Tui tampite gin zuazua bangin minamte awng zuazua ding uh a, amaute a gamlapi ah tai-in, huihpi mai-a leng mual tunga ansite leh pingpei mai-a leng sawlbawk bangin a lengkhia mang ding hi.
En un, nitakin buaina! Zingsang hong tun ma-in amah a om nawn kei hi! Hih in ei hong buluh mite sehtanh leh eite hong sutgawp mite tunga kipia tanh ahi hi.
Ephiopia gunte gal-a om khate tawh liim a ngah gam in gimna thuak hen;

Tua gam in papyrus kung tawh kibawl gunkuangte tawh tuipi tawnin gamvan-palaite sawlin, “Kamtai manlangte aw, amau gam gunpite in a kikhensak, a thahat a vanglian minam, a kipat uh-a kipanin tu hun ciang dong a kikihta minam, gam khenkhamin a tuancil minam khat kiangah va pai un,” ci hi.
Leitung-a tengte khempeuh leh leitung-a om mi khempeuh aw, mualte tungah lim khat hong kilah ciangin na mu ding uh hi! Peengkul a kimut ciangin, na za ding uh hi!
Bang hiang hiam cihleh Yahweh in keima kiangah, “Ka tawlnga hit-hiat ding a, ankungte tunga a lum hiuhiau bangin, anlak khualum hun-a meiizun bangin Ka tenna mun panin ka en ding hi,” hong ci hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh anlak hun ma, a pakteng a pulh khit ciangin, a pak khit leenggah a lak hun laitakin, Amah in singhiang heuhna temkawi tawh a selte atkhia ding a, a zam zeizai a hiangte heuhkhia ding hi.
Tuate pen mual tunga vasate aa ding leh leitung gamsate aa dingin kinusia ding a, vasate in khuakhal sung ne-in leitung gamsate in phalbi sung a ne ding uh hi.

Egypt’ vangik: En un, A manlang mahmah meii tungah Yahweh tuangin Egypt ah pai ding a, Ama mai-ah Egypt-te’ pasiante lau-in liing ding uh a, Egypt’ lungtang ama sung mah ah tuisuak ding hi.

Tua ni ciangin Egypt pen numei tawh kibang ding a, Amah in amaute tunga a liinsak Tungnungpen Yahweh’ khut kilokna hangin lau-in a liing ding hi.

Tua hun lai-in Yahweh in Amoz’ tapa Isayah tungtawnin thu gen a, “Na kawng panin na puanhampi suah-in, ka khe panin na khedapte suah inla, pai un,” a ci hi. Amah in zong tua bangin hih a, a guaktang leh a kheguakin a pai hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “Egypt leh Ethiopia tunga lim leh siahil dingin Ka nasempa Isayah guaktang leh kheguak-in kum thum sung a pai mah bangin,
Assyria kumpipa in thongkiami-in Egypt mite leh galmat-in Ethiopia mite, a moi a ham a guaktang, a kheguak, Egypt a maizumna dingin a tawbote khuh loin a kaikhia mang ding hi.
Tua ciangin amau lametna Ethiopia leh amau kisaktheihpih Egypt hangin amaute lau-in a maizum ding uh hi.

Tua ni ciangin hih tuikulh-a tengte in, ‘Assyria kumpipa kiang panin eite hong honkhia dingin huhna ngenin i taina mun, i lamette en dih un. Eite bangci suahtak ding i hi hiam?’ ci ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tuipi gei-a sehnel gam’ vangik: Pingpei in leitaw lam a kantan mah bangin, sehnel gam pan, a kihtak-huai gam panin tua ci bang hong pai hi.

A kihtakhuai mangmuhna khat kei tungah hong kigen a, a lehhek thei mipa in lehhekin, a sut thei mipa in sut hi. Elam aw, kuan to in! Media aw, umcih in! Keima bawlsa tua gam sunga tau-na khempeuh ka beisak ding hi, ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka kawng teng na a, nausuak numei khat in na a sak bangin natna in kei hong lencip hi.
Ka lungtang zawm a, kihtakna in hong lausak hi. Ka nopsak zanhun pen Amah in lau-na-in hong heisak hi.
Ankuang lui unla, galvilna tausang ah galvil-in, an ne tui dawn un; tua khit ciangin no uliante aw, kithawi unla, kidalna lum sathau nilh un.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in hih thu kei tungah hong genkhin hi: “Pai inla, galvil mi koih in. Amah in a muh bangbang gensak in.
Tua ciangin amah in sakol tung tuang pawlkhat tawh leeng khat leh laate tunga kivawh leeng khat leh kalaohte tunga kivawh leeng a muh ciangin, amah in limtakin phatakin ngai hen,” hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah kiko-in, “Ka siapa aw, humpinelkai khat! Galvilna tausang tungah sun tawntung ka ding tansuak a, zan simin ka vilna mun ah ka tu hi.

Tua ciangin en in, hih lai-ah sakol tung tuang pawlkhat tawh mi a tuang leeng khat hong pai hi. Tua ciangin amah in dawngin, “Babylon kicim, kicim, ama pasiante a kiseek limte khempeuh Amah in lei lakah sukzansak hi,” a ci hi.
Keima kong cilsa, ka phual-a buhte aw, Israyl’ Pa, tungnungpen Yahweh kiang panin ka zaksa thu, note tungah kong pulak khin hi.
Dumah’ vangik: Amah in Seir panin kei hong samkhia-in, “Galvilpa aw, tuzan bangci hiam? Galvilpa aw, tuzan bangci hiam?” hong ci hi.
Galvilpa in, “Zingsang hita a, zong zan lai hi. Kan nuam na hih leh, kan inla, ciah-in, hong pai kik in,” a ci hi.
Arabia tunga vangik; No Dedan mi khuazon honte aw, Arabia gam sunga gamlak ah na giak ding uh hi.
Tema gama tengte in a dangtak mipa tungah tui puak a, galtai mipa an tawh a dawn hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute pen nausau, a kidoksa nausam, a kikeeksa thal leh gal husa panin hong taite ahi uh hi.
Yahweh in hih thu kei tungah hong gen hi: Kum khat sung, a kicial mipa’ kum hunte mah bangin Kedar’ minthanna khempeuh puk ding hi.
Thal tawi a omlai sunte, Kedar mi galhangte tawm ding hi,” ci hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh in genzo hi.
Mangmuhna Kuam tunga vangik: Note khempeuh innkhum zang ah na paitoh nadingun tu-in bang in nang hong buaisak ahi hiam?
Nang buai-na tawh a dim, a gamlum den khuapi aw, na mi thatte uh namsau-in kithat lo a, gal sunga si zong hi lo hi.
Na gam-ukte khempeuh uh taikek khawm uh a, amaute pen thal tawite’ matsa-in om uh hi. Nang sunga hong kimante khempeuh, gamlapi ah a taite hangin thong sungah hong kikhum khawm hi.
Tua ahih ciangin keimah in, “Hong en kei un; nakpi-in ka kap ding hi. Ka mite’ tanu hong kisuhna hangin kei hong hehnem dingin hancim kei un,” ka ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh tua pen buai-na, tuatcilna, Tungnungpen Pa, Yahweh in Mangmuhna Kuam sungah tokzau-in, kulhte a sukzanna, mual liante a kikahna ni ahi hi.
A tuangte leh leengte, leh sakol tung tuangte tawh Elam in thallawng pua a, Kir in lumte a suahkhia hi.
Hi bangin hong piang ding hi: na kuam hoihpente leengte tawh kidim ding a, sakol tung tuangte in kulhkongpite ah munla ding uh hi.
Amah in Yahdah dalna lakhia a, tua ni ciangin note in Tulak Inn sunga galhiamte’ na zong hi.
Nangmah in David khuapi galdalnate mun tampi a kisiatna zong na mukhin uh a, bual nuainung-a tuite na khawm hi.
Yerusalem-a innte na sim a, kulh kisiate puah nadingin innte na phel khin hi.
Nangmah in Bual Lui-a tuite khol nadingin kulhpi nih kikal ah tui beempi khat zong na bawl hi. Ahih hangin nangmah in tua na a Bawlpa phawk loin, sawt pek lai-in a geel Pa na zahtak kei lai hi.
Tua ni ciangin a honpite’ Pa, Yahweh in kahna, tau-na, kiattolna leh puanhampi silh dingin thu pia hi.
Ahih hangin en un, lungdamna leh kipakna om lai zen a, bawngtalte leh tuute go-in, sa nekna leh leenggahzu dawnna nei-in, “Zingciangin si ta ding i hih manin ne-in dawn ni,” na ci zawsop uh hi.
Tua ciangin Tungnungpen Yahweh kiang panin ka bil sungah hih thu hong kilaak hi: Na sih matengun no kiang panin hih mawhna kisawp khia lo taktak ding hi, tungnungpen Yahweh in ci hi.
Hih in a honpite’ Pa, Yahweh cih ahi hi: Inn sung a uk Shebanyah kiangah pai inla, hih neihsa kempa tungah gen in;

‘Suangpi sungah a hankhuk ding a khuak, a sangna ah ama aa dingin hankhuk a to khat bangin hih lai-ah nang aa dingin hankhuk na tawh nadingin nangmah in hih lai-ah bang nei-a, hih lai-ah kua nei na hiam?
En in, Yahweh in saltanna nasia tak tawh nang hong puakhia ding a, nang hong kuhcip taktak ding hi.

Gam lian khat sunga kilawn bawhlung khat bangin Amah in nang hong pingpei gawpin zial gawp ding taktak ding hi. Tua lai-ah nang na si ding a, na minphatna leengte pen na ukpa’ inn-a maizumna hi ding hi.
Tua ciangin na za panin kong notkhia ding a, na zum panin kong sawnkhai ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin hi bangin hong piang ding hi: Keimah in Hilkiyah’ tapa Ka nasempa Elyakim ka sam ding a,
na puantualpi amah silhsak-in, na kawnggak amah ka gaksak ding a, na vaipuak teng ama khut sungah ka ap ding hi. Amah pen Yerusalem-a tengte aa dingin leh Yahdah innkuan aa dingin pa khat hi ding hi.
David’ inn tawhtang ama liangko tungah ka nga ding hi; tua ahih ciangin amah in hong-in, kuamah in khak lo ding a, amah in khakin, kuamah in hong lo ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah pen mun kip khat-a tum siktukilh khat bangin amah ka kipsak ding a, amah pen a pa innkuan aa dingin a minthang kumpi-tokhom a suak ding hi.
Amaute in a pa innkuan’ minthanna khempeuh, a beh a phung, a suan a khak, haite-a kipan tuibeelte khempeuh dong a neng a tawng um leh beel khemepuh ama tungah khai ding uh hi.
Tungnungpen Yahweh in ci hi: Tua ni ciangin mun kip-a a kikipsak siktukilh pen kihemkhia-in, kisattan-in, kia ding a, a tunga vangik teng kisia ding hi. Yahweh in genkhin zo hi.
Tyre tunga vangik: No Tarshish tembawte aw, Tyre kisia ahih manin kap un! Tua lai-ah inn leh khawlmunte om nawn lo hi. Chittim; Cyprus, gam panin hih thu amaute tungah kilaak hi.
No tuikulh-a tengte leh tuipi kantanin a pai mite’ dipsa-a om no Sidon sumbawlte aw, dai khinkhian un.
Tui lianpi tungah Sihor antang hong pai a, Nile Gun-a anlakte Tyre’ siah hi a, Tyre pen minamte’ sumbuk phualpi ahi hi.

Sidon aw, tuipi in hong genzo ahih manin maizum in; tuipi’ thahatna in, “Keimah nau ka suak ngei kei a, ta ka nei ngei kei hi. Keimah in tangval ka khoi ngei kei a, nungak ka khansuah ngei kei hi,” a ci hi.
Tyre tawh kisai-in Egypt ah thu a tun ciangin, Tyre’ thu hangin amaute in na sa mahmah ding uh hi.
No tuikulh-a tengte aw, Tarshish lam kantan unla, kap un.
Tanglai pek-a tang khuapi, gamlapi pek panin a kiphut hih khuapi, na kisak theihpih khuapi ahi hiam?
Kumpi-lukhu a bang khuapi, a sumbukte ulian vive ahi, a sumbawlte leitung mi thupi vive ahi Tyre langa hih vaihawmna ahih kua ahi hiam?
Minthanna hanga kiphatsakna khempeuh a minsiasak ding leh, leitunga mi thupi khempeuh etneu a suah nadingin Tungnungpen Yahweh in tua thu a geel ahi hi.
Tarshish’ tanu aw, Nile Gun bangin na gam kantan in. Thahatna them zong a om nawn kei hi.
Amah in tuipi tungah a khut zankhia-in kumpigamte a lokgawp hi; Yahweh in sumbukte tungah a munkhip muanhuaite a suksiat nadingin thu a pia khin hi.

Tua ciangin Amah in, “Sidon’ tanu, nang nungak a nengniam nu aw, nuam na sa nawn kei ding hi! Tho inla, Chittim; Cyprus, lam kantan in; ahih hangin tua lai-ah zong khawl nading mun na nei kei ding hi,” a ci hi.

Chaldea mite’ gam en un! Hih mite bangmah-in kisim nawn lo hi! Assyria in sehnel-gam-a gamsate aa ding suahkhin ta a, amaute in a tausangte phutin, umcihna taute sangsak uh a, tua ciangin a siacimsak uh hi.
No Tarshish tembawte aw, na thahatna uh maimangta ahih manin kap un!

Tua ni ciangin hi bangin hong piang ding hi: kumpi khat nuntak hun sung bangin kum sawmsagih sung Tyre kimangngilh ding hi. Kum sawmsagih a bei khit ciangin Tyre tungah hih bang piang ding hi: amah in a paktat numei bangin lasa ding hi;
Nang kuama phawk loh a paktat numei a, harp khausai la-in, khuapi sung teng ah vakvai in. A gin hoih ginsak inla, la tampi sa in; tua hileh nang hong kiphawk kha thei ding hi.

Tua kum sawmsagih a bei khit ciangin a piang ding thu hih ahi hi: Yahweh in Tyre en ding a, Tyre khuapi in ama sep ngei semkikin, leitung maitang-a leitung khumpigamte khempeuh tawh kizomin sumbawl khawm ding hi.

Tua ciangin ama summuh teng leh thalawhsate pen Yahweh tungah a siangtho hi ding hi. Tua pen a kikhol tuam a kikoih tuam kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh ama summuh teng pen Yahweh mai-a a teng mite aa dingin kicing taka a nek nading leh puansilh hoih nono lei nading ahi hi.
En un, Yahweh in leitung hawmsuak sakin gamkhing suaksak a, lei maitang susia gawp-in, a sunga tengte a thehtang mang hi.
Mipite leh siampite, silate leh a neite, nasemnu leh a nasepna-pi, a leite leh a zuakte, leitawi a piate leh a late, a met a late leh a met a piate a kibang kim ding hi.
Leitang kihawmsuak sak ding a, kisiacip ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in hih thu a genzo hi.
Leitung kapin, tulta a, leipi kapin a tul hi; leitunga mi kiliansakte a bah hi.
Leitung pen ama sunga a tengte mah in ninsak hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Thukhamte palsatin, biakna ngeina kipte khel-in, tawntung thuciamna palsat uh hi.
Hih thu hangin samsiatna in leitung netum a, a sunga teng mite kisia hi; tua ahih ciangin leitunga tengte kangin, mi tawm bek a omlai hi.
Leenggahzu thak kap a, leenggui bah-in, a lungnop mite khuisa ta hi.
Gualnopna khuang gingte khawl a, a nuamsa mite’ gamlumna bei-in, harp khausai tawh nopsakna a dai ta hi.
Amaute in la sa-in leenggahzu dawn nawn lo ding a, zu pen a dawn mite aa dingin kha mahmah ding hi.
Buai-na khuapi kisia cimsukin, kuamah a lut theih loh nadingin inn khempeuh kikhakcip hi.
Kongzing lakah leenggahzu duhin a awngawng om a, nopsakna khempeuh mialcip-in, gam sunga lungnopna bei ta hi.
Khuapi sungah hawmsuahna bek om a, suksiatna in kulhkongpi satzan hi.
Tua ciangin leitunga mite lakah hi bangin hong piang ding a, olive kung kilok tawh kibangin, leenggah a lawh hun khit cianga leenggah sangh kaikhop tawh kibang ding hi.
Amaute in a aw uh ngaihsakin, Yahweh’ thupitna la sak ding uh a, tuipi panin amaute nakpi-in a kiko ding uh hi.
Hih bang thu hangin meite sungah Yahweh minthangsak unla, tuipi tuikulhte ah Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh’ Min pahtawi un.

Leitung mongte panin, “Thumaan mite tungah minphatna om hen!” ci-in la a kisaknate i zakhin hi. Hih hangin keimah in, “Ka gawngtam hi, ka gawngtam hi, ka tungah dahna hong tung hi! A lehhek mi in lehhek hi! Hi taktak hi, a lehhek mite in nakpi-a lehhek gamtat uh hi,” ka ci hi.
Leitung-a tengte aw, note tungah lau-na leh dum, leh thangzak hong tung hi.

Hi bangin hong piang ding hi: Lau-huaina ging panin a tai mipa, dum sungah kia ding a, dum sung tawng panin a kahto mite thangzak ah awk ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh a sangna-a tawlette kihong a, leitung bulpite a kiliing hi.
Leitung khangkhamin, leitung siacip a, nakpi takin leitung a kiliing gawp hi.
Zu kham khat bangin leitung hoi dangdang ding a, buk khat bangin a awn ding hi. Leitunga thupalsatna pen leitung ah gik ding a, amah pukin, a thokik nawn kei ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin hih bangin piang ding hi: Yahweh in a sanga om a lian honpite leh leitunga om leitung kumpite a dantat ding hi.
Dum sungah thongkiate a kikholkhop mah bangin amaute kikhoih khawm ding a, thong sungah kikalhcip ding hi; ni tampi khit ciangin amaute kivil ding hi.
Tungnungpen Yahweh in thupitna tawh dimin a tangmite mai panin Zion Mual leh Yerusalem ah uk ding ahih manin khapi kisuangin, ni a maizum ding hi.
Yahweh aw, ka Pa na hi hi. Nang kong liansak ding a, Na Min ka phat ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah in a lamdang nate na sem a, tanglaipek-a na geelsate muantakin thu man hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah in khuapi kip khat na ninlomtang in na bawl a, khuapi muanhuai khat zong na siacimsak hi; gamdang mite’ kumpi-inn omna zong khuapi hi nawn lo a, cikmah-in zong kilamkik nawn lo ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi thahatte in Nang hong pahtawi ding a, a lipkhaphuai minamte’ khuapi in Nang hong zahtak ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh huihpi in kawm a nawkgawp bangin a lipkhaphuai mite a gamhtat uh ciangin mizawngte aa dingin thahatna na hi a, micimmawhte aa dingin a lungkham hun ah thahatna, huihpi panin bukna, nisa panin niliim na hi hi.
Mun keu-a nisa bangin gamdangte’ gamlumna na daisak a, nisa pen meii liim tawh na votsak mah bangin a kihtak-huai mite’ hiang na niamkhiat ding hi.
Hih mual tungah Tungnungpen Yahweh in mi khempeuh aa dingin an lim pawi; leenggahzu gei pawi; guh-gek tawh a kidim nate, lim takin a kikhaih siang leenggahzu gei pawi a bawl ding hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuh tungah a kilawn khuhna leh minam khempeuh tunga a kizal tuamna teng Amah in a mual tungah susia ding hi.

Amah in gualzawhna tawh sihna valhtum ding a, Yahweh eite Pa in maitang khempeuh panin khituite nulkhia-in, Ama mite’ kizahkona leitung khempeuh panin lakhia ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in genkhin zo hi.

Tua ni ciangin hi bangin kici ding hi: En un, Amah eite Pa ahi hi! Amah i ngakngak a, Amah in eite hong hon ding hi! Hih in Yahweh hi a, i ngakngak Amah ahi hi! Ama hotkhiatna sungah eite lungdam-kipaakin nuam i sa ding hi!
Bang hang hiam cihleh hih mual tungah Yahweh’ khut tawlnga ding a, nindum sungah buhtu a tuatcil bangin Ama nuai-ah Moab kituancil ding hi.
Tuipeekin a khut a zankhia mi khat bangin Amah in amaute laizangah a khutte zankhia ding a, amau kiphatsakna teng, a khut-in a laksa teng uh tawh a niamkhiat khawm ding hi.
Amah in note’ kulh a sang na galpanna muanhuaite uh susia-in niamkhiat ding a, leilak, leivui lakah a koih ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin Yahdah gam sungah hih la kisa ding hi: Eite in khuapi muanhuai khat i nei hi. Yahweh in kulh leh kanh dingin hotkhiatna a bawl hi.
Thu man a zui, mite laka a thumaan minamte a lut theih nadingin kongpite hong un.
Amah in Nang hong muang ahih manin Nang tunga lungsim kip a nei mipa lungnopna kicing na pia ding hi.
Yahweh muang tawntung in; Bang hang hiam cihleh Pa Yahweh sunga tawntung thahatna sungpi om hi.
Amah in a sangna mun-a tengte niamkhiat a, khuapi sangpi a khiasuk hi. Amah in leilak dongah nga sukin, leivui lakah a koih hi.
Mizawngte khete leh mi cimawhte’ khekap, khe in tuancil ding hi.
Thutang mipa’ lampi tamkim a, Nangmah, Thutang Penpa in thutang mite’ lampi na neelsak hi.
Hi hi, Yahweh aw, Na thukhenna lampi ah Nang kong ngak uh a, kote lunggulhna in Nangma Min leh Nangmah phawk theihna ahi hi.

Zanin ka lungsim takpi tawh Nang kong lunggulh hi. Ka sunga ka kha tawh keimah in zingsangin Nang kong zong ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh leitung ah Na thukhennate a om ciangin leitunga a tengte in thumaanna thei pan ding uh hi.
Migilote tungah zong hehpihna a om hangin, amaute in thumaanna thei lo uh a, amaute in thutang mite’ gam sung nangawn ah siatna bawlbawl lai uh a, Yahweh’ thupitna a awlmawh kei uh hi.

Yahweh aw, a sang ah na khut kilaamto a, ahih hangin amaute in mu lo uh hi. Na mite aa dingin na deihluatna mu uh henla, amaute maizum thuak uh hen! Hi hi, na galte aa dingin a kisiit meikuang in amaute netum tahen!
Yahweh aw, kote aa dingin suahtakna hong sehsak in; bang hang hiam cihleh ka sep khempeuh zong ko aa dingin Nangma sepsa ahi hi.
Yahweh kote Pa aw, Nangmah bek in kote nong uk ding kimlai-in adonim; tote, pasiante, in kote hong uk zawsop uh a, ahi zongin Nangmah bek hangin Na Min ka lo ding uh hi.

Tote leh sianmangte (adonim leh elohim) si uh a, amaute nungta nawn lo ding uh hi. Amaute si uh a, a thokik nawn kei ding uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Nangmah in amaute en-in, na susia khin a, amaute a kiphawkna khempeuh na beisak hi.
Minam na pungsak hi, Yahweh aw, minam na pungsak hi; Nang hong kipahtawi a, Nangmah in leitung mongte khempeuh dong a gamgite na khan hi.
Yahweh aw, lungkham hun ciangin amaute in nang hong zuan uh a, na taii ciangin amaute in thungetna hong sungkhia uh hi.
A suah hun a naita naupaii numei in na sa-in, a natna hangin a kiko khiat bangin, Yahweh aw, nangma muhna ah kote zong tua mah bang ka hi uh hi.

Ko zong nau ka paii uh a, na ka sa uh hi. Ahih hangin a om bang khatin kote in huih bek ka hingkhia uh hi. Kote in leitung ah hotkhiatna khatpeuh zong ka piangkhiasak kei uh a, leitunga tengte zong a puk kei hi.

Na misite nungta ding a, a sisa pumpite tho ding hi. No leivui sunga tengte aw, khanglo unla, lasa un; bang hang hiam cihleh na daitui uh zing daitui tawh kibang a, leitung in misite suahkhia ding hi.
Hong pai un, ka mite aw, munsiangtho ah lut un; na kiimkot-a na kongkhakte uh kong khaksak ding a, thangpaihna a bei khit mateng tomno sung kong seel ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh en un, leitung-a tengte amau mawhna hangin dan a pia dingin Ama omna panin Yahweh hong paikhia a, leitung in zong a sisan kilangtelsak ding a, ama tunga a kithatte zong sincip nawn lo ding hi.

Tua ni ciangin Yahweh in a hehna khiam het loin a lian a khauh vangliatna tawh gulpi’ pawlte’ kamsangte vatmang ding hi. Amah in a thukpi sunga om tua sapi ahi gulpi, hih a lampial ama nasemte sihna dan a pia ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin, “Leenggahzu san leenggui huan khat,” ci-in amah lasak un.
Keimah Yahweh in ka kem a, a hunhunin tui ka buak den hi. Tua ahih ciangin kuamah in a siatsak loh nadingin zan leh sunin ka kem hi.
Hehna Ka sungah a om kei hi. Gal sungah kua in lingkungte leh thangling kungte hong siah ding ahi hiam? Tuate nawkin ka pai ding a, amaute ka haltum khawm ding hi.
Tua bang ahih keileh Kei tawh kilemna a bawl theih nadingun Ka thahatna hong bel uh henla, tua ciangin Kei tawh kilem bawl ding uh hi.
Amah in Yaaqob sung panin hong paite zungkhasak ding a, Israyl ngumin pak ding a, a gah tawh leitung maitang teng dimsak ding hi.
Israyl a sat mite a sat bangin Amah in Israyl satkhin ahi hiam? Israyl mite amau a thatte bangin kithat ngei ahi hiam?
Canaan panin notkhiatna leh saltanna tawh a hih zah ciangin Nangmah in amaute na langdo hi. Nisuahna lam huih a nun lai-a bangin Amah huih khauh tawh a notkhia hi.

Amah in pasiante tunga biaknatau suangte khempeuh suangkang satvui a batsak ciangin Asherim leh ni biakna-milimte a ding lai om nawn lo hi; hih thu hangin Yaaqob’ khialhna kisiangsak ding a, a mawhna a kipaihsakna gah taktak ahi ding hi.
Ahih hangin a muanhuai khuapi a hawmsuah ding a, gamlak bangin a sunga tengte in taisan-in nusia ding hi. Tua lai-ah bawngno gamta ding a, tua lai mah ah giakin, a hiangte a hawkmai ding uh hi.

A hiang mengte a keu ciangin kitan hi. Numeite pai-in singin a cih uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh hih in khentel theihna nei lo mite ahi uh hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute a bawlpa in amaute tungah hehpihna nei lo ding a, amaute a piangsakpa in amaute tungah maipha a lak kei ding hi.
No Israyl mite aw, tua ni ciangin hih bangin piang ding hi: Euphrates Gun luanglai panin Egypt Luipi dongin Yahweh in a buhte cilkhia ding a, note khat khatin hong kaikhawm ding hi.

Tua ni ciangin hih bangin piang ding hi: peengkul lianpi khat hong ging ding a, Assyria gam sunga thahlup dinga a baihsa-a omte pen Egypt gam sunga a kinot mite tawh pai-in, Yerusalem-a mual siangtho ah Yahweh a bia ding uh hi.
Ephraim zukhamte’ kiphatsakna lukhum tungah gimna tung hen; a minthang ama mel hoihna pen pak vul kuan khat hi a, a lu tunga pakkual kikoih leenggahzu zawhsa mite ahi uh hi.
En un, Yahweh’ hehna pen a kauhpai, a lipkhaphuai na hi a, huihpi gialpi leh khauh takin a luang a thahat tuikhang bangin a susia huihkhauhpi bangin tua pen Ama khut tawh leitung a paisuk ding hi.

Kua tungah Amah in thutheihna hilh ding ahi hiam? Kua tungah Amah in upna guipi theitelsak ding ahi hiam? Ang sung panin kilakhia, nawizu tawh a kikhen tung naungekte tung ahi hi!

Bang hang hiam cihleh khe khuan nadingin lupna tom lua a, silh dingin puanza neu lua hi.

Tua ahih ciangin tu-in mi zahpihte hi nawn kei un; tua bang hi keileh note hong kihihna kitosak ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh suksiatna ding thukip leitung buppi ah a kikhensat khitna, Tungnungpen i Pa Yahweh kiang panin ka za khin hi.
Na bil hong ngat unla, ka aw za un; ngai unla, ka thugen za un.
Lo khopa in khaici vawh nadingin lo kho niloh ahi hiam? Amah in lei a maitamsak khit ciangin khokho lai ahi hiam?

Bang hang hiam cih leh ama Pa in khentel theihna hilhin, amah a sinsak hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh caraway pen buhcilna tawh kicil lo a, cumin tungah zong leengpei kigawisak lo hi; ahih hangin caraway pen ciang tawh kisatkhia a, cumin pen molhtum tawh kisat hi.

Hih zong Tungnungpen Yahweh kiang panin hong pai mah hi a, Amah pen a thulamlahna ah lamdang a, nasepna ah pil mahmah hi.
David’ tenna khuapi Ariyl, Ariyl tungah gimna tung hi! Kum khat tungah kum khat gawm unla, Kum siangtho kipat panin kum siangtho tawp dongin Pawite bawl toto un.
Tua hi napi-in Ariyl ka lunggimsak ding a, thuumna leh tauna om ding hi; tua khuapi pen Kei aa ding Ariyl bang ding hi.
Keimah in na kiimkot khempeuh ah giahphual ka satin, tausang tawh nang kong umcih ding a, na langah umcihna ka bawl ding hi.

Ariyl a do minamte khempeuh a honpite, amah leh a mun muanhuai do-in, amah a lunggimsakte pen mangmatna leh zan huna mangmuhna tawh kibang ding uh hi.

Gilkial mipa in a mangin an ne a, a khanlawh ciangin a gil a vah tuan loh tawh kibang ding a, ahih keileh dangtak mi khat in a mangin tui dawn a, a khanlawh ciangin zawmin, a dangtak a kap tuan loh tawh kibang ding hi. Zion Mual a do minamte khempeuh a mihonpite tua mah tawh kibang ding uh hi.
Khawl unla, lamdangsa un! Kiko khia unla, kap un; amaute zukham hi uh a, ahih hangin leenggahzu kham ahi kei uh hi; amaute lung-am uh a, ahih hangin zu khauh hang ahi kei hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in, “Hih mite in ka kam uh tawh Kei lam hong nehin, a mukte uh tawh Kei hong pahtawi uh a, ahih hangin a lungsim uh Kei tawh kigamla-in, amaute hong zahtakna pen mihingte’ thukhun kihilhna hang ahi lel hi.

4 Tua ahih ciangin en un, hih mite lakah a lamdang leh tum lamdang a lamdang nasep ka sem ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh a mipilte’ uh pilna pen beimang ding a, a thutheite’ thutheihna pen kiseel ding hi,” a ci hi.

A kilehbulh-in na hei gawp nate uh, beel bawlpa’ tungman bangin kingaihsun ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh nasepna in amah a bawlpa’ thu genin, ‘Amah in kei hong bawl lo hi,’ ci ding ahi hiam? A kipiangsak na in ama piangsakpa thu genin, ‘Ama’n thutheihna nei kei,’ ci ding ahi hiam?
Lebanon pen singno lo hoih suah ding, singno lo hoih pen gammang tulak bangin a kitawisang ding hun tomno sung bek hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ni ciangin bengngongte in Laibu sunga thute za ding uh a, lungzinna leh khuamialna sung panin mittawte in mu ding uh hi.
Lung niamkhiat mite Yahweh sungah a lungdamna uh khang semsem ding a, mite laka a zawngte pen Israyl’ Siangtho Pa sungah lungdam kipak ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh a lauhuai mi a mawknapi kisuaksak ding a, mi zahpihte kibeitumsak ding a, siatna bawl ding a sawmte khempeuh kisusia ding hi—
tua mite pen kam pauna tawh a khialh nadingun mi a bawlte, kulhkongpi ah mi a thuhilhpa thang a siahte, thutang mi pen a man lo teci tawh a heikhia mite ahi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Abraham a tankhiapa Yahweh in Yaaqob innkuan tawh kisai-in hih bangin ci hi: Tu-in Yaaqob kimaizumsak nawn lo ding a, Keimah kihei-in ka beimangsak kei ding hi.

a zuau tate ahi hih a lehdo mite pen Yahweh’ Thukham a ngai nuam lo dingte ahi uh hi.

Lampi panin paikhia unla, zawi panin pialkhia un; kote omna panin Israyl’ Siangthopa khawlsak un!” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israyl’ Siangtho Pa in hih bangin ci hi: Note in hih thu simmawhin, zawhthawhna leh uangtatna suangin, tuate tungah kinga na hih manun,
