Yahweh kitawisang hi; bang hang hiam cihleh a sangna ah amah teng hi. Amah in thumaan leh thutang tawh Zion kidimsak hi.
Pilna leh thutheihna pen nangma hunte a kipna leh na hotkhiatna tha hi ding a, Yahweh zahtakna pen Ama van manpha ahi hi.
En dih un, a mi thahatte uh a pualam ah kap ding uh a, kilemna sem palaite nakpi-in a kap ding uh hi.
Lam lianpite bu-mang a, khualzin mi khawl ta hi. Amah in thuciamna palsat a, khuapite a simmawh khin a, amah in kuamah zahtak lo hi.
Leitung thuumin zawm ta a, Lebanon vul mangta a, Sharon lah sehnel-gam bangin, Bashan leh Carmel in a singtehte singkhia hi.
Yahweh in ci hi: tu-in ka tho ding hi! Tu-in ka kitawisang ding a, tu-in ka kilamto ding hi!
Buhvai na pai ding uh a, buhkung na suakkhia ding uh hi; na husanna un mei bangin hong kangtum ding hi.
Leikang kuang tawh na mite kibang ding a, lingkung sattan bangin amaute mei sungah kihal ding hi.
Bang sem ka hi hiam? cih thu, gamlapi-a om note in za un. A nai-a om note in Ka vangliatna thei un.

Zion-a mi mawhte lau uh a, dipkuatna in mi hoih kineihkhemte lauthawngsak hi. Eite lakah kua pen a kangtum meikuang tawh teng khawm ding ahi hiam? Eite lakah kua pen tawntung meikuang tawh teng ding ahi hiam?

Thumaan takin a kalsuan, thutang takin a pau kua ahi hiam? Mi kinengniamte tung pana ngahna a deih lo, sumgolh la nuam loin a khut a sing, sisan suahte’ genna za nuam loin a bil a hum, siatna a muh loh nadingin a mit a si mipa ahi hi!
A sangnate ah amah teng ding a, ama bukna mun pen mun kip muanhuai suangtumte hi ding hi; an kipia ding a, a tui dawnte ciim ding hi.
A mel hoihna tawh Kumpipa na mitte in mu ding a, gamlapi-a gam amaute in mu ding uh hi.

Na lungsim uh ah ni danga na kihtakte uh na ngaihsun ding uh a, “Tua kamtaipa koi-ah om ahi hiam? Vangik a pua kamtaipa koi-ah om ahi hiam? Mun sangnate-a tua kamtaipa koi-ah om ahi hiam?” na ci ding uh hi.
A kitel thei lo, gamdang mite’ pau bangin a pau, tel theih loh kammal tawh a pau tua mite, tua a gilo mite na mu nawn kei ding uh hi.

A kisehsa Pawite i bawlna khuapi Zion en unla, a kihemkhia lo ding Inn khat, daitakin a kitenna Yerusalem na mitte un mu ding hi; a khetphimte khat zong kikhin nei lo ding a, a khaute khat beek zong a tat ngei kei ding hi.
Yahweh eite Vantung Pa om ding hi. Tua mun pen eite aa dingin gun zaipite leh tuite omna mun hi ding hi. Tuate tungah gun kuang kihot lo ding a, tembaw hatte zong pai lo ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh pen i Thukhenpa, Yahweh pen Thukhuampiapa, Yahweh in i Kumpipa ahi hi. Amah in eite hong hon ding hi!

Na tembaw khaute uh kol a, amaute in a tembaw mungpi kipsak thei lo a, amaute in a puankhaite zal thei lo uh hi. Tua ciangin galvanlak tampi kihwm ding a, khebaite nangawn in vanlak a puakhia ding hi.
Tua ciang i gama tengte kuamah in, “Ka cina,” ci lo ding uh a, a sunga a teng mite a mawhna uh kimaisak ding hi.
No minamte aw, hong nai un; no mite aw, ngai un! Leitung leh a sunga om khempeuh, leipi leh a tung pana a piangkhiate khempeuh in za tahen!
Bang hang hiam cihleh minam khempeuh tungah Yahweh thangpai a, a galkapte khempeuh tungah heh mahmah hi. Amah in amaute susia kiuhkeuh khin a, a thatlumte tungah amaute pia khin ta hi.
A kithat amau mite kilawnkhia ding a, a siluanghawmte uih semsem-in, mual liante amau sisan tawh tuisuak khawm ding hi.

Vantunga a honpite khempeuh tuisuak ding a, laizial khat bangin vantungte a kizial khawm ding hi; leenggui tung panin a teh a kiat khiat bang leh thei kung panin a gah a kiat khiat bangin amau sunga a honpite khempeuh kia mang ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh vantung ah Ka namsau kisilsiang ding hi; en un, Edom mite tung leh Ka samsiat mite tungah thukhen dingin paisuk ding hi.

Yahweh’ namsau sisan tawh kidim a, a thau tawh, tuunote leh keelte’ sisan tawh, tuutalte’ kal pana a thau tawh kizolsak ding hi. Yahweh tungah Bozrah kipiakhin taktak a, kithahna lianpi khatin Edom gam a kipia hi.
Gam bawngtalte amau tawh puk khawm ding a, bawngtal khanglaite pen bawngtal thahatte tawh puk ding hi; a leitang uh sisan tawh kidiah ding a, a leivui uh a thau tawh a kawtkim ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh tua pen Yahweh’ thuhkikna ni hi a, Zion mawhsaknate a thuhsak kum ahi hi.
A luite uh kultal tui suak ding a, a leivuite uh kaat suak ding hi; a gam uh a kuanglai kultal suak ding hi.
Tua pen zan ahi a, sun ahi zongin mit lo ding a, a khu kahto ngitnget ding hi. A khang khangin sia ngitnget ding a, kuamah in a tawntungin nawk nawn lo ding hi.
Ahih hangin mu leh sakuh in luah ding uh a, keising leh va-ak teng ding uh hi. Tua ciangin Amah in tua tungah buai gawpna khau leh hawmsuahna suangtumte a khai ding hi.
Amaute in kumpigam aa dingin a mi thupite sam ding uh a, ahih hangin kuamah om lo ding a, a uliante khempeuh uh a bangmah lo ahi ding uh hi.
A kumpi-innte ah lingkungte po ding a, laho kung leh thangling kungte a po ding hi. Tua mun pen ngiate tenna mun leh simbute inntual suak ding hi.
Sehnelgam gamsate zong tuikulh gamsate tawh kimu ding uh a, keeldawi in a lawmte sam ding hi. A awngiah simbu zong tua lai-ah tawlnga ding a, ama aa dingin tawlngakna mun a zong ding hi.
Tua lai-ah simbupi in a bu tomin tui ding a, keuhsakin a note a kha liim nuai-ah a kem ding hi. Tua lai-ah musite zong a kopkopin omkhawm ding uh hi.

Yahweh’ Laibu sungah zong unla, sim un. Hihte khat beek zong a kidon loin om lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh “Yahweh pen amaute tuu banga a cingpa hi a, bangmah a kisam kei ding uh hi,” ci-in kigelh hi; Ama kam in tua thu gen khin ahih manin, Ama Kha in amaute kaikhawm ding hi.
Amah in amau aa dingin a tanh uh sehsak khin a, Ama khut in amaute lakah tehna khau tawh a hawmsak khin hi. Amaute in luah tawntung ding uh a, a khang a khangin tua lai-ah amaute teng ding uh hi.
Gamlak leh gamgawtak amaute hangin kipaak ding a, sehnelgam nuamin, lingpak bangin a palhkhia ding hi.

Palhpha mahmah ding a, lungnopna leh lasakna tawh lungdam ding hi. Lebanon’ minthanna, Carmel leh Sharon-te’ hoihna ama tungah kipia ding hi. Amaute in Yahweh’ minthanna, i Pa’ thupit mahmahna mu ding uh hi.
A thazawm khutte khauhsak unla, a zaw khete kipsak un.
A lungsim lauthawng mite tungah, “Thakhauh unla, lau kei un! En un, na Pa uh thuhkikna tawh hong pai ding a, thaman tawh eite Pa hong pai ding hi; Amah hong pai-in note hong hon ding hi!” ci un.
Tua ciangin mittawte’ mit kihonsak ding a, bengngongte’ bil kivaksak ding hi.
Tua ciangin khebate pen sazuk bangin diang ding uh a, a pau thei lote’ leii in lasa ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh gamlak ah tuite phulkhia-in sehnel gam ah luituite a luang ding hi.
Tua ciangin a sa mahmah sehnelte bualtui suak ding a, keugaw gam pen ciktui nakte a zuak ding hi. Ngiate’ lup ngeina, a tenna uh ah pumpeng leh mau tawh lopa a po ding hi.

Tua lai-ah lam lianpi khat om ding a, Sianthona Lampi kici ding hi. A siang lote in tua tung tawn lo ding a, ahih hangintua pen tua lampi a tawn mite aa ding ahi hi; hi hi, mihaite in zong lam a khial kei ding uh hi.
Tua lai-ah humpinelkai om lo ding a, tua tungah sasialne ganhing khatpeuh zong a pai kei ding hi. Tua lai-ah amaute kimukha lo ding a, ahih hangin tatsate in tua lai tawn ding hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh’ tatsa mite hong ciahkikin, a lu tung uh ah tawntung lungnopna khu-in lasakna tawh Zion tung ding uh hi. Amaute in lungnopna leh kipaakna ngah ding uh a, dahna leh khuisatna a beimang ding hi.
Tu-in Hezekyah Kumpipa uk zawh kum sawm le kum li kumin hih bangin hong piang hi; Assyria kumpi Sennacherib in Yahdah gam sunga khuapi muanhuai khempeuh do-in a la hi.

Tua ciangin Lachish panin Yerusalem-a Hezekyah kiang a pai dingin Assyria kumpipa in galkap honpi khat tawh Rabshakeh; galkap mang lianpa, a sawl hi. Puansawppa’ Lo zuatna lam lianpi gei-a bual tungnung tuinak kiangah amah a ding hi.
Tua ciangin hih uliante ama kiangah a pai hi: Hilkiyah’ tapa kumpipa’ inn a uk Elyakim, lai-at Shebanyah leh Asaph’ tapa thuciamteh Yahach ahi hi.
Rabshakeh in amaute kiangah, “Hezekyah kaingah hih thu puak un: ‘A lian kumpi Assyria kumpipa in hih bangin ci hi: Hih na kimuanna uh bang bulphuh na hi hiam?
Galsim na dingin geelsiamna leh thahatna ka nei uh hi, na ci uh hi; ahih hangin tuate kammal hawmpi hi lel hi! Kei nong lehdo nadingun tu-in kua muang na hi uh hiam?

En un, a kingam peuhpeuh’ khut a sun pumpeng ciangkhut kitam ahi lel Egypt na belh uh ahih leh, ama’n hong liamsak lel ding hi! Ama sungah bukna a la mi khempeuh tungah Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh pen tua bang ahi hi!

Note in kei kiangah, ‘Yahweh ka Pa uh ka muang uh hi,’ ci-a kinei na hih uh leh Ama mun sangte leh biaknataute Hezekyah in lakhiatsakin, Yahdah leh Yerusalem tungah, ‘Hih biaknatau mai Yerusalem bek ah na bia ding uh hi,’ a cih Pa hi lo ahi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in Assyria kumpipa ka ukpa uh tawh thukimna bawl un. A tunga tuang ding na ngah nak uh leh, sakol tul nih kong pia ding hi.
Sakol leengte leh sakol leeng hawlte hangin Egypt muangin ka ukpa’ uliante laka a neupen galkap bu khat nangawn bangci not zo ding na hi uh hiam?

Yahweh kiang panin thu ngah loin hih mun a do ding leh a susia dingin kei hong paito sa na hi uh hiam? Yahweh in keima kiangah, ‘Pai to inla, hih gam do-in susia in,’ hong ci hi,’ ci-in gen un,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Hilkiyah’ tapa Elyakim, Shebanyah leh Yahach in Rabshakeh kiangah, “Kote in thei ka hih manun na nasemte tungah Aramaic pau tawh hong gen in; ahih hangin kulh tunga om mite zakna ah Hebrew pau-in nong gen loh nadingin kong thuum uh hi,” a ci uh hi.

Ahih hangin Rabshakeh; galkap mangpa, in, “Ka ukpa in hih thute na ukpa tung bek ah hong gensak hi loin, kulh tunga tu mite, note mah bangin note tawh a ek ciat uh ne-in a zun ciat uh a dawn ding mite tungah zong hong gensak hilo ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Rabshakeh dingto-in, Yahdah mite’ pau-in nakpi-in kiko a, “Assyria kumpipa, a lian kumpipa’ kammal za un!
Kumpipa in hih bangin ci hi: Hezekyah kikhemsak kha kei un! Amah in ka khut panin note hong hon zolo ding hi!
Hezekyah in note tungah, ‘Yahweh in eite hong hon taktak ding a, Assyria kumpipa khut sungah hih khuapi kipia lo ding hi,’ ci-in Yahweh na muan nadingun kizolsak kei un.

-17 Hezekyah thu ngai kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh kumpipa in hih bangin ci hi: Letsong pia-in kei tawh kilemna hong bawl unla, kei kiangah hong pusuak un! Kei hong pai-in, nomau leitang mah tawh a kibang leitang, buh leh leenggui lo, an leh leenggui huan leitang ah note kong paipih ni mateng mi khempeuh in ama leenggui pan leh ama theikung panin ne ding uh a, nomau tuikhuk ciat panin tui na dawn ding uh hi.

Ahih zongin kidawm un; tua bang hi keileh Hezekyah in note hong delhin, ‘Yahweh in eite hong hon ding hi,’ hong ci kha ding hi. Assyria kumpipa’ khut sung panin minam khatpeuh’ pasian (el) in a gam honkhia ngei ahi hiam?
Hamath leh Arphad-te’ pasiante koi-ah om hiam? Sepharvaim mite’ pasiante koi-ah om ahi hiam? Amaute in ka khut sung panin Samaria honkhia ngei ahi hiam?
Hih gamte pasiante khempeuh panin kua in ka khut sung panin amamu gam hon thei ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin kei khut panin Yahweh in Yerusalem bangci hut zo ding ahi hiam?’ ci hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin mite dai takin omin, kam khat beek zong dawngkik lo uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kumpipa in, ‘Amah dawng kei un,’ ci-in thupia khin hi.

Tua ciangin Hilkiyah’ tapa kumpi innsung ukpa Elyakim, lai-at Shebanyah leh Asaph’ tapa thuciamteh Yahach-te Hezekyah kiangah puan balkeksa-in kilehkik uh a, tua Rabshakeh; galkap mangpa, thugente ama kiangah a ko uh hi.
Hezekyah kumpipa in hih thupuak a zak ciangin hih bangin hong piang hi; amah in a puante balkek a, puanhampi tawh kitunin, Yahweh’ Inn sungah a pai hi.
Tua ciangin amah in kumpi inn ukpa Elyakim, lai-at Shebanyah leh upate—puanhampi a silh kim siampite Amoz’ tapa kamsang Isayah kiangah a sawl hi.
Amaute in ama kiangah, “Hezekyah in hih bangin ci hi: Tuni pen lungkham ni, tai ngah ni leh mindai ni ahi hi; naungek a suah hun tung napi-in a hingkhiat nading tha a nei lo tawh i kibang hi.

Assyria kumpipa a ukpa in a Nungta Pa ko dingin a sawl Rabshakeh; galkap mangpa, kammalte khempeuh za henla, Yahweh in a zaksa kammalte hangin tai hen. Tua ahih ciangin a omlai sunsunte aa dingin thungen in,’ ci hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Isayah kiangah hih thu tawh Hezekyah Kumpipa’ uliante a tung uh hi.
Isayah in amaute kiangah, “Hih bangin na ukpa tungah na gen ding uh hi: Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Na zaksa kammalte, Assyria kumpipa’ nasempa in Kei hong mindaisakna kammalte hangin lau kei un.
En un, amah in a man lo thu khat za-in, ama gam ah a ciahkik nadingin lungsim ka guan ding hi. Tua ciangin ama gam sung mah ah namsau tawh ka sattuk sak ding hi, ci hi,’ ci un,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in Lachish a nusiat khitna thu za ahih manin, Rabshakeh ciahkik a, Assyria kumpipa in Libnah khua a dona a mu hi.
Tu-in Ethiopia kumpipa Tirhakah in amah do dingin kuan hi, ci-in a man lo thu khat Sennacherib in a za hi. Amah in hih thu a zak ciangin Hezekyah kiangah kamtaite sawlin,
“Yahdah kumpi Hezekyah kiangah gen in: Assyria kumpipa khut sungah Yerusalem kipia lo ding hi,’ cihna tawh na muan pasian (el) kikhem sam kei in.
En in, amaute khempeuh susia kiuhkeuhin gam khempeuh tunga Assyria kumpipa’ hihna thu na zakhin hi! Tua hi a, nang hong kihon ding ahi hiam?
Ka pu ka pate susiat Gozan-te, Haran-te, Rezeph-te leh Tel Assar gam sunga Eden mite pasiante (elohim), tua minamte pasiante in amaute hon ngei ahi hiam?
Hamath kumpipa, Arpad kumpipa, Sepharvaim, Hena leh Ivvah mite khuapi-a kumpipa koi-ah om ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Hezekyah in kamtaite khut panin hih laikhak ngahin a sim hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh’ Inn ah Hezekyah paito-in Yahweh mai-ah a zalkhia hi.
Hezekyah in a Pa Yahweh kiangah thu ngen a,
“Cherub-te kikala a teng Israyl Pa, tungnungpen Yahweh aw, leitung kumpigam khempeuh lakah nangmah bek Pa na hi hi. Nangmah in vantungte leh leitung na bawlkhin hi.
Yahweh aw, na bil hong ngat inla hong za in. Yahweh aw, na mit hong inla hong mu in. Sennacherib in a Nungta Pa a zahkona kammalte ngai in.
Yahweh aw, Assyria kumpite in minamte leh a gamte a suksiatna thu a man hi a,
a pasiante (elohim) uh mei sungah paai-in a susia uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tuate lakah a Vanglian khat beek omlo a—tuate pen mihingte’ khuta bawlsa sing leh suang ahi lel hi.
ua ahih ciangin Yahweh kote Pa aw, kong thuum hi, ama khut panin kote hong hon in, tua hileh leitung kumpigam khempeuh in nang, nangmah bek Vanglian Pa na hihna hong thei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Amoz’ tapa Isayah in Hezekyah kiangah hih thu puak a, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Assyria kumpipa Senacherib tawh kisai-a na thungetna ka zakhin hi.
Hih in amah tawh kisai-in a kigen Yahweh’ kammal ahi hi: Yerusalem’ tanu, nungak in nang hong simmawhin hong zahpih hi. Yerusalem’ tanu in a lu hong peisan hi!
Kua zahko-in kua simmawh na hi hiam? Kua langpanin na aw sangsakin, kiphatsakna tawh na mit liik na hi hiam? Israyl-te’ Siangthopa hi!

Na kamtaite tungtawnin nangmah in Yahweh na zahko a, ‘Ka sakolleeng honpite tawh mual sangte tungah ka kahto a, Lebanon mualte dong ka tung hi. Taamtak sangpente leh taaksan hoihpente ka phuk ding hi. Gam sung tawngnung pen te dong ka lut ding a, a taam hoihpente dong ka pai ding hi.
Tuikhukte ka tokhin a, tui ka dawnkhin hi. Ka khepeek tawh a ki-umcih munte-a gunte khempeuh ka keusakkhin hi,’ na ci hi.

Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Hihte sawt pek lai-a ka sehsa a hih lam za ngei lo na hi hiam? Tanglai hunte-a kipanin tuate ka geelsa hilo ahi hiam? Kulh-a ki-um khuapite a susia-in a kisia lomtang a suaksak dingpa na hih nadingin tu-in ka tungsaksa ahi hi!

Tua ahih ciangin amau mite hatna teng kihupkangin, amaute patau-in lungbuai uh hi. Amaute pen lo sunga singnote, lo ngekte, innkumzanga lopate tawh kibang uh a—a khankhit ma-in a keu buh tawh kibang uh hi.
Ahih hangin keimah in na omna mun, na ciah na kuan ciang leh Kei tunga na hehna uh ka thei hi!

Kei tunga na hehluatna hang leh na kiphatsak luatna in ka bilte hong batkhitna hangin Keimah in na nak ah Ka sikkawi ka bulh ding a, na kam ah Ka kamkaih vawhin, nong kuanna lam mah ah kong kilehsakkik ding hi,’ a ci hi.

Hezekyah aw, hih pen nang aa dingin lim hi ding hi: ‘Tu kumin ama thu-a a potawmte na ne ding a, a kum nihna ciangin tuate pana a selkhiate na ne ding hi. Ahih hangin a kum thumna ciangin khai tuhin atin, leengguite suanin a gah ne in.
Tua ciangin Yahdah innkuan a suakta a omlai sunte in a nuailam ah zungkha kik ding uh a, a tunglam ah a gah ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yerusalem panin a omlai sunte leh Zion Mual panin a suaktate hong pai ding uh hi. Vanglianpen Yahweh’ deihluatna in hih thu hong sem ding hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Assyria kumpipa tawh kisai-in Yahweh genna hi bang ahi hi: ‘Hih khuapi sungah amah lut lo ding a, hih lai-ah thaltang khat zong lawn kha lo ding hi. Khuapi mai-ah lum tawh zong amah kuan lo ding a, umcihna phuung zong a ciang kei ding hi.
Ama hong kuanna lampi tawnin amah ciahkik ding hi. Hih khuapi ah amah lut lo ding hi, Yahweh in ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Ka nasempa David leh Keimah ka kikhualna-in hih khuapi hu-in hih khuapi ka dal ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Assyria mite giahphual ah Yahweh’ vantungmi lut a, mi 185,000 a that hi. Zingsang tuungin amaute a thawh uh ciangin hihte khempeuh misi luang bekbek a na hi hi!
Tua ahih ciangin Assyria kumpi Sennacherib in tua mun a taisan hi. Amah paikhia-in Nineveh ah ciahkikin tua lai-ah a om hi.

Tua ciangin hih bangin hong piang hi: amah in ama Pasian (El) Nisroch’ inn sungah a biakbiak laitakin a tapate ahi Adrammelech leh Sharezer in namsau tawh amah a sattuk hi. Armenia gam ah amaute tai-in suakta uh a, a tapa Esarhaddon in kumpi’ za a luah hi.

Tua hun lai-in Hezekyah a cina-in si dektakin a lum hi. Ama kiangah Amoz’ tapa kamsang Isayah pai-in ama kiangah, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Na innkuan vai ding hawm in. Nang na si ding a, na nungta kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a maitang kawm lam ngatin Yahweh tungah thungen a,

“Yahweh aw, kong thuum hi; Nangma mai-ah lungsim kicing takin thuman sungah ka kalsuanna leh Nangma mit ah a manin ka gamtatna tu-in hong phawk in,” a ci hi. Tua khit ciangin Hezekyah nakpi takin a kap hi.
Tua ciangin Isayah tungah Yahweh’ kammal hong tung a,
“Kilehkik inla, Hezekyah kiangah, ‘Na pa David’ Pa Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Na thungetna ka zakhin a, na khituite ka mukhin hi. En in, na nuntakna kum sawm le kum nga ka behlap ding hi.
Assyria kumpipa khut panin nang leh hih khuapi kong hon ding a, hih khuapi ka dal ding hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi.
Hih pen Yahweh in a gensa thu a sep nadingin Yahweh kiang pana nang aa dingin lim hi ding hi:
En in, Ahaz’ ni-nai tungah nitum kuan-a liim kal sawm a paisa pen ka nungkiksak kik ding hi,’ a ci hi. Tua ciangin Amah in Ahaz’ tehna kal tunga a paisa mun panin ni liim kal sawm a nungkiksak hi.
Hih pen a ci na-in a natna panin a damkik ciangin Yahdah kumpi Hezekyah’ laigelh ahi hi:
Keimah in, “Ka hat saan laitakin hankhuk kongkhakpite ah ka paisuk ding a, ka nuntak kum om laii teng khempeuh hong kisut hi,” ka ci hi.
Keimah in ka ci hi: A nungtate’ gam sunga om Yahweh, Yahweh ka mu kei ding hi; leitunga teng mite lakah mihing ka en nawn kei ding hi.

Ka nuntak hun hong kisattansak hi. Tuucingpa’ puanbuk bangin hoong kihepkhiatsak hi; siamganpa in a kikhaite a attan bangin Amah in ka nuntakna hong attanska hi; sun panin zan dong ka hun tawpna ah nong puak hi.
Zingsang dong ka ngaihsun a, Amah in humpinelkai khat bangin ka guh khempeuh hong balzan hi; sun panin zan dong ka hun tawpna nong puak hi.
Gun vapi ahih keileh phialphiah khat bangin kei ka ham a, vakhu bangin ka tau hi. A tunglam ka etetna-in ka mitte gim hi. Yahweh aw, kei hong kinengniam hi; kei hong huh in!

Bang gen thei nawn ding ka hi hiam? Bang hang hiam cihleh Amah in kei tungah hong genin Amah mah in hih thu sem khin hi. Lungsim natluatna hangin ka nuntak kumte khempeuh damtakin ka pai khiankhian ding hi.
Yahweh aw, hici bangin mihingte nungta a, ka kha nuntakna zong hihte tawh kidim hi; kei hong damsak kik tapeuh inla, kei hong nungtasak in.
En in, keima nopsak nadingin nakpitakin ka thuak hi; ahih hangin keimah nong itna hangin siatna dum sung panin kei nong honkhia a, ka mawhna khempeuh Na nunglam ah nong paihsak khin hi.
Hankhuk in Nang tungah lungdam hong kiko thei lo a, Sihna in nang hong phat thei lo hi. Dum sunga a tuaksuk mite in Nangma thu man lamen thei lo uh hi.
A nungtate! A nungtate!—Tuni-a keimah in kong phat bangin amaute in Nang hong phat ding uh hi! Pa in a tate kiangah Na thu man theisak ding hi.
Yahweh in kei hong hon ding hi! Tua ahih ciangin eite in i nuntak laiteng khausai tumgingte tawh Yahweh’ Inn sungah ka late i sa ding hi.
Isayah in, “Theinai lasak inla, tuate su-in meima tung tungah belhsak in; tua ciangin na dam ding hi,” a ci hi.
Hezekyah in zong, “Yahweh’ Inn ah ka paitoh nading liim bang ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Tua hun lai-in Baladan’ tapa Babylon kumpi Merodach-Baladan in Hezekyah a ci na-in a damkikna thu za ahih manin ama kiangah laikhak leh letsong a puaksak hi.

Hezekyah in amaute limtakin muakin, ama vankholna innte sunga om khempeuh a lak hi—ngun leh kham, paknamtui leh sathau manpha, a galvan koihna sunga om khempeuh leh, ama vankholna sunga om khempeuh a lak hi. Hezekyah in ama inn sung khempeuh-a ahi a, ama kumpigam sunga om khempeuh ahi zongin a lahloh bangmah om lo hi.

Tua ciangin Kumpi Hezekyah kiangah kamsang Isayah pai-in, “Hih mite in nang kiangah bang thu hong gen ahi hiam? Amaute koi pana hong pai ahi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Hezekyah in dawngin, “Amaute pen gamlapi gam, Babylon gam panin kei kianga hong pai uh ahi hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Isayah in, “Amaute in na inn sungah bang teng mu khin uh ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin Hezekyah in, “Ka inn sunga om khempeuh a mu khin uh hi. Ka vankholnate laka om, amaute ka lahloh khat beek a om kei hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Isayah in Hezekyah kiangah, “Tungnungpen Yahweh’ kammal za in:
En in, na inn sunga om khempeuh leh tuni ciang mahmah donga na pu na pate kholsa khempeuh Babylon gam ah a kipuakkhiat ding hunte hong tungta hi. Bangmah kisit lo ding hi, Yahweh in ci hi.
Amaute in nang sung pana suak, nangma tapate kimkhat puakhia ding uh a, Babylon kumpipa’ kumpi-inn ah cilgeh innsung mangte hi ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Hezekyah in Isayah kiangah, “Nangma nong genkhiat Yahweh’ kammal in dik hi,” a ci hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in, “A tawmpen bel ka nuntak sungin kilemna leh thu man om lai buang ding hi,” ci-in a ngaihsun hi.
Hehnem un, Ka mite hehnem un, note Pa in ci hi.
Dam takin Yerusalem hopih unla, ama dan thuakna hun a beina, ama mawhna a kimaisakna leh a mawhna khempeuh hangin Yahweh’ khut panin a zahnih-in a ngah khitna thu genkhia un.
Gamlak-a a kiko mipa awging in, “Yahweh’ lampi ding bawlkhol unla, i Pa aa dingin sehnel gam sungah lam lianpi khat a tangin bawl un.
Kuam thuk khempeuh kisangtosak ding a, mual liante khemepuh leh mual neute kiniam koih ding hi; a kawi-na munte kimamsak ding a, a phokna munte kizangtamsak ding hi.
Yahweh’ hotkhiatna hong kilaak ding a, mihing khempeuh in mu ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ kam in genzo hi,” a ci hi.
Awging in, “Kiko in,” ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Bang kiko ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi. Mi khempeuh lopa tawh kibang a, ama hoihnate khempeuh pen gamlaka paakte tawh kibang hi.
Yahweh’ kha in mut ahih manin lopa vulin, paak pulh hi; mihingte pen lopa hi taktak uh hi!
Lopa vulin, paak pulh hi; ahih hangin i Pa’ Thukham kip tawntung ding hi!

Lungdamna thu a puak Zion aw, mual sang tungah paito in. Lungdamna thu a puak Yerusalem aw, tha neihzah-in na aw uh sangsak in; sangsak inla, lau kei in! Yahdah khuapite kiangah, ‘Na Pa un en un!’ ci un.
En un, Pa Yahweh hong tung ding hi; thahatna tawh Amah hong pai-in, Ama aa dingin a ban in uk ding hi; en un, a thaman tawh hong pai a, Ama sepna a mai-ah om hi.
Amah in tuucing khat bangin a tuuhonte an pia ding a, tuunote a khut tawh kaikhawm-in, a ang sungah pom ding a, tano a neite dam takin paipih ding hi.
Kua in Ama khut kuak sungah tuite tehin, a khaap tawh vantungte teh a, tehna sung khat ah leitung leivui khempeuh guangin, pongkhaina tawh mual liante khai a, tawi tehna tawh mual neute teh ahi hiam?
Kua in Yahweh’ lungsim thei ding ahi hiam? Kua mi in Amah thuhilhna sinsak ding ahi hiam?
Amah in kua kuppih-in, hilhin, ahih keileh thutang lampi, thutheihna hilhin, ahih keileh a siangtho ngimna hangin a kikhentuam theih nadingin Thukham theihtelna lampi kua hilh ahi hiam?
En un, minamte pen phelkhai pana takkhia tuimal khat tawh kibang uh a, tawitehna tunga leivui neucik bangin kingaihsun lel hi; en un, Amah in tuikhulhte na themneng bang lelin a domto hi.
Lebanon pen meicih nadingin kicing zo lo a, meihal biakna dingin a gamsate zong kicing zo lo hi.
Minamte khempeuh Ama mai-ah bangmah hi lo a, bangmah ahi lo, a mawknapi sangin man nei lozaw-in a ngaihsun lel hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh tawh kua tehkak thei ding na hi hiam? Amah pen bang lim saikak thei ding na hi hiam?
Milim bawlpa in sungin, kham seekpa in tua pen kham tawh zut a, tua milim aa dingin ngun khainiangte a sunsak hi.
Tua bang biakna a bawl dingin a zawnglua mahmah mipa in a muat lo ding sing teel a, amah in a kipuk lo ding pasian khat a phuhsak nadingin khutsiam khat a zong hi.
Thei ngei lo na hi uh hiam? Za ngei lo na hi uh hiam? A patcil-a kipanin hong kigen ngei lo ahi hiam? Leitung kiphuh panin tel lo na hi uh hiam?
Leitung kuumpi tunglam-a a tupa Amah hi a, leitunga tengte pen kauphe tawh a kibang lel hi. Amah in paun bangin vantungte zalkhia-in, a sungah ten theihna ding puanbuk bangin tuate a zalkhia hi.
Amah in uliante bangmah lo suaksak a, Amah in leitung thukhente a mawknapi ahisak hi.

Hi hi, amaute pen a gina-in kisuan lo, a gina-in kivawh lo, amau’ kungte a gina-in lei sungah zung kha lo ding a, tua ciangin Amah in amaute muut-in, vul ding a, pingpei in ham bangin amaute lenkhiatpih ding hi.
Note in Kei tawh ka kikimpih dingin kua tawh hong teh thei ding na hi uh hiam? Siangtho Pa in ci hi.

A sang lam en to unla, hihte kua piansak hiam, a honpite a malmalin a suahkhia kua hiam en un. Amah in a vangliatna lianpi tawh a min-in tuate khempeuh sam a, Ama vangliatna tha hangin khat beek zong pelem lo hi.
Yaaqob aw, “Yahweh kiang panin ka lampi kiliah a, ka Pa kiang panin ka thuneihna kipaisan hi,” bang hangin ci a, Israyl aw, bang hangin tua ci pau na hi hiam?
Thei ngei lo na hi hiam? Za ngei lo na hi hiam? Yahweh, tawntung Pa, leitung mongte a Piangsakpa, amah gim loin zong tawl lo hi. Ama thu theihtelna muh zawh ding hi lo hi.
Amah in a gimte tha guan a, tha nei lo mite tungah Amah in thahatna a khangsak hi.
Khangnote nangawn gimin tawl ding uh a, khanglaite puk dipdep ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh a ngak mite in tha thak ngah ding uh a, muvanlai bangin kha tawh leengto ding uh hi; amaute tai-in tawl lo ding uh a, amaute pai-in gim lo ding uh hi.
Tuikulhte aw, Ka mai-ah daitakin om unla, mite a tha dimsak kik un! Amaute a nai-ah hong paisak unla, amaute thugensak un; thukhenna ah pai khawm ni.

Nisuahna lam panin thumaan khat lamto-in, a khephung dong ah sam-in, ama mai-a minamte amah pia-in, kumpite khengin a uk dingin a bawl kua ahi hiam? Ama namsau tunga leivui bang leh, ama thal-a huihmut buhkung leeng bang lelin amaute a bawl kua ahi hiam?
A khe tawh a sik ngei lohna lampi tawnin amaute delhin, bangmah ci loin a khengsuak kua ahi hiam?
A kipat cil-a kipanin a khangkhangin mite a sam, hih nasep semin a bawl kua ahi hiam? Keimah, Yahweh, a masa ka hi a, a tawpnate tawh ka om ding hi; Tuapa Keimah ka hi hi.
Tuikulh gamte in mu-in kihta uh a, leitung mongte a lau uh hi; amaute hong neh-in hong pai uh hi.
Mi khempeuh in a vengte ciat huh a, a sanggam ciat kiangah, “Nakpi-in hangsan un!” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin khutsiampa in kham sekpa hanthawn-in, sek tawh hoih takin a sekpa in a hampi a satpa hanthawn-in, “Zop theih hi ta hi,” a ci hi; tua ahih ciangin a kiliing loh nadingin amah in siktukilh tawh khen kip hi.
Ahih hangin nang Israyl, Ka lawm Abraham’ suan, kong teelsa Yaaqob aw, Ka nasem na hi hi.
Lei mongte panin kong la khin zo a, a gamlapen munte panin nang hong samin, nangma kiangah, “Ka nasem na hi a, nang hong lawnkhia loin nang kong teel khin hi,” kong cihpa na hi hi.

Nang hong ompih ka hih manin lau kei in; lungkia kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh nangma Pa ka hi hi. Kong thahatsak ding hi; hi hi; nang kong huh ding a, a thumaan Ka taklam khut tawh nang kong len gige ding hi.
En in, nang hong galbawl mite khempeuh maizum-in zahla ding uh hi; amaute bangmah lo suak ding uh a, nang hong dem mite mangthang ding uh hi.
Amaute na zon hangin na mu kei ding hi—nang hong dem mite, nang hong galbawlte bangmah hi het loin, na om lopi khat tawh a kibang ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh nangma kiangah, “Lau kei in; kong huh ding hi,” ci-in, Keimah, Yahweh nangma Pa, in na taklam khut kong len ding hi.
Nangmah lungno bang ahi lel Yaaqob, no Israyl mite aw, leu kei un! Kong huh ding hi, Yahweh note hong Tankhiapa, Israyl’ Siangtho Pa in ci hi.
En un, note pen a thak a hiam, ha tampi a nei buhcilna-in hong bawl ding a, note in mual liante cilin na satvui ding uh a, mual neute ansi na bangsak ding uh hi.
Amaute na haih ding uh a, huih in amaute lenkhia mangin, pingpei in thehthang ding hi; Yahweh sungah note in nuamsa-in Israyl’ Siangtho Pa sungah na minthang ding uh hi.
Mizawngte leh mi cimawhte in tui a zon ciangin, bangmah om loin dangtakin a leii uh a keu ciangin Keimah Yahweh in amaute ka za ding hi; Keimah Israyl’ Pa in amaute ka nusia kei ding hi.
Mun sangnate ah guntuite ka hong ding a, kuam laizanga tuikhukte ka honsak ding hi; Keimah in sehnel-gam bualtui ka suaksak ding a, keugaw gam ciktui ka suaksak ding hi.
Sehnel-gam ah tamtak, singkha, mui leh olive kungte ka posak ding a, gamtulte ah tak, hiangpa leh taksan ka posak khawm ding hi;
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh’ khut in hih thu a sepna leh Israyl’ Siangtho pa in a piansak khitna thu amaute in mu-in thei-in, ngaihsun-in, a theihtel khawm ding uh hi.
Na thu uh hong sung un, Yahweh in ci hi; na deihna kip uh pulaak un, Yaaqob’ Kumpipa in ci hi.

Amaute in a pasiante uh hong suahkhia-in, bang piang ding hiam cih eite hong lak uh hen. Kote in tuate ngaihsun-in, amaute’ tawpna a nunung lam ka theih nadingun a omsate, ni danga nate hong laksak un; ahih keileh a piang ding nate ko tungah hong gensak un.

Note pen pasiante na hihna uh ka theih nadingun tu khit cianga hong piang ding thute ko tungah hong lak un; kote lungkia-in ka lau nadingun phatna ahi a, siatna ahi zongin khat peuhpeuh hong bawl dih un.
En un, note bangmah na hi kei uh a, na nasepna uh zong a mawkna ahi hi! No hong teel mite kihhuai hi!

A Kidal Mun panin khat ka kipankhiasak khin a, ni suahna lam panin Ka Min a lo mite kaikhawm kawmin amah hong pai ding hi. Amah in gam ukte sum bangin sugawp ding a, beel bawlpa buan cil bangin cilgawp ding hi.

Eite in i theih nadingin a kipat cil-a kipanin kua in tangko ahi hiam? Eite in, “Amah thumaan hi,” i cih theih nadingin nidangin kua in tangko ahi hiam? Hi hi, a lakkhia kuamah om lo hi. Hi hi, a tangko kuamah om lo hi. Hi hi, na kammalte a za kuamah om lo hi.
A kipal cil-in Zion kiangah, “En in, amaute en in! Yerusalem kiangah lungdamna thu a puakte ka pia ding hi,” ka ci hi.
Keimah khuadakin, kuamah om lo hi; amaute lak ka en a, ahih hangin amaute thu ka dot ciangin kammal khat beek hong dawng thei ding thu lamlak a om kei hi.
En un, amaute khempeuh a mawknapi hi a, amau nasepnate bangmah lo ahi hi. A kisung amau pasiante’ limte huih hawmpi ahi lel hi.
En un! Ka letkip ka nasempa! A sungah ka lungdamna ka teelpa! Ama tungah Ka Kha ka koih khin a, amah in gentile mite tungah thutang puak ding hi.
Amah kikokhia loin, a aw zong sangsak lo ding a, kongzing lakah a aw zong kiza lo ding hi.
Amah in a kituancilsa pumpeng kuaitan lo ding a, a khu lai anthul sumit lo ding hi; Amah in thu man tawh thukhenna a a suahkhia ding hi.
Amah in leitung ah thukhenna a kipsak khit matengin lungsi loin, lungkia lo ding hi; tuikulh gamte in Ama Thukham ngak ding uh hi.
Vantungte bawlin a zalkhia, leitung leh a sung pana piangte a phah, a tunga om mite huu pia-in a tunga pai mite tunga kha a pia Pa Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi:
Keimah, Yahweh in thumaanna tawh nang kong sam khin a, na khut kong len ding hi; Nang kong kem ding a, mite tungah thuciamna khat leh gentile mite tungah khuavakin nang kong pia ding hi;
ahang in mittawte’ mit a honsak ding, thong sung panin thongkiate a lakhia ding leh thong sung khuamual sunga a tu mite a lakkhiat theih nading ahi hi.
Keimah Yahweh ka hi a, tua in Keima Min ahi hi; adang khatpeuh tungah ka minthanna ka pia kei ding a, Keimah hong kiphatna zong a kisui milimte tungah ka pia kei ding hi.
En un, hun beisa-a nate in hong kheng a, tu-in a thak nate kong tangko hi; tuate a hong piangkhiat ma-in, tuate thu kong gen khol hi.
No tuipi sungah a tuaksukte leh a sunga om khempeuhte, tuikulh gamte leh a sunga tengte khempeuh aw, Yahweh tungah la thak sa unla, leimong panin Amah phatna sa un.
Sehnel-gam leh a khuapite, Kedar mite tenna khuaneute in a aw uh sangkhai uh hen. Sela mite la sasak unla, mual dawn panin awngsak un!
Yahweh minthanna amaute gensak unla, tuikulhte ah amah phatna tangkosak un.
Mi thahatpa bangin Yahweh kuan ding a, gal a do mipa bangin a deihluatna sosak ding hi. Amah kiko khia ding hi; hi hi, hawk ding hi! Amah in a galte zo gawp ding hi!
Sawtveipi ka dai khikhe khin a, kei leh kei kidekin ka om hit-hiat hi. Ahih hangin tu-in numei nausuak khat bangin ka kiko ding a, thakhat thu-in susia-in ka netum ding hi.
Muan liante leh mual neute ka susia ding a, an kung khempeuh ka keusak ding hi. Gunte keugaw gam ka suaksak ding a, bualtuite ka keu tumsak ding hi.

Amau theih loh lampi ah mittawte ka paipih ding a, amau theih ngei loh sul zuihpih-in, ka kha ding hi. Amaute mai-ah khuamual khuavak ka suaksak ding a, a kawi peuhmah ka mamsak ding hi. Hih thute amaute aa dingin ka sem ding a, amaute ka taisan kei ding hi.
A kisui milimte muangin a kisung milimte tungah, ‘Ka pasiante uh na hi hi,’ a ci mite kilehkik ding uh a, amaute nakpi takin maizum ding uh hi.
Bengngongte aw, za un! Mittawte aw, na muh theih nadingun en un!
Ka nasempa lo kua mittaw ahi hiam? Ka sawl kamtaipa bangin kua bengngong ahi hiam? A hoihkim mipa bangin kua mittaw a, ahih keileh Yahweh’ nasempa bangin kua mittaw ahi hiam?
Na tampi na mu hi; ahih hangin tuate na encian kei hi. A bilte kihong napi-in amah in a za kei hi!
Ama thumaanna a khualna hangin Thukham liansakin a pahtawihuai a suahsak ding Yahweh lungkim mahmah hi.

Ahih hangin hih mite pen a kibuluh neihsa a kisutte hi uh a, amaute khempeuh a vang sunga awk, thong inn sunga kiselte ahi uh hi. Antah hi lel uh a, kuamah in hon lo hi; kuamah in, “Hong pia kik un,” a cih loh van kisutte ahi uh hi.
Note lakah kua in hih thu ngai ding na hi uh hiam? Kua in thudon-in hong tung ding hun kua in ngai ding ahi hiam?

Kua in vansuh khat-in Yaaqob pia a, a buluhte tungah Israyl pia ahi hiam? Yahweh hi lo ahi hiam? Ama tungah eite i khial hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Ama ngeinate zui lo uh a, Ama Thukham a mang kei uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Amah in a heh-so leh gal kidona tha amaute tungah sungkhia hi; tua in amaute kiimkot khempeuh meikuangsak hi; tua hi napi-in amaute in thei lo uh hi; amaute kang napi-in amaute in kin lo uh hi.

Ahih hangin tu-in Yaaqob aw, nang hong piangsakpa, Yisrayl aw, nang hong bawlpa Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi, “Lau kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh nang kong tan zo a, na min-in kong sam khin hi; nang in Keima aa na hi hi.
Nangmah in tuite na kantan ciangin nang kong ompih ding a, gunte na kan ciangin nang hong tuum lo ding hi. Meikuang lak kantanin na pai ciangin na kang kei ding a, nang hong hul kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah Yahweh note Pa, Israyl’ Siangtho Pa, note’ Honpa ka hi hi. Nangmah tatna-in Egypt ka pia a, nangma manh-in Ethiopia leh Seba ka pia hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Keima muhna ah nangmah manpha-in, na paktak-huai a, nang kong it hi; tua ahih ciangin nang aa dingin mi kong pia ding a, na nuntak theih nadingin mihingte kong pia ding hi.
Nang hong ompih ka hih manin lau kei in; nisuahna lam panin na suante kong paipih ding a, nitumna lam panin nang kong kaikhawm ding hi;
Keimah in leilu lam kiangah, “Amaute piakhia in,” ka ci ding a, tua ciangin leitaw lam kiangah, “Amaute kemcip kei in! A gamla-a om ka tapate leh lei mongte panin ka tanute hong paipih in—
Ka minthan nadingin ka piansak, ka bawlsate, Keima Min tawh a kilo a kuama-peuh hong paipih un; hi hi, amaute ka bawl khin hi,” ka ci ding hi.
Mit a nei mittawte, bil a nei bengngongte hong paipih un.

Minamte khempeuh hong kikaikhawm henla, mite kituahkhawm hen! Amaute lakah kua in hih thu tangko thei-in, a beisa hun-a nate kua nate kua in eite hong lak thei ahi hiam? Amau dikna a kilangsak dingin a teci uh hong pulakkhia uh hen, tua bang ahih keileh amaute in, “Hih thu man hi!” cih hong za-in thei uh hen.
“Note pen ka tecite na hi uh hi,” Yahweh in ci a, “Note in kei hong thei-in nong up theih nading uh leh Tuapa Keimah ka hihna na tel theih nadingun kong teelsa Ka nasemte na hi uh hi.
Kei, Keimah in Yahweh ka hi a, Kei simloh honpa dang a om kei hi.
Keimah in tangko-in, keimah in ka hon a, keimah in ka lak hi; note lakah gamdang pasian a om kei hi! Tua ahih ciangin Keimah in Yahweh ka hih lam, note pen ka tecite na hi uh hi,” Yahweh in ci hi.
Hi hi, a beisa tua ni ma-in, Keimah Tuapa ka hi a, Ka khut sung panin kuamah in a lakhia zo kuamah om lo hi! Keimah in ka sem ding a, kua in heikik thei ding ahi hiam?

Note hong Tanpa, Israyl’ Siangtho Pa, Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Note kong khualna-in Babylon ah ka sawl khin a, a mi thupite khempeuh uh thongkiate bangin ka niamkoih a, amau tembawte sunga nuam a sa Chaldea mite ka niamkhiat hi.
Kei pen Yahweh ka hi a, note Siangtho Pa, Israyl’ Piangsakpa, note Kumpi ka hi hi.
Tuipi sungah lampi a bawl, tui hatte sungah zawi a bawlpa,
kilawnkhia khawmin a tho kik nawn lo ding, amaute gam-in meivak khau sukmit a bang, sakol leengte leh sakolte, galkapte leh galhangte a paikhiatpihpa Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi:
“A beisa hunte phawk nawn kei unla, khanglui thute zong ngaihsun kei un.
En un, a thak na khat ka bawl ding hi; tu-in hong piangkhia hi. Thei lo na hi uh hiam? Gamlak ah lampi khat zong ka bawl ding a, sehnel-gam sungah gunte ka bawl ding hi.
Gamlak gamsate, ngiate leh simbute in Kei hong pahtawi ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah in gamlak ah tuite pia-in, Ka teelsa, Ka mite dawn dingin sehnel-gam ah gunte ka pia hi.
Hih mite Kei aa dingin ka bawl khin a, amaute in Keimah phatna lakkhia ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yaaqob aw, Kei nong sam kei hi; Israyl aw, Kei nong cimtak hi.

Na meihal biakna dingin tuu leh keel nong paipih kei uh a, na biakpiaknate uh tawh zong Kei nong pahtawi kei uh hi. Note aa dingin an tawh biakna vangikpi ka suaksak kei a, paknamtui tawh kong gimsak kei hi.

Sum tawh kilei kawltu namtui khatpeuh nong paipih kei a, biakpiakna limci tawh nong lungkimsak nai kei hi; ahih hangin na mawhnate tawh Kei tungah vangik nong suan a, na khialhnate tawh Kei nong gimsak khin hi.
Kei mahmah ka kikhualna-in na thupalsatnate hong phiatkhiatsakpa Keimah, Kei mahmah ka hi a, na mawhnate ka phawk nawn kei ding hi.
Kei hong phawk inla, Ka Min tawh hong sam in! Kithu khatin kikum khawm ni. Na dikna a kilat nadingin a piang ding hih thute gelh inla genkhia in.
Na pa masa uh khial a, na thu sungte un Ka thuciamna palsatin, thungetna ah Kei kiang panin kiheikhia uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Levi Siampi gui ka beisak ding a, Yaaqob samsiatna thuaksakin, Yisrayl gensiatna ka thuaksak ding hi.
Ahih hangin, ka nasempa Yaaqob aw, ka teelsa Yisrayl aw, tu-in za in.
Nangmah a hong bawl, naubu sung panin a hong piangsak, nang a hong huh ding Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Ka nasem Yaaqob, ka teelsa Yeshurun; ka it Yisrayl, aw lau kei in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh a dangtak mipa tungah tui ka sung ding a, lei keu tungah tui ka tuum sak ding hi. Na suanlekhak tungah Ka Kha ka sung ding a, na suan na khak tungah ka thupha a sung ding hi.
Amaute pen lui tui luang gei-a po gialheek kungte bangin lonona ah selkhia ding uh hi.
Khat in, “Yahweh aa ka hi hi,’ ci-in a khat in amah leh amah Yaaqob min tawh a kilo ding hi. A dang khat in, “Yahweh aa ka hi hi,” ci-in gelhin amah leh amah Yisrayl’ min kiphuah ding hi.
Israylte’ Kumpi leh Tanpa ahi Yahweh, a honpite’ Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Keimah in a masapen leh a tawmna ka hi a, Kei sim loh vangliatna bulpi khat beek a om kei hi.

Tanglai mite a seh keimah ka hih nungsangin Kei bangin kua in genkhol thei a, Kei aa dingin kua in a kituak dimdiamin hih thei ding ahi hiam? A piang thute leh a piang ding thute amaute genkholsak un.

Lau kei unla, kihta kei un. “Ka tecite na hi uh hi,” ci-in tua hun lai panin hong genin tangko khin hilo ka hi hiam? Kei simloh vangliatna bulpi koi ah om ahi hiam? A taktakin Suangpi dang khat beek om lo a, khat beek ka thei kei hi.
Milim a bawlte khempeuh bangmah hilo a, amau ki-aptuamna nate in a mawknapi ahi hi. Amau tangin teci a pang mite khua mu lo hi a, thu zong a thei kei uh hi; tua ahih ciangin a maizum ding uh hi.
Kua in ama meet nading ngaihsun loin pasian ahih keileh a kiseek milim bawl ahi hiam?
Amah leh amah dan mite in maizumna thuak ding uh a, khutsiamte pen mihing mah hi lel uh hi! Amaute khempeuh kikhawmsakin dingsak un; amaute liingin maizumna ngah khawm ding uh hi.

Sikseekpa in a na zat khat la-in, tua tawh mei-am sungah na sem a, amah in tui dawn loin a zawm ciangin a gilkialin a tha a bei hangin, amah in sekte tawh pasian lim seekin, ama khut hatna tawh a bawl hi.

Sing nasep khutsiampa in a tehna khungkhia-in, tua zui-in a ciamteh hi. Amah in singnawtna tawh nawtgil a, tehna kual khat tawh a ciamteh hi. Amah in, pasian’ inn sunga a teng dingin mihing mel hoihna tawh kizui-in mihing lim-in a bawl hi.
Amah in tamtak kungte phuk hi; tua ahih keileh gamlak singkungte laka a khuahpente ahi sesing kung ahi a, tawsaw kung ahi zongin a la hi. Amah in taksing suanin, guahtui in a khangsak hi.

Tua ciangin tua kung pen mihing aa dingin cih sing suak hi; amah in tua sing kimkhat la-in a khua a lumsak hi. Hi hi, amah in mei-in tawh-in, moh a em hi. Hi hi, amah in pasian khat bawlin, tua mai-ah a bia hi; ama bawl mihing mai mah ah amah a kun hi.
Amah in sing a lang mei-in cih a, tua tungah a an bawlin, a sa hangin, a gilvah-in a ne hi. Amah a khua zong lum-in, “Aha, ka khua lum ta, mei mu ta ing ei,” a ci hi.

Amah in a sing omlaite tawh pasian khat, ama suih milim khat a bawl hi. Tua mai-ah kunin a bia hi. Amah in sing pawl khat a ngah nadingin thungen a, “Hong hon in, bang hang hiam cihleh nang pen ka pasian na hi hi!” a ci hi.

Hih banga a gamta mite in bangmah thei lo a, bangmah a theitel kei uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in a muh loh nadingin a mite uh leh amaute in a theihtel theih loh nadingin a lungsimte uh a khakcipsak hi.

Khatbeek in a lungsim ah ngaihsun lo uh a, khatbeek in, “A kimkhat meikhuk ah ka cih khin a, a am tungah moh ka em khin a, sa hangin, ka ne khin hi. Tua ahih ciangin a om lai teng a kihhuai khat, pasian khatin bawl buang ding ka hi hiam? Sing bek khat mai-ah kun buang ding ka hi hiam?” cih theih nading thu theihna ahi a, theihtelna ahi zongin a nei kei hi.

Amah vut tawh kivak a, khemna lungsim in amah lam pialpih khin hi; tua ahih ciangin amah leh amah kihonkhia thei lo a, “Hih in ka taklam khut sunga om thu zuaupi hi lo ahi hiam?” zong a ci thei kei hi.
Yaaqob leh Yisrayl aw, keima nasem na hih uh ciangin hih nate ciamteh in. Yisrayl aw, Kei aa dingin nasem khatin nang kong bawl a, kong mangngilh kei ding hi.
Na thupalsatnate meiipi bangin, na mawhnate meiilum bangin ka phiatkhia khin zo hi. Nang hong tankhin ka hih ciangin Kei kiangah hong ciahkik in.

Vantungte aw, Yahweh in tua thu sem khin ahih manin la sa un! No leitung a ngiamna lamte aw, awng un! No muan liante, tulak leh a sunga singkung khempeuh aw, la sa khia zuahzuah un. Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in Yaaqob tan khin a, Yisrayl sungah Amah mah kiminthangsak khin hi!
Naubu sung panin nang hong bawl, note’ Tanpa Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi, “Keimah in na khempeuh bawlin, Keimah tawh leitung a zalkhia Ka nasemte tawh vantungte a zalkhiapa Keimah Yahweh ka hi hi.
Kamsang zuaute’ limte a tangtungsak lo, aisante’ a haibawl, mipilte lehheiin amau theihna a khiatna neilopi a suaksakpa Keimah ka hi hi.
A nasempa’ kammalte a semkhia, Yerusalem’ thu genin, ‘Ama kiangah kiteng ding,’ Yahdah khuapite’ thu genin, “Amaute kilam ding hi,’ a cipa keimah ka hi hi; a khua kisiate a ngei ka bangsak ding hi;
tuithukte tungah, “Keu in, na luite ka kangsak ding hi,” a cipa,
Ka tuucing pa, Ka ngimna khempeuh a semkhia ding, Yerusalem tungah, ‘Na kilamkik ding hi,’ biakinn tungah, ‘Na bulpi kiphut ding hi,’ a ci dingpa, thutang mi aa dingin thu a genpa ka hi hi.

Kulh kongpite a kikhak loh nadingin ama mai-ah kongkhakte a honsak ding, kumpite’ vangliatnate a lakkhiatsak ding, ama mai-ah minamte a zawhsak dingin a taklam khut a len, a sathau nilhpa Cyrus tungah Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi:
Nangma mai-ah ka pai ding a, a kipahtawi mite keimah in a lampi uh ka tangsak ding hi; sumngo kongpite ka sutan ding a, a kalhna sikzawlte ka attan ding hi.
Na min tawh nang a hong sampa pen Keimah Yahweh, Yisrayl’ Pa ka hihna na theih nadingin mialna van manphate leh mun sim tham-a huahnate nang tungah kong pia ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yaaqob ka nasempa hang leh Ka teelsa Yisrayl hangin na minin nang kong sam a, Kei ka hih lam nong phawkkhak loh uh hangin min kong phuah hi.
Keimah Yahweh ka hi a, kuamah dang om lo hi. Pasian om lo hi. Kei ka hih lam nong phawkkhak loh hangin hih theihna tawh nang kong thakhuahsak ding hi.
Tua hileh, amaute in nisuahna panin a tumna mun dongah Kei losiah kuamah a om loh lam a thei ding uh hi. Keimah Yahweh ka hi a, kuamah dang om lo hi!
Keimah in khuavak a bawl a, khuamial ka piangsak hi; kilemna ka bawl a, suksiatna ka bawlsak hi; Keimah Yahweh in hih nate khempeuh ka hih hi.
No vantungte aw, tunglam panin taksuk un; vanpite in thumaanna buasuk un. Leitung kikhah hen; hotkhiatna pokhia henla, thumaanna tawh khangkhia khawm hen; Keimah Yahweh in ka piangsak hi.

Amah a Bawlpa tawh a kitawng pa in gimna ngah hen! Leibeel them in leitung-a leitunga leibeel them kitotpih hi. Tungman in amah a seekpa kiangah, “Bang bawl na hiam?” ahih keileh na nasep in, “Amah in khut nei kei” hong ci thei ding ahi hiam?
A pa tungah, ‘A bangci ta nei na hi hiam?’ ahih keileh a nu kiangah, ‘A bangci ta suakkhia na hi hiam?’ a ci pa in gimna ngah tahen.
Yisrayl’ Siangthopa, Yisrayl a Bawlpa Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: ‘A piang ding thute hong dong in. Ka tate thu ahi a, ka thupiaksa ka khut-a ka nasep ahi zongin hong dong in.
Keimah in leitung ka bawl khin a, a tungah mihing ka piangsak khin hi. Ka khutin vantungte ka zalkhia a, vantung na honpite khempeuh thu ka pia hi.

Thumaanna tawh amah ka phongto khin a, keimah in ama lampite khempeuh ka lak ding hi. Amah in nasep thaman ahi a, letsong ahi zongin ngaihsun loin Keima khuapi lamkik ding a, sal-a om ka mite khahkhia ding hi,’ mi honpite Yahweh in ci hi.

Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Egypt gama piangte leh Ehiopia sumbuk vante leh, mi tunsang Sabean mite nang kiangah hong pai ding uh a, tuate nangma aa ahi ding hi. Amaute in nang hong zui ding uh hi; kol kibulhin hong pai-in nangma kiangah hong kun ding uh a, tua ciangin amaute in nangma kiangah, “Nangma sungah Yahweh hong om takpi a, kuamah dang om peuhmah loin, adang vangliatna bul zong om lo hi!” ci-in thuumna hong bawl ding uh hi.
A taktakin, Israyl’ Pa, honpa aw, nang leh nanga a kibu Pa na hi hi.
Amaute khempeuh maizum-in, zahla ding uh hi. Pasian (elohim) a bawlte cih nading thei loin om ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin Israyl pen Yahweh in tawntung hotkhiatna tawh hu ding hi; nang pen tawp hun nei lo leitung ah na maizum kei ding a, na zahla kei ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh vantungte a piangsak, Pa khat ahi, leitung piangsakin a bawl, tua leitung a kipsak, a mawkna a suaksak lo, a kiteng thei dingin a bawlpa Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi, “Keimah Yahweh ka hi a, adang vangliatna bulpi khat beek a om kei hi!

Keimah in leitung khuamialna mun ah a simthamin ka gen kei a, Yaaqob’ suan tungah, “A mawknapi-in Kei hong zong in,” ka ci kei hi. Keimah, Yahweh in thumaan takin ka gen hi! Keimah in siangtakin a man thute ka gen hi.
Minam sung panin a suakta lai note aw, kikaikhawm unla hong pai un; hong nai un. Amau suihtawm sing milimte phutin, a hu thei lo pasian (el) tungah thu a ngen amaute in thu theihna nei lo uh hi.

Na thu uh sung unla, a manna hong lakkhia un; hi hi, amaute kikumkhawmsak un. Sawt pak lai-in kua in hih thu gen ahi hiam? Tanglai-in kua in tua thu genkhol ahi hiam? Keimah, Yahweh hi lo ka hi hiam? Kei lobuang vangliatna bulpi khat beek a om kei a, Kei simloh a thutang Pa leh Honpa a om kei hi.
Lei mongte khempeuh aw, Kei hong en unla, suakta un; bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah Yahweh ka hi a, kei simloh vangliatna bulpi a om kei hi.
Keimahmah ka kiciam khin a, thutang takin Ka kam panin kammal paikhia a, a kikhelkik nawn lo ding thu in: Keima mai-ah khuk khempeuh khukdin-in, leii khempeuh in,
“Yahweh sungah thumaanna leh thahatna om taktak hi!” ci-in kiciam ding uh hi. Ama kiangah mite pai ding a, Ama tunga a heh khempeuh a maizum ding uh hi.
Yahweh sungah Israyl suan khempeuh thutang ding a, minthang ding hi.
Baal;Topa, kunsukin, Nebo a kulsuk hi; amau pasiante (elohim) pen sapite tung leh bawngte tungah kipua hi. Na vanpuakte uh pen a gik mahmah van hi a, a gimte aa dingin vangik ahi hi.
Amaute kulsukin, kunsuk khawm uh hi; amau leh amau kivanzangsak thei loin, galmat a suak dingin a paikhia uh hi.
Gil sung panin hong kemin, naubu panin kong lakkhiat, Yaaqob innkuan leh Israyl innkuan a omlaisun khempeuh aw, ka thu hong ngai un;
na tek dong nangawn-un keimah in Amah ka hi a, na sam uh a kan dong nangawn-in note kong kem ding hi. Keimah in ka bawl khin a, ka don ding hi; keimah in hong tawi-in kong honkhia ding hi.
Note in Kei tawh a kibang kua hisakin, Kei tawh kua kikimsak ding na hi uh hiam? Ahih keileh ka kibatpih dingin kua tawh hong tehkak ding na hi uh hiam?
Amaute in ip sung panin khamte uangzat-in, tawitehna tawh ngun teh uh hi; amaute in kham seekpa cial a, amah in tua nate pen pasian-in a bawl hi; tua ciangin amaute kunin a bia uh hi.

Amaute in tua pasian pen a liangko tung uh ah ngato-in pua uh a, ama om nading mun-ah koih-in, a om niloh hi; a omna panin tua pen kin lo ding hi; hi hi; mi khatpeuh tua tungah kiko ding a, ahih hangin dawng thei lo ding a, ama buaina panin zong a honkhia thei kei ding hi.
No thupalsatte aw, thu phawk unla, kipasalsak un, na lungsim uh ah koih un.
Hun lui lai-a nate phawk un; bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah Yahweh ka hi a, adang om lo hi; Keimah Yahweh ka hi a, Kei tawh a kibang kuamah om lo hi.
A kipat cilin a tawpna ding thu ka pulak a, a piang nai lo nate tanglai pek panin genin, “Ka thugen kip ding a, Ka geelna khempeuh ka tungsak ding hi,” ka ci hi;
A gamla gam panin Ka geelna a semkhia ding khat, nisuahna lam panin muvanlai khat ka sam hi. Keimah in ka ci khin a, ka tangtungsak ding hi; ka ciamkhin a, zong ka sem ding hi.
Thumaanna tawh a kigamla, no lungsim genhakte aw, Ka thu hong ngai un;
Ka thumaanna note kiang nai-ah kong puak hi; note kiang panin kigamla lo ding a, Ka hotkhiatna sawl a khawl kei ding hi. Ka minthanna Israyl aa dingin Zion ah hotkhiatna ka koih ding hi.

Babylon’ ta nungak aw, paisuk inla, leivui lakah tu in; Chaldea mite’ tanu aw, kumpi-tokhum lo tawh leilak ah tu in! Bang hang hiam cihleh nang pen a moi milmel, a ngeek dikdek hong kici nawn lo ding hi.
An gawina suangte la inla, an gawi in; na kikhuhna la khia inla, na khe guakin pai-in, na phei dong na puan kaito inla, gunte kantan in.
Guaktang na hihna kipholak ding hi; hi hi; na maizumna teng kimu ding hi. Keimah in phu ka la ding a, kuamah ka zah kei ding hi.
Eite hong Tanpa—mi honpite’ Yahweh cih min nei, Israyl’ Siangtho Pa ahi hi.
Chaldea’ tanu aw, gamdai takin tu inla, khuamialna sungah pai in; bang hang hiam cihleh nang pen Kumpigamte’ Tonu, hong kici nawn lo ding hi.
Ka mite tungah ka heh hi; keima luah gamh ka ninsak khin a, nangma khut sungah amaute kong pia hi. Nangmah in amaute na hehpih kei a, a khanghamte tungah na hakkol gik mahmah na suan hi.
Tua ciangin nangmah in, “Kei pen to numei ka hi tawntung ding hi,” na ci hi; tua ahih ciangin nangmah in hih thute na lungsim ah koih loin, a thu mongte zong na phawk kei hi.

Tua ahih ciangin a nuam bek a ut, kidop nei loin a om, na lungsim sungah, ‘Kei hing, kei simloh midang om kei; meigong khat bangin ka tu kei ding a, ta-khuai cih bang ka sin kei ding,’ a ci nangmah in, tu-in hih thu za in.

Ahih hangin hih thu nihte tomno sung ni khat thu-in nang tungah hong tung ding hi: ta-khuai-na leh meigongna. Na aisiamna honpite hang leh na mibum siamna a tampite hangin tuate nang tungah kicing takin hong tung ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh nangmah in na gitlohna suangin, “Kuamah in hong mu lo hi,” na ci hi. Na pilna leh na thutheihna in nangmah lam hong pialsak a, nangmah in na lungsim sungah, “Kei hing, kei simloh kuamah dang om kei,” na ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin nang tungah siatna hong tung ding a, koi pan hong kipan hiam cih na thei kei ding hi. Nang tungah buaina hong tung ding a, tua buaina na hamkhia thei kei ding hi. Na muh kholh loh dong tuahna thakhat thu-in nang tungah hong tung ding hi.
Tu-in na neu lai-a kipanin na sep ahi na mibum siamnate leh na aisiamna honpite tawh kiptakin ding in. Tua pen na gualzawhna hi kha thei ding a, na lausak kha thei ding hi.
Nang hong kikuppihna honpite hangin na gim hi. Tu-in aksi zia theite, aksi et siamte leh kha simin thu magente ding uh henla, nang tunga hong tung ding hih thute panin nang hong hon uh hen.

En in, amaute buhtu bang ding uh a, mei in amaute kang ding hi. Meikuang’ vangliatna panin amau leh amau a kihonkhia thei kei ding uh hi; khua lum nading meihol om nawn lo ding a, awi ding meikuang zong a om nawn kei ding hi.

Na neu lai-a kipan nang tawh na sem khawmin na vanzuakpihte in nang tungah tua zah ciang bek hong hi thei ding uh hi; amaute pen amau tupna ciatah zauvak ding uh a, kuamah in nang hong hon lo ding uh hi.
Israyl’ min tawh a kilo, Yahdah tuite pana a khangkhia, Yahweh’ min tawh a kiciam, Israyl’ Pa sam napi thu man leh thutak tawh a hilo Yaaqob’ innkuan aw, hih thu za in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute pen khuapi siangtho min tawh kiloin, Israyl’ Pa tungah kinga uh hi; vanglianpen Yahweh in ama Min ahi hi.
A masa nate sawt pekin kong gen khin a, Ka kam panin tuate gingkhia-in, ka kitheithangsak hi. Thakhat thu-in ka sem a, a piang hi.
Note pen paupengin, na ngawng uh sik thagui bang hi-in, na taltang uh sumngo banga sak ahihna thei khin ka hih manin,

hun sawt pek lai nangawnin note tungah hih thute kong genkhia a, a tangtun ma-in note tungah tuate kong lak hi; tua hileh note in, “Ka Pasian (El) in tuate sem a, ahih keileh a kisui ka milim ahih keileh a kisung milim in tuate thupia hi,” na ci thei kei ding uh hi.
Note in hih thu khempeuh na zakhin ta uh a, na mu khinta uh hi; genkhia lo ding na hi uh hiam? Tu-a kipanin a thak nate, a kisel thute leh na theih ngei lohte kong lak khin ta hi.
Tu-in tuate kipiangsak a, sawt pek lai-in a piang kei hi. Note in, “En un, tuate ka theihsa hi!” na cih theih loh nadingun hih ni masa tuate’ thu na za nai kei uh hi.

Na za kei takpi uh a, na thei kei takpi uh hi; sawtpek lai-a kipanin na bil a kihong kei takpi hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh muan theih ding na hih lohna uh leh naubu ah na pian panin thupalsat hong kicih ding lamtak ka thei hi.
Ka Min ka khualna-in, ka hehna diah-in, Kei hong kipahtawina ka khualna-in, note kong suksiat khak loh nadingin note tungah ka ki-ip hi.
En un, ngun siansak na bang zo kei uh zongun note kong siangsak hi; gimna meilipi sungah note kong ze-et hi.
Keimah ka kikhualna-in, keimah ka kingaihsutna-in hih bangin ka hih hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Ka Min tungah bang tanvei daina tung ding ahi hiam? Mi dang tungah Ka minthanna ka pia kei ding hi.
Keima kong sap Yaaqob leh Yisrayl aw, Ka thu hong ngai un;Tuapa keimah ka hi a, a masa ka hi a, a tawpna zong ka hi hi.
Ka khut in leitung bulpi phut a, Ka taklam khut in vantungte a zalkhia hi. Keimah in amaute ka sap khop ciangin, amaute in nasem khawm hi.

Note khempeuh, kikaikhawm unla, za un! Amaute lakah kua in hih thute genkhol ahi hiam? Yahweh in amah it hi; Amah in Babylon tungah a lungkim bangin hih ding hi; Chaldea mite tungah a khut nga ding hi.
Keimah mahmah in ka gen khin hi; hi hi, amah ka sam khin hi. Amah ka paipih a, amah a daupai ding hi.
Kei kiangah hong nai unla, hih thu za un. A kipat cil-a kipanin a simthamin thu ka gen kei a, tua thu hong pian-a kipanin tua lai-ah ka om hi. Tu-in Pa Yahweh in Ama Kha tawh kei hong sawl hi.
Israyl’ Siangtho Pa, note Tanpa Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Na gawlzawh nadingun hong hilh, na zuih dinga kilawm lampi ah hong paipih Keimah Yahweh note Pa ka hi hi.
Ka Thukhamte a ngai hi hoh le uh teh maw! Tua ciangin na nopsakna gunpi bang ding a, na thumaanna tuipi tuihualte tahw kibang ding hi.

Na suan na khak sehnel bangin tam khin ding a, na sung pana piang na tu na tate zong sehnel mal bangin tam khin ding hi; tua ciangin amau min kiphiat loin, Keima mai panin zong kisusia lo lai ding hi.
Babylon panin paikhia un! Chaldea mite kiang panin taikhia un! Lungdamna aw tawh hih thu tangko un; lei mong dong nangawn ah hih thu tangko un. “Yahweh in a nasempa Yaaqob tankhin hi,” ci un.
Amah in sehnel gam kantanin amuate a paipih ciangin amaute a dangtak lo uh hi; Amah in amau aa dingin suangpi panin tuite luangkhia sak hi; Amah in suangpi khangkham sak a, tuite luang buahbuah hi.
“Ahih hangin migilote aa dingin lungnopa om lo hi,” Yahweh in ci hi.
No tuikhulh gamte aw ka thu hong ngai un! A gamla pana no minamte aw, ngai un! Yahweh in naubu panin kei hong sam khin a, ka nu sulsung ah ka oma patin Amah in keima min a lawhsa ahi hi.
Amah in ka kam namsau hiam bangsak a, Ama khut liim sungah kei hong sel-in, thaltang hiam nawtgil bangin kei hong bawl hi; Amah in a thallawng sungah kei hong koih hi.
Tua ciangin Amah in keima kiangah, “Nang pen Ka nasempa Yisrayl na hi a, nang tungtawnin Kei hong kipahtawi ding hi,” hong ci hi.

Tua ciangin keimah in, “Ka nasep a mawknapi hi a, bangmah lopi aa dingin ka tha ka zang khin a, bangmah ka lawhtak kei hi. Ahi zongin ka vaihawmna Yahweh tawh om takpi a, ka nasepna ka Pa tawh om hi,” ka ci hi.

Yahweh’ mit ah hong kipahtawi-in ka Pa in ka thahatna hi a, Israyl’ suanlekhakkte kikaikhawm nai no ahih manin Ama kiangah Yaaqob’ mite a puakkik ding Ama nasem ahi dingin naubu panin kei a hong bawl Yahweh in tu-in gen hi.

Amah in, “Yaaqob minamte a lamto ding leh ka kepsa Israyl a ngei a bangsak kik dingin Ka nasem na hihna a kicing nai lo ahi hi; Ka hotkhiatna lei mong dong a phak theih nadingin Keimah in Gentile mite tungah khuavak dingin nang kong pia lai ding hi,” hong ci hi.

Israyl a Tanpa leh amau Siangtho Pa in sim mawhna a thuak, minamte in a muhdah, gam ukte’ nasempa tungah, “Nangmah hong teel, Israyl’ Siangtho Pa, a citak Yahweh hangin kumpite in mu-in dingto ding uh a, uliante kunsuk ding uh hi,” hong ci hi.

Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: a lungkimhuai hun ah note kong za a, hotkhiatna ni-in note kong panpih hi; leitung a ngei a bangsakkik ding, a kinusia tang gamh ah note kong tensak nadingin note kong kem ding a, mite aa ding thuciam khat bang kong suaksak ding hi.

Tua hileh note in thongkiate tungah, “Hong pai khia un,” na ci thei ding uh a, khuamial sunga omte tungah, “Hong kilakkhia un!” na ci thei ding uh hi. Amaute in lam tawntung ah an ngah ding uh a, a sangna munte khempeuh ah a gamta ding uh hi.

Amaute gilkial loin dangtak lo ding uh hi. Khualum in ahi a, nisa in ahi zongin kap lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute tungah hehpihna a nei Pa in amaute makaih ding a, ciktui kiang nangawn ah amaute paipih ding hi.
Keimah in Ka mual liante khempeuh lampi-in ka bawl ding a, Ka lam lianpite kisangsak ding hi.
Amaute en un! Gamlapi pan, nitumna lam pan, gam pan hawlkhiat a ngahte a kipuak kikna gam panin amaute hong pai ding uh hi.
Vantungte aw, la sa un! Leitung aw, nuam in! Mual liante aw, la sa-in awngkhia un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in a mite hehnem khin a, gimna thuak mite hehpih ding hi.
Ahih hangin Zion in, “Yahweh in kei hong nusia khin a, ka Pa in kei hong mangngilh khin hi,” a ci hi.

Nupi khat in a khoisa naungek mangngilh thei ding ahi hiam? Ama naubu pana a tapa tungah hehpih lo ding ahi hiam? Hi hi, amaute in mangngilh kha thei ding a, ahih hangin Keimah in nang kong mangngilh kei ding hi.
En in, ka khut peekte sungah nang kiong gelh khin zo a, na kulhte Keima mai-ah om gige hi.
Na tate kintat ding uh a, nang hong susiate leh nangmah a mawkna hong suaksak mite nang kiang panin paikhia ding uh hi.

Na mitte khangto inla, na kiim na pam en-in mu in; hihte khempeuh kikhawmin nang kiangah hong pai hi. Yahweh in, “Nungta taktak ahih manin, amaute khempeuh kizepna bangin na silh ding a, mothak khat bangin nangma tungah tuate hong kikoih ding hi.
A kisia, a kinusia munte leh a kisusia nangma gamte in nangma tunga a teng mite aa dingin kawcik lua zawsop lai ding a, nang hong valtum mite pen gamlapi ah om ding uh hi.
Na tate na sup khit ciangin na neih kik lai ding tate in na bil sungah, ‘Kei aa dingin mun toi lua hi; ka ten nadingin mun hong pia in,’ hong ci ding hi.

Tua ciangin nangmah in na lungsim sungah, ‘Keimah in ka tate sum khin-in, a hawmguakin ka om a, salin hong kikoihin, a vakvai ka hih nungsangin kua in kei aa dingin hihte hong hinkhiatsak ahi hiam? Kua in hihte hong khoisak ahi hiam? Kei guak hong kinusia a, ahih hangin hihte koi panin hong pai ahi hiam?’ na ci ding hi,” a ci hi.

Pa Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi, “En in, Gentile mite tungah ka khut ka lamto ding a, mite tungah ka lan ka khai ding hi. Amaute in na tapate uh a khutin hong paipih ding uh a, na tanute uh a liangko tungah hong pua ding uh hi.

Kumpite pen nang hong kem pate hi ding uh a, kumpinute pen nang hong khoi na nute hi ding hi. Amaute in a maitang uh leilak ngatin nang kiangah hong kun ding uh a, na khe-a leivuite liak ding uh hi. Tua ciangin keimah Yahweh ka hihna na thei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Kei hong ngakte a maizum kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
A thahatpa kaig panin nate kila khia zo ding ahi hiam? Ahih keileh, thukhun kip tawh a kimanpa kihonkhia zo ding ahi hiam?

Ahih hangin Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi, “A thahatpa mat salte nangawn kilakhia ding a, mi lipkhaphuaite’ galmat zong kihonkhia ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah in nang hong dem mite ka dem ding a, na tate ka honkhia ding hi.

Keimah in nang hong bawlsiate pen amau satak mah ka nesak ding a, leenggahzu lim kham bangin amau sisan mah ka khamsak ding hi. Mi khempeuh in Keimah, Yahweh, note Honpa, note Tanpa, Yaaqob’ Vanglianpa ka hihna hong thei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi, “Amah ka ciahsakna, na nu’ kimakna lai koi-ah om ahi hiam? Ka leibatnate laka koipen tungah nang hong zuak ka hi hiam? En un, nomau’ mawhna hangin note hong kizuak a, nomau’ khialhna hangin na nu uh kipaaikhia hi.

Bang hangin kong pai ciangin mi khat zong om lo ahi hiam? Kong sap ciangin hong dawng ding khat zong om lo ahi hiam? Hong hon khia zo lo ka hih theihna kiciangtan ahi hiam? Hotkhiat nading vangliatna nei lo ka hi hiam? En un, keima taina tawh tuipi ka keusak a, gunte pen sehnel gam ka suaksak hi; tui a om lohna hangin a ngasate uih a, dangtakin a si uh hi.
Vantungte khuamial ka silhsak a, amau kituam nadingin puanhampi ka bawl hi,” a ci hi.

A thanem mipa tungah a hunin Thukham ka gen theih nadingin Pa Yahweh in Kei tungah a kihilhsa leii hong pia hi. Amah in zingsang simin Kei hong phong a, thusin khat bangin ka zak theih nadingin Ka bil hong khanglosak hi.
Pa Yahweh in Ka bil hong honsak a, Keimah in mah lehdo loin, zong ka lampial kei hi.
Kei hong sat mite tungah ka nungzang ka pia a, ka biangmul panin hong kai mite tungah ka biang ka pia hi. Zahkona leh cilphihna panin Ka maitang ka sel kei hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Pa Yahweh in Kei hong huh ding hi; tua ahih ciangin cih nading thei loin ka om kei ding hi; tua ahih ciangin meisah suang bangin Ka maitang ka dawh a, kei hong maizumsak loh ding lam ka thei hi.
Kei hong dik tangsakpa ka kiangah om hi. Kei langah kua pang ding ahi hiam? Dingto khawm ni. Kua in Kei langah thu hong bawl ahi hiam? Ka kiang nai hong neh hen.
En un, Pa Yahweh in Kei hong huh ding hi. Kua in Kei hong mawhsak ding ahi hiam? En un, amaute puan bangin paat ding uh a, nget in amaute netum ding hi.
Yahweh tungah zahtakna a pia, Ama nasempa’ aw a ngai note lakah kua om ahi hiam? Khuamial kalsuanin, khuavak a nei lo kua ahi hiam? Amah in Yahweh’ Min muang henla, a Pa tungah kinga tahen!

En un, mei a tawhkuang, mei-ek tawh a ki-umcihsak tawmte khempeuh aw, nomau meikuang vak sung leh nomau tawhsa mei-ekte ah kalsuan un. Keima khut pana na ngah ding uh hi a, gimna thuakin na lumsuk ding uh hi.
Thumaanna nungzuihin, Yahweh a zongte aw, Ka thu hong ngai un; note hong ki-eukhiatna suangpi leh note hong kitawh-khiatna dum en un.
Na pa uh Abraham leh note suahkhiatna Sarah en un. Bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah in amah bek ka sam a, thupha pia-in ka pungsak hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in Zion hehnem ding hi; a kisia ama munte khempeuh puahpha ding a, Eden bangin ama gamlakte bawlin, ama sehnel-gam pen Yahweh’ huan a bangsak ding hi. Ama sungah lungdamna leh kipaakna, lungdam kohna leh la sakna awging om ding hi.
Ka mite aw, ka thu hong ngai un, Keima minamte aw, na bil hong ngat un: Keima kiang panin Thukham pusuakkhia ding a, minamte’ khuavak dingin Ka thukhenna ka kipsak ding hi.
Ka thumaanna hong nai hi; ka hotkhiatna hong paikhia ta a, Keima khut in mite thukhen ding hi. Tuikulh gamte in Keimah hong ngak ding uh a, amaute in Keima khut muang ding uh hi.

Vantungte ah na mit uh liik to unla, nuailam leitung en un; bang hang hiam cihleh meikhu bangin vantungte mangthang-in, leitung pen puan bangin lui ding a, a sunga tengte a kibangin a si ding uh hi; ahih hangin Ka hotkhiatna kip tawntung ding a, Ka thumaanna a bei ngei kei ding hi.
No thumaan a theite, na lungsim uh Keima Thukham sungah a om mite aw, Ka thu hong ngai un: mite’ gensianna lau kei unla, amau kogawpna zong kihta kei un.
Bang hang hiam cihleh puan bangin nget in amaute ne tum ding a, samul bangin lungno in amaute ne ding hi; ahih hangin Ka thumaanna kip tawntung ding a, Ka hotkhiatna a khang a khangin kip ding hi!
Khanglo in! Khanglo in! Yahweh’ khut aw, thahatna zang in! Tanglai huna bang, khanglui huna bangin khanglo in. Rahab a satzanpa, gul lianpi a liamsakpa Nang hilo na hi hiam?
Tuipi, tui thukpite a keusak, a kitankhia mite’ kantan dingin tuipi thukte lampi-in a bawlpa Nangmah hilo na hi hiam?

Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh’ tatsate hong ciahkik ding a, amau lu tungah tawntung lungdamna tawh la sa kawmin Zion ah hong tung ding hi. Amaute in lungdamna leh kipaakna ngah ding uh a, dahna leh khuisatna beimang ding hi.
Kei, Keimah ngiat pen note hong hehnempa ka hi hi. A si lel ding mihing leh lopa bangin a vul ding mihing’ tapa a kihta nang kua na hi hiam?

Vantungte zalkhia-in, leitung bulpi a phut nang hong bawlpa Yahweh a mangngilh nang kua na hi hiam? Hong susia dingin a kithawi bang kekin, note a hong nengniamte’ hehna hangin ni simin na lau ngitnget uh hi. Hong nengniamte’ hehna koi-ah om lel ahi hiam?
Thong sunga kikhum mite kikhah baih ding hi; amaute dum sungah si loin, an a tasam kei ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin tuipi khenkhamin, a tuihualte a hawksak keimah Yahweh ka hi hi; Vanglianpen Yahweh in Ama Min ahi hi.
Keimah in na kam ah Ka kammalte ka koih khin a, ka khut liim tawh kong tuam zo hi. Keimah in vantungte ka suan a, leitung bulpite nga-in Zion kiangah, ‘Ka mite na hi uh hi!’ ka ci hi.
Yahweh khut ah ama hehna hai a kham Yerusalem aw, khanglo in! khanglo inla, dingto in; nangmah in liingawpna hai panin na dawn kang a, a datte zong na suukkhia khin hi.
Ama sung pana piang tapa khempeuh lakah amah a lamlak ding kuamah om lo a, a khankhiatsak tapa khempeuh lakah a khutin a len ding zong a om kei hi.
Hih thu nihte nang tungah hong tungzo hi; kua in nang hong dahpih ding ahi hiam?—maimanna leh suksiatna, kialpi leh namsau—kua hangin nang hong hehnem ding ka hi hiam?
Na tapate bah khin uh a, ngenthang sunga sanang awk bangin lamlian bul ah lum uh hi; Yahweh’ hehna leh na Pa taina tawh amaute kidim uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin gimna a thuak, leenggahzu ne lopi-in zukham nangmah in tu-in hih thu za in:
Ama mite thu ah a hupa Yahweh na Pa, nangma Pa in hih bangin ci hi, “En in, Nangma khut panin liingawpna hai, Ka hehna hai sunga a datte ka lakhia khin hi; na dawnkik ngeinawn kei ding hi.

Ahih zongin Keimah in tua pen nang hong simmawhte’ khut sungah ka koih ding hi. Amaute in note tungah, ‘Na tungah ka pai theih nadingn na kunsuk n’ hong ci uh a, nangmah in leilak bangin, tot theih nading lampi khat bangin na nungzang na dawhkhin hi,” a ci hi.
Zion aw, khanglo in! khanglo in! Kithakhauhsak in! Khuapi siangtho Yerusalem aw, na puan hoihte silh in! Tuhun-a kipanin vun-at loh mite leh a sianglo mite lut ngawn lo ding uh hi.
Yerusalem aw, na tung panin leivui singkhia-in, tho inla, tu in; saltang Zion’ tanu aw, na ngawng-a kolte panin kisuaktasak in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Man nei loin note hong kizuak hi; tua ahih ciangin sum lo tawh note hong kitan ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Pa Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Ka mite a masa-in Egypt gam ah pemta dingin paisuk a, thu om lopi-in Assyria mite in nengniam uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin tu-in hih tengah bang nei ka hi hiam? A mawknapi-in Ka mite kipaikhiatpih hi, Yahweh in ci hi; amaute tunga a uk mite in amaute tausak uh a, ni simin Ka Min gensia den uh hi, Yahweh in ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Ka mite in Ka Min thei ding uh a, tua ni ciangin thu a genpa Keimah ka hihna amaute in thei ding uh hi. En un, tua in kei ka hi hi!

Lungdamna thu hong puak, kilemna a genkhia, thumaan thutak lungdamna thu hong puak, hotkhiatna genkhia-in Zion tungah, “Na Pa in uk hi!” a ci mipa’ khe mual liante tungah bangzah takin etlawm ahi hiam!
Na galvilte in a aw uh sangsak ding uh a, amau awging tawh la sa khawm ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in Zion a tonpihkik ciangin amaute in mittang kituahin a mu ding uh hi.
A kisia Yerusalem munte aw, la sa-in kikokhawm un; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in a mite hehnem khin a, Yerusalem a tankhin hi.
Yahweh in minam khempeuh muhna ah ama khut siangtho kilangkhiasak khin a, leitung mong khempeuh in i Pa’ hotkhiatna mu ding uh hi.
Kihem un! Kihem un! Tua lai panin paikhia un! A siang lo nate lawng kei un! Ama kiang panin paikhia un! Yahweh’ beel a puate aw, siang un!
Bang hang hiam cihleh note kinawhgawp-in na paikhia kei ding uh a, lauthawngsa-in na pai kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh note mai-ah Yahweh pai ding a, Israyl’ Pa in note hong kaikhawm ding hi.
En un, Ka nasempa in pilvang takin sem ding hi. Amah kitawisang-in kilaamto ding a, sang mahmah ding hi.
Mi tampi in nang hong dipkuat mah bangin mi zong sun nawn loin a mel kisia gawp a, ama pumpi in mihing zong sun nawn lo hi.

Tua ahih ciangin minam tampi in amah dipkuat ding a, ama hangin kumpite in a kam uh cip ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amau tungah a kigen ngei lo thute mu ding uh a, amaute in a zak ngei loh thute a tel ding uh hi.
I thupuak kua in um ahi hiam? Kua tungah Yahweh’ khut kilang ahi hiam?

Bang hang hiam cihleh amah pen kungno khat leh leikeu sung pana singzung khat bangin Ama mai-ah khangto hi. Amah in lim leh deihhuaina mel nei lo hi; eite in Amah i muh ciangin amah i iplah nadingin hoihna om lo hi.
Mite in amah amah simmawhin nial uh a, gimna thuak mipa leh haksatna a theipa ahi hi. Ama kiang panin i maitang a seel bangphial i hi a, Amah kisimmawhin, eite in amah i thupisim kei hi.
A taktakin amah in eite natna thuakin, i dahnate puakhia hi; tua hi napi-in Yahweh in amah satin gimsak hi, ci-in i ngaihsun hi.
Ahih hangin eite thupalsatna hangin amah liam a, eite tatsiatna hangin amah kisatnim hi; eite nopsak nadingin dantatna ama tungah tung a, amah a kisatna hangin eite i dam hi.
Eite khempeuh tuu bangin lam i pial khin a, a kuamapeuh eima utna ciat ah i pai hi; Yahweh in eite khempeuh’ tatsiatna ama tungah suan khin hi.

Amah kibawlsia-in, gimna kithuaksak hangin amah kam khat beek pau lo hi; sagote kiangah a kipaipih tuuno khat bangin amah kipaipih a, a mul mette mai-ah a ham lo tuu khat bangin amah a kam a ka kei hi.

Thong sung pan leh thukhenna panin amah kipaikhiatpih a, kuain ama khanggui genkhia ding ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cihleh a nungtate’ gam sung panin amah kikhenkhia a, Ka mite’ thupalsatnate hangin amah kisat hi.
Amah ngongtat loin a kam sungah zuau thu khat beek omlo napi-in migilote tawh kivui khawmin, mihaute tawh a si khawm hi.

Tua hi napi-in ama kisatnimna in Yahweh lungkimsak hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in natna tampi thuak hi. Tu-in amah in mawhna hanga biakna paipihkhin hi. Amah in a suan mu-in a khan sau ding a, Yahweh’ lungkimna ama khut sungah pung ding hi.
Amah in a thuakna thaman mu ding a, a lungkim ding hi. Ama theihna tawh a thumaan Ka Nasempa in mi tampi tak a dik suaksak ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in amau mawhnate pua ding hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Keimah in amah pen miliante tawh sehtanh khat ka hawmsak ding a, amah in mi hattte tawh nate hawm ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh sihna dongin a nuntakna piakhia-in thupalsatte tawh a kisim khawm hi; amah in mi tampite’ mawhna pua a, thupalsatte aa dingin thuumna a bawlsak hi.
Ta a suak lo a ciing mi aw, la sa in! Nausuak natna a thuak ngei lo mi aw, la sakhia in! Bang hang hiam cihleh a kitenpih numei’ tate sangin a kinusia numei’ tate a tamzaw hi, Yahweh in ci hi.
Na puanbuk mun khan inla, na tenna puanbukte zalkhiasak in; cilbawl loin, na khaute sausak inla, na khetphimtee kipsak in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh taklam leh veilam ah na kizeel ding a, na suan na khakte in Gentile-te luah ding a, a kinusia khuapite ah a kitengkiksak ding uh hi.

Nang hong kimaizumsak lo ding ahih manin lau kei in; cih nading thei loin om kei in, maizumin hong kikoih lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh na khangno lai-a na maizumna na mangngilh ding a, na meigonna hanga hong kikonate na phawkkha nawn kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh nang hong Bawlpa pen na Pasal hi a, a honpite’ Yahweh pen ama Min ahi hi; nang hong Tanpa pen Israyl’ Siangtho Pa ahi hi; Amah pen leitung buppi i Pa kici ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in a kinusia nupi, a dah ngeungau khat leh, khangno lai-a a kima zi khat bangin Yahweh in nang hong sam khin hi, Yahweh in ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh tomno sungin nang kong nusia pak a, ahih hangin hehpihna lianpi tawh nang kong khawm ding hi.
Ka hehpakna hangin tomno sung nang kiang panin ka mai ka sel hi; ahih hangin tawntung migitna tawh nang kong hehpih ding hi, nang hong Tanpa Yahweh in ci hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh hih pen Kei aa dingin Noah’ tuite tawh kibang hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Noah’ tuite in leitung tum nawn lo ding hi, ci-in ka kiciam mah bangin nang tungah kei hong heh nawn loin, zong kong tai nawn kei ding hi, ci-in ka kiciam hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh mual liante kihemin, mual neute a kikhin ding hi; ahih hangin nang kiang panin ka migitna taikhia lo ding a, Keima kilemna thuciamna zong kihemkhia lo ding hi, nang hong hehpih Yahweh in ci hi.
Gimna a thuak, huihpi’ nawkgawp, hehnepna a ngah lo khuapi aw, en in, na suangte suang manpha eng tawh ka ciang ding a, na bulpite saphhire suang manpha tawh ka hih ding hi.
Na tawlette suang manpha san tawh, na kongpite crystal suang tawh, na kulhpite suang manpha hoihte tawh ka bawl ding hi.
Na tate khempeuh Yahweh in hilh ding a, na tete lungnopna lian mahmah ding hi.
Thumaan takin nang hong kikipsak ding a, netniamna tawh na kigamla ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh lauthawngna hangin na lau kei ding hi; ahang in tua in na kiang nai hong neh lo ding hi.
En in, amaute kituah khawm taktak ding uh a, ahih hangin Kei kiang pan ahi kei hi. Nang hong langpanin a kituah peuhmah nangma hangin a puk ding hi.
En in, meihol a kuang sak dingin a zaap, ama nasepna vante a seek siksekpa ka piangsak khin a, a susia dingin a siagawpsakpa ka piangsak khin hi.

Nang do nadingin a kibawl galvan peuhmah kimang lo ding a, thukhenna ah nang hong langpanin a pang leii peuhmah nangmah in na nial zo ding hi. Hih in Yahweh nasemte’ gamhluah hi a, amau thumaanna pen Keima kiang pan ahi hi, Yahweh in ci hi.
Aw! A dangtak mi peuhmah aw, tuiphual ah hong pai un; sum nei lo peuhmah aw, hong pai-in, lei unla, ne un. Hi hi, hong pai un; sum kisam lo, a manh kisam loin leenggahzu leh bawngnawi lei un.

A kimuh theih lai-in Yahweh zong unla, hong nai lai-in amah sam un;

Ka kam pana a pusuak ka kammal zong tua bang ahi hi! Khiatna nei lo pi-in ka kammal hong kilehkik lo ding a, ahih hangin ka lungkim bangin tangtungsak ding a, ka sawl bangin a lawhcing sak ding hi.

Lingkung tangin takkung po ding a, thangling kung tangin muikung po ding hi; hih in Yahweh aa dingin Min leh a bei ngei lo ding tawntung lim khat hi ding hi.
Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Ka hotkhiatna hong tun ding leh Ka thumaanna hong kilaak ding naita ahih manin thutang zang unla, thu manin gamta un.
Hih bangin a gamta, hih thu a lenkip mihing’ tapa, Shabbat tangin a ninsak lo mi, siatna khatpeuh pan a khut a kem mipa thupha ngah ahi hi.
Yahweh a beel Gentile mipa in, ‘Yahweh in Ama mite kiang panin kei hong khenkhia taktak hi,’ ci sak kei unla, a kiget mipa in, ‘En un, singkung keu khat ka hi lel hi,’ cisak kei un.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in, Ka Shabbat-te zui-in Kei hong lungkimsa nate teelin, Ka thuciam a lenkip a kiget mite tungah hih bangin ci hi:
Ka inn sung, ka huang sung nangawn ah mun khat leh ka tapate ka tanute tawh a kikim Min khat amaute tungah ka pia ding a, a sia ngei nawn lo ding tawntung Min amaute tungah ka pia ding hi.
Yahweh’ na a sem ding leh Yahweh’ Min a it ding, Ama nasem a suak dingin Yahweh a beel, Shabbat-te zui-in a ninsak loh, Ka thuciamna kiptakin a len Gentile mite tungah—

Keimah in Ka mual siangtho ah amaute paipih-in, thungetna Keima Inn sungah amaute ka lungdam sak ding hi. ka biaknatau tungah amau meihal biakpiaknate leh amau biakpiaknate kisang ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Ka Inn pen mi khempeuh aa dingin thungetna Inn kici ding hi.
A kikhentang Israyl-te a kaikhawm Pa Yahweh in, “A kikaikhawmsate banah a dangte zong Kei kiangah ka kaikhawm lai ding hi,” a ci hi.
No lo sunga om ganhing khempeuh, gamlak-a om ganhing khempeuh aw, a netum dingin hong pai un.
Na galvilte mittaw-in bangmah thei lo uh a, amaute khempeuh a ham thei lo ui gina lo hi uh a, itmut ding, lup ding, kual ding nuamsa uh hi.
Hi hi, amaute pen kham hun a nei lo a huaiham ui hi uh hi. Amaute pen thutel thei lo tuucing zong ahi uh hi; amaute khempeuh amau tum ciatin gamta uh a, amau ngah nading lamlam ciat ah kihei uh hi.

Thumaan mipa si a, kuamah in thupi ngaihsut lo hi; hehpihna nei mite si uh a, a tung ding siatna panin thutak mite a kikhemkhia ahih lam kuamah in tel lo uh hi.
Nopna sungah amaute lut uh a, thutangin a kalsuan amaute si-in a lumte bangin a tawlnga uh hi.
Ahi zongin no, dawi a samte’ tapate, Yahweh kiang panin lampial khia-in Pasian (El) tawh a paktatte’ suanlekhakte aw, hiah hong pai un!
Kua ciamnuih bawl mawkmawk na hi uh hiam? Kua nehpiksan-in kua leiphen na hi hiam? Zuauphuakte suanlekhak, thupalsatte’ tate hilo na hi uh hiam?
Singhing nuai peuhpeuh ah Pasian (El) aa dingin lunggulh luatna tawh a sa pempam, kuam sung suangheng nuai tengah na tate uh a thatte hi lo na hi uh hiam?

Kuam sunga suangmaite note tanh ahi hi. Amaute pen note’ aituam ahi hi! Tuate tungah note in dawn-a biakna na sung uh a, an tawh biakna zong na pia uh hi. Keimah dai-in, hih nate koih khong ding ka hi hiam?
