Kongkhakte leh kongkhakmungte’ nung ah nangmah in phawkna milimte na tung hi; nangmah in kei hong nusia-in tuate kiangah na pai a, na lupna na zaisak hi. Nangmah in a lupna na itte tawh thukimna bawl-in, amau khut na en gige hi.
Kumpipa; Molek, kiangah sathau tawh na pai a, na paknamtuite na kinuhphapha hi; na kamtaite; milimte, gamlapi ah na puak a, ahih hangin Sheol ah nang hong kipuak ding hi.

Nang zuau-in, Kei hong phawk loin, na lungsim ah nong koih loh zah dong dingin nangmah in kua kihtakin nei-in kua zahtak na hi hiam? Keimah dai takin sauveipi ka om hit-hiat manin kei hong zahtak lo hi lel lo na hi hiam?

Nang cimawh-in na kiko ciangin na milimte in hong hon hen; ahih hangin huih in tuate khempeuh lenkhia ding a, tuate khempeuh a mawknapi suak ding hi. Ahih hangin Kei hong muang mi in leitang ngah ding a, Ka mual siangtho luah ding hi.
“Zik un, zik un, lampi bawl khol un, Ka mite’ lampi a dongkhak thei ding na khempeuh la khia un,” kici ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh a sang, a kipahtawi, tawntung sungah a teng, a Min a Siangtho pa in hih bangin ci hi: “A sangna mun leh a siangtho mun ah ka om a, a kiniamkhiat mite’ lungsim leh a kisik mite’ lungsim a thakhuahsak kik dingin kisikna leh kiniamkhiatna lungsim a neite tawh zong ka om khawm hi.
Keima bawlsa nuntakna tawh keima mai-ah mihing’ lungsim gim ding ahih manin keimah in a tawntungin ka mawhsak kei ding a, zong ka heh paisuak kei ding hi.

A nai a gamla a omte tungah ‘Kilemna! Kilemna!’ a ci ding muk pana hong luangkhia a gah ka piangsak a, amah ka damsak ding hi,” Yahweh in ci hi.
Ahih hangin migilote pen khawl hun a nei lo, buan leh ninte a lamto a kilok tuipi tawh kibang uh hi.

Na aw sit loin nakpi takin kiko inla, peengkul bangin na aw ngaihsak in; Ka mite tungah a thupalsatna uh leh Yaaqob’ innkuante tungah a mawhnate uh lak in.

Tua hinapi-in amaute in, thumaan takin a gamta, a Pa uh ngeina kipte a nusia lo minam bang kekin nisim-in kei hong zong uh a, Ka lampite a thei nuam uh hi; amaute in keima kiang panin thutang ngeina kipte hong dong uh a, Yahweh kiang nai-ah nuam a sa tawh a kibang uh hi.

Amaute in, “Kote in an tang napi-in bang hangin hong mulo na hi hiam? Komau mah ki-gawt-tawm napi-in bang hangin thei kha lo na hi hiam?” a ci uh hi. En un, note in na an tan ni-un nomau nopsakna na zong uh a, na nasemte uh na nengniam uh hi.

En un, note in kitot kilai nading leh gitlohna khuttum tawh a kitum ding bekin an na tang uh hi. Tuni-a bangin an na tang kei ding uh a, a sangna ah na aw uh hong kizak ding zong na lamen thei kei ding uh hi.

Mi khat in ama pumpi a gawt ni-in a hih ding keima teelsa antanna hih bang ahi hiam? Maugua bangin a lu kun lel ding leh puanhampi leh vut tunga lum lel ding ahi hiam? Na an tanna uh hih bang lel ahi hiam? Tua pen Yahweh san theih ni hi ci ding na hi uh hiam?
Gitlohna khaute phelin, vangik luate lakhia-in, a kinengniamte khahkhiat ding leh hakkol suktan ding keima deih an tanna hilo ahi hiam?
Na na uh a gilkialte tawh ne khawmin, mizawng kawivakte na inn ah paipih-in, tangguak-a omte na muh ciangin puansilhsakin, na mipihte uh kiang panin bu lo ding hilo na hi uh hiam?

Tua ciangin na khuavak pen zingsang bangin hong tang semsem ding a, na cidamna pen manglang takin hong hoih semsem-in, na thumaanna pen note mai-ah pai ding hi; Yahweh’ vang pen note’ kipuahphatna hi ding hi.

a genthei nuntakna a taisak dingin gilkial mite tangin nangmah kikhaam leh, a mial sungah na khuavak hong suakkhia ding a, na khuamialna pen sunkim bangin hong tang ding hi.

Na mite un tanglai-a kisia na munte uh lamkik ding a, khang tampite’ bulpite na dingto sak ding uh hi; tua ciangin note pen A Siasate Puahkikte, a sungah teen theih nadingin Lampite a Ngei a Bangsak-kikte hong kici ding hi.

“Note in Shabbat palsat loin, Keima ni siangtho ni-in no nopsak bangin om loin, Shabbat a deihhuai ni leh a pahtawi huai Yahweh’ ni siangtho ni hi na cih uh a, na gammtat ngei bangun gamtat lohna, nomau nopsak nading zontawm lohna, mawk paupau lohna tawh amah na pahtawi uh leh,
Yahweh sungah lungnopna na mu ding uh a, leitung a sangna munte ah kong tuangsak ding a, na pa uh Yaaqob’ gamh tawh hong vak ding hi,” Yahweh’ kam in ci khin hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangma mai-ah kote’ thupalsatnate tampi pha a, ka mawhnate un kote langah teci pang hi; bang hang hiam cihleh eite tungah i thupalsatnate om a, i khialhnate ahih leh i thei hi—

Meii bangin a leng, a tawlngakna mun ah vankhu bangin a leng hihte kua ahi hiam?

Ahih hangin Yahweh in note pen Siampi-in hong seh ding a, mite in i Pa nasemte hong ci ding uh hi. Note in Gentile mite’ hauhna na ne ding uh a, amau minphatna note sungah hong tung ding hi.

Keimah Yahweh ka hih leh, thutang deih-in, meihal biakna dingin meihsa suhna ka mudah hi; thu man ah a nasepna uh ka makaih ding a, amaute tawh Ka tawntung thuciamna ka kipsak ding hi.
Gentile mite lakah amau suanlekhakte kithei ding a, mite lakah amau tulehta-te kithei ding hi. Amaute a mu peuhmah in Yahweh’ thupha piak suanlekhakte ahih lam thei didng uh hi.

Yahweh sungah nakpi takin nuam ka sa ding a, ka Pa sungah ka kha kipak ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh siampipa lu-a kippah bangin zipipa in a lu a tuam bangin, suangmanpha tawh monu a kizep bangin Amah in hotkhiatna puante hong silhsak a, thumaan puanpi tawh kei hong tuam hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh leitung in mengkhiasakin, huan in khaici a posak bangin Yahweh i Pa in minam khempeuh mai-ah thumaanna leh phatna pokhiasak ding hi.

Zion kihotkhiatna thu khuavak bangin a tankhiat mateng, ama gualzawhna thu meivak kuang bangin a tankhiat matengin, Zion ka khualna-in gamdai-in ka om mawk kei ding a, Yerusalem ka khualna-in ka khawl mawk kei ding hi.
Gentile mite in na thumaanna mu ding a, kumpite khempeuh in na thupitna mu ding uh hi. Yahweh in hong phuah ding Min thak tawh nang hong kisam ding hi.
Yahweh khut sungah nang pen thupitna lukhu na hi ding a, na Pa khut sungah kumpi kilawmna lukhu na hi ding hi.

Amaute in nang pen Nusiatsa hong ci nawn loin, na leitang Gamkhing a ci nawn kei ding uh hi. Ahi zongin nang pen Hephzibah; Amah Ka lungkimna; hong kici ding a, na leitang pen Beulah; kitenpih, kici ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh nang sungah Yahweh lungkim a, na leitang pen a kitenpih zi hi ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh tangvalno khat in nungak khat a tenpih mah bangin na tapate in nang hong tenpih ding a, zipipa pen a mo nu tungah a lungdam mah bangin, nangma tungah na Pa hong lungdam ding hi.
Yerusalem aw, na kulhte tungah galvilte ka koih khin a, sun leh zanin amaute a omkhong kei ding uh hi. Hong phawk nadingin Yahweh’ Min a lo note gamdai kei un,
Amah in a kipsak mateng, Amah in leitung ah Yerusalem phatna a suaksak matengin Amah khawlsak kei un.
A taklam khut leh a thahat khut tawh Yahweh kiciamin, “Na galte an dingin na ante uh ka pia nawn kei taktak ding a, note sepsa na leenggahzu thak uh zong gamdangte in dawn nawn lo ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin an late in ne-in, Yahweh phat ding uh hi! Leenggah kaikhamte in Ka huang siangtho sungah dawn ding uh hi,” ci khin hi.
Kongpite tawnin pusuak un, pusuak un! Mite aa dingin lampi bawl khol un! Zik un, lam lianpite zik un! Mite aa dingin suangtumte lakhia unla, lan khai un!
En un, lei mong dong ah Yahweh in tangko khin a, “Zion’ tanu tungah, ‘En in, na hotkhiatna hong pai ta hi! En in, a thaman hong pua a, Ama nasepna hong masuan hi,’ gen un,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute pen Mi Siangthote, Yahweh’ Tatsate kici ding a, tua ciangin nang pen a Kizongkhia, a Kinusia lo Khuapi hong kici ding hi.

Edom gam Bozrah panin ausan tawh a kidiah puan silhin, a puansilh tawh etlawmin, a thahatna lianpi tawh hong zin kua hi hiam? Thumaan tawh thu a gen Keimah ka hi hi! A hu zo dingin a thahat Keimah ka hi hi.
Bang hangin Na puan san a, na puansilhte leenggah cilpa’ puan tawh kibang ahi hiam?

Mite lak panin kuamah in hong huh loin keimah guak in leenggah ka cil hi. Sin sona tawh amaute ka cil ding a, hehna tawh amaute ka tuancil ding hi; ka puan tungah amute’ si hong kitheh gawp ding a, ka puan khempeuh sisan hong baang ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh phulak ni ding ka lungtang ah om a, Ka tatkhiat kum ding tungkhin ta hi.

Keimah ka khuadak a, ahih hangin hong huh ding khat beek om lo hi; hong panpih ding khat beek a om lohna hangin ka lungnuam kei hi. Tua ahih ciangin keima khut mah in Kei aa ding hotkhiatna hong puak a, Keima hehna mah in Kei hong kipsak hi.
Ka sinsona tawh mite ka tuancil gawp-in, Ka hehna ka khamsak ding a, amau thahatna lei lak ka tunsuk ding hi.

Yahweh itna kip leh Yahweh phatnate, Yahweh in eite tunga hong piak khempeuh tawh kizui leh, ama hehpihna tawh kizui, ama itna a honpite tawh kizui-in amaute tunga a piak, Israyl innkuan tunga ama hoihna lianpite ka gengen ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Amah in, “Amaute pen Ka mite hi a, a zuau lo ding tate ahi uh hi,” a ci hi; tua ahih ciangin Amah pen amau Honpa ahi hi.
Amau thuakna khempeuh ah Amah in zong thuak a, Ama kiang panin vantungmi in amaute hon hi; Amah in a itna leh a hehpihna tawh amaute tankhia hi; Amah in a beisa hun khempeuh ah donin a kem hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in Ama Kha Siangtho lehdo-in a khasiasak hi; tua ahih ciangin gal leh sa bangin amaute kiang panin kiheikhia-in, Amah in amaute a lang do hi.

Tua ciangin Ama mite in a beisa hunte, Mosheh leh a mite phawkkik uh a, “Ama tuu a cingte tawh tuipi panin amaute a paikhiatpihpa koi-ah om ahi hiam? Amaute sungah a Kha Siangtho a koihpa koi-ah om ahi hiam?
Mosheh taklam khut leh a thupi Ama khut tawh amaute a makaih, amaute mai-ah tui khenkhamin, tawntung Ama minthan nadingin a bawlpa koi-ah om ahi hiam?
Amaute a kituk loh nadingin gamlak a sakol tung tuan bangin tui thukpi kantanin amaute a makaihpa koi-ah om ahi hiam?
Lonona kuam sung a zuansuk gan bangin Yahweh in amaute tawldamna a pia hi; Na Min na thansak nadingin hih bangin Na mite na makaih hi.

Vantung panin hong ensuk inla, Na sianthona leh na minthanna a tenna panin hong en in. Na deihluatna koi-ah om ahi hiam? Na thahatna koi-ah om ahi hiam? Kei tungah na lungnemna leh nong hehpihnate koi-ah om ta ahi hiam? Tuate kidokkik ta ahi hiam?

Abraham in kote hong thei loin, Israyl in kote hong phawkkhak loh hangin Nang pen kote Pa na hihna muanmawh nading om peuhmah lo hi. Yahweh aw, nang pen kote Pa leh kote Tanpa na hi hi. Nangma min in tawntung pan a omsa ahi hi.
Yahweh aw, Na lampite panin a khial dingin kote hong phalin, ka lungsim un nangmah zahtak ding haksa sa dingin phal na hi hiam? Na nasemte, Na luah minamte na khualna-in hong kihei kik in.
Nangma mi siangthote in tomno sung bek na munsiangtho luah uh a, ka galte un na mun siangtho tuancil gawp khin hi.
Kote pen nangmah in cikmah-a na uk ngei loh, Nangma Min tawh cikmah-a a kisam ngei lo, khanglui mite tawh a kibang ka suak khin uh hi.
Nangma mai-ah muan liante a liin nadingin vantungte balkekin hong kumsuk hilecin maw!
Singte a kuan ciangin mei in tui a sosak bangin, Nangma mai-ah minamte a liin nadingin na galte tungah Na Min kitheisak in!
Kote in ka upmawh loh uh a lauhuai nate semin nong paisuk lai-in, na mai-ah mual lianpite liing hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Amah a ngakte aa dingin a sem nangmah longal vangliatna khatpeuh a nei, leitung a kipat cil-a kipanin mite in thei lo uh a, bil tawh zong za ngei loin, mit tawh zong mu ngei lo uh hi.

Thumaan takin gamta-in nuam a sa, na ngeinate ah nang hong phawk mi na limbawl hi. En in, kote mawh khin ka hih manun nang na sinso a, sauvei pi mawhna sungah ka kidiah khin uh a, tua bang pi-in kote hong kihon ding ahi hiam?
Kote khempeuh a siang lo mipa tawh ka kibang khin uh a, ka thumaannate khempeuh uh puan nin tawh kibang hi; singteh bangin ka vul uh a, ka mawhnate un huih bangin kote hong mutkhia hi.

Tua ahih ciangin nangmah hong pom dingin a hanciam Na Min tawh hong sam kuamah om nawn lo hi; bang hang hiam cihleh nangmah in kote kiang panin na maitang na seel khin a, ka mawhna uh hangin kote nong beimangsak hi.
Ahih hangin tu-in Yahweh aw, kote Pa na hi hi; Kote tungman ka hi uh a, Nang pen beel seekpa na hi hi; kote khempeuh nangma khutte’ nasep ka hi uh hi.
Yahweh aw, nakpi takin sinso kei inla, ka mawhnate uh ciamteh paisuak kei in. En in, Nangma tungah kong thuumna uh hong mu in, kote khempeuh Nangma mite ka hi uh hi!
Na khuapi siangthote gamlak suak a, Zion zong gamlak suakin, Yerusalem gamkhing suak hi.
Ka pate un Nangmah hong phatna a siangtho a hoih kote’ Inn, mei tawh kihaltum a, ka neihsa hoih khempeuh uh kisia hi.
Yahweh aw, hih thu khempeuh nungah ki-ip lai ding na hi hiam? Nang dai takin om dide-in nakpi takin kote hong gimsak lai ding na hi hiam?
Kei hong kan lo mite’ zonin ka om a, Kei hong zong lo mite in kei hong mu hi. Keimah in Ka min tawh hong sam lo minam tungah, “Hiah om ing, hiah om ing,” ka ci hi.
A man lampi zui loin amau ngaihsutna bang a zui a lehtat mite,
Ka maitang ah Kei hong hehsak ngitngetin, huan sungah biakpiakna bawlin leiseek biaknatau tungah paknamtui a hal mite,
A sisate phawkna bawlna tawh om khawmin zan hun a beisak mite, voksa ne-in, amau beel sungah sa siang lo mehtui a koih mite,

‘Nang sangin siangtho zaw ka hih manin ka kiang nai-ah hong pai kei in! Nang kia ding in!’ a ci mite tungah sun tawntungin ka khut ka zakkhia khin hi. Tua bang mite pen Ka nakvang sunga meikhu hi a, sun tawntungin a kuang mei ahi uh hi.
En un, Ka mai-ah gelhsa-in a om hi: Dai takin ka om nawn kei ding a, ka thukik ding hi; amau angsung dong ah ka thuk ding hi—

Note mawhnate leh na pu na pate uh mawhnate ka thuk ding hi, amaute in mual liante tungah paknamtui halin, mualte tungah kei hong gensia uh hi, Yahweh in ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amau gamtatna sa tawh kizui-in ka thuk ding hi.

Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Leenggah bom sungah leenggah tui thak om a, mi khat in, ‘Susia kei un, a sungah a hoih om hi,’ a cih mah bangin Ka nasemte ka khual na-in amaute khempeuh ka susia khin kei ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yaaqob sung panin a suan khat piangkhia sakin, Yahdah sung panin Ka mual liante a luah ding khat ka piangkhia sak ding a, Ka teelpa in luahin, Ka nasemte tua lai-ah teng ding uh hi.
Kei hong zong Ka mite aa dingin Sharon pen tuuhon gamtatna hi ding a, Achor Kuam pen bawnghonte giahna mun hi ding hi.
Ahih hangin note pen Yahweh a taisan, Ka mual siangtho a mangngilh, Gad pasiante aa dingin sabuai lui-in, Mene pasiante aa dingin dawna biakna a piate na hi uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin namsau tawh thah dingin note kong seh ding a, hong ngawngtan dingte dawhin na vekun na kun ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kong sap lai-in nong dawng kei uh a, kong gen lai-in na ngai kei uh hi; Keima muhna ah siatna bawlin, ka lungkimna ahi lo nate na teel uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh i Pa in hih bangin ci hi: En un, Ka nasemte in ne ding a, ahih hangin note na gilkial ding uh hi. En un, ka nasemte in dawn ding a, ahih hangin note na dangtak ding uh hi. En un, Ka nasemte kipak ding uh a, ahih hangin note na maizum ding uh hi.
En un, Ka nasemte in lungsim nopna tawh la sa ding uh a, ahih hangin note lungsim natna tawh kapin, lungsim gimna tawh na thuum ding uh hi;

Ka teel mite aa dingin na pasiante uh minte thangzak bangin omlai ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh i Pa in note hong that ding a, ahih hangin amah in a tawntunga a om paisuak dingin a nasemte tungah Min khat pia ding hi;

Tua ahih ciangin mi suangin amah mah thupha a kipia mi pen Amen pasian tawh thupha kipia ding a, mi suangin a kiciam mi pen Amen pasian tawh kiciam ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute khempeuh in Yahweh mangngilh khin uh hi. A kipat cil panin galte hi ngitnget uh hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute pen Keima mit panin kisel hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh en un, a thak vantungte leh leitung khat ka piangsak hi; a beisa nate kiphawkkha nawn lo ding a, lungsim ah zong a om kei ding hi.
Ahih hangin Keima piansaksa sungah a tawntungin lungdam kipakin om un; bang hang hiam cihleh en un, nopsakna-in Yerusalem ka piangsak a, a nuamsa dingin a mite ka piangsak hi.
Yerusalem ah nuam ka sa ding a, Ka mite lakah nuam ka sa ding hi; tua khua sungah kahna aw leh kikona aw kiza nawn lo ding hi.

Tua sungah ni tawmno sung bek a nungta naungek om nawn lo ding a, ama nuntak zah ding a nungta lo putek zong om lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh naupangte kum za a cin ciangin si pan ding a, ahih hangin kum za a pha mi mawhte pen kihamsiat ding hi.
Amaute in inn lamin a sungah teng ding uh a, leengguite suanin, a gahte a ne ding uh hi.

Amau lamsa inn sungah midang teng nawn lo ding a, amau suansa midang in ne nawn lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh singkung khat a hin tan mah Ka mite nungta ding a, Ka teelsate in amau khut tawh a sepsa uh sawtpi a ne ding uh hi.
Amaute nasepna guaksuak loin khasiat nading lelin ta nei kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute leh amaute tawh a suanlekhekte pen Yahweh’ thupha piakte’ suan ahi uh hi.
Hih ci bangin hong tung ding hi: amaute hong sap ma-in ka dawn ding a, a pau laitak mahin ka zak ding hi.

Keivom leh tuuno in an ne khawm ding uh a, humpinelkai in bawngtal bangin buhkung ne ding hi; leivui pen gulpi’ an hi ding hi. Ka mual siangtho tung khempeuh ah amaute kiliam sak loin, a kisusia kei ding uh hi, Yahweh in ci hi.
Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Vantung pen ka tokhum hi a, leitung pen ka khe ngakna ahi hi. Kei aa dingin koi lai-ah inn lam ding na hi uh hiam? Ka tawlngakna mun koi lai ahi hiam?
Hihte khempeuh Keima khut in bawlin, tua ciangin a hong om pan hilo ahi hiam? Yahweh in ci hi. Ahih hangin zawngin lungsim a kitamzan, Ka Thukham a zahtakpa pen keima deih mipa ahi hi.

Biakna-in bawngtal a gopa in mihing zong that a, biakpiakna-in tuuno a piapa in ui ngawng zong tan hi; an tawh biakna a bawlpa in, vok’ sisan tawh biakna pia a, paknamtui tawh phawkna biakpiakna a piapa in milim zong thupha a pia hi—amaute in amau lampi ding teel tawm khin taktak uh a, amau nuntakna in amau kihhuaina ah nuamsa uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amau theih khilhsakna mah ka teel ding a, amau kihtakte mah amau tungah ka tungsak ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh ka sap ciangin kuamah in hong dawng lo a, ka gen ciangin amaute in ngai lo uh hi; ahih hangin amaute in Ka mittang mai-ah siatna gamta uh a, ka lungkimna ahi lo peuh teel zawsop uh hi.

Ama thu-ah lau-in a liing mite aw, Yahweh’ thu za un: note hong mudah-in, Keima Min hangin note hong hawlkhia na sanggamte un zahkona tawh genin, ‘Note nopsakna ah teci ka hih nadingun Yahweh in a minthanna lakkhia hen!’ ci uh hi. Ahih hangin amaute maizum ding uh hi.
Khuapi panin gamlumna, munsiangtho panin awging! A talte tungah a thukkik Yahweh’ awging za un!
Tuanu in nausuah natna a thuak ma-in, nau suak a, natna a thuak ma-in, amah in tapa khat nei hi.

Kua in hih bang thu za ngei ahi hiam? Kua in hih bang thu mu ngei ahi hiam? Ni khat thu-in gam khat piang thei ahi hiam? Thakhat thu-in minam khat piang thei ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cihleh Zion in nausuak gimna a thuak phetin, a tate suakkhia pah hi.
Ta suak lo ding pi-in nausuah hun tungsak ka hi hiam? Yahweh in ci hi. A suak khiasakpa keimah in naugil khakcip ding ka hi hiam? Yahweh in ci hi.
Yerusalem tawh nuamsa unla, amah tawh kipaak khawm un. Ama hangin a thuum note khempeuh aw, ama tawh nopsak khopna hangin nuam un.
Tua ciangin amau hehnepna nawizu tawh hong kivakin, na gilvah ding uh a, nawizu dawnin, ama minthanna a dimlet tawh nuamna sa ding uh hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi, “En un, gunpi bangin nopsakna leh luitui luangkhia bangin Gentile mite minthanna ama tungah ka tungsak ding hi. Tua ciangin note pen a nawizu dawnin, a ang ah hong pua ding a, a khuk tungah na diang ding uh hi.
A nu in a hehnep naupang khat bangin, note kong hehnem ding a, note in Yerusalem khua sungah hehnepna na ngah ding uh hi.
Hih thu na muh uh ciangin, na lungsim uh nuam ding a, na guhte uh lopa bangin nosuak ding hi; Yahweh’ khut in a nasemte a ompihna leh a galte tungah a hehna a lahna thu ki thei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh en un, heh mahmahna tawh ama sinsona leh meikuang tawh dan a pia dingin huipi a bang ama leengte leh meikuang tawh Yahweh hong pai ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh meikuang leh Ama namsau tawh Yahweh in mihing khempeuh tungah thukhen ding a, Yahweh thah mi tampi pha ding hi.
Huan sungah amau-le-amau kisiansuahin a kisiangsak, zusa sa leh pasiante tungah biakpiakna a kizang voksa a ne mite laka om siampipa nung a zui mite beimang khawm ding uh hi, Yahweh in ci hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh amau nasepnate leh amau ngaihsutnate ka thei a, minam khempeuh leh paunam khempeuh a khawm dingin kong pai ding hun hong tung ding hi; tua ciangin amaute hong pai-in Ka thupitna mu ding uh hi.

Amaute lakah lim khat ka koih ding a, amaute laka a suakta laite pen galsim lai minamte: Tarshish, Pul leh Lud mite tung, Tubal leh Yavan mite tung, Ka min hoihna za ngei loin Ka minthanna a mu ngei lo mite tungah ka sawl ding hi. Tua ciangin amaute in Gentile mite lakah Ka thupitna tangko ding uh hi.

Israyl mite in beel siang sungah biakna koih-in Yahweh’ Inn ah a paipih bang tektekin, amaute in Yahweh kiangah biakna a pia dingin na sanggamte khempeuh uh, sakolte leengte, taalte, laate, kalaoh-te tungah hong pua-in Ka mual siangtho Yerusalem ah hong paipih ding uh hi, Yahweh in ci hi.
Amaute lak panin siampi ding leh Levi mi ding ka tengkhia ding hi.
Ka bawl ding a thak vantungte leh leitung thak zong Ka mai-ah kipsuak ding a, tua mah bangin na suante leh na min kipsuak ding hi, Yahweh in ci hi.
Tua ciangin hih bang hong hi ding hi: Khadet khat pan khadet khat, Shabbat khat pan Shabbat khat, Keima mai-ah hong bia dingin mi khempeuh hong pai ding uh hi, Yahweh in ci hi.

Amaute pai-in, Kei hong lehdo mite luanghawm en ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amau a ne thante si lo ding a, amau a kihalna mei mit ngei lo ding hi; tua ciangin amaute pen mi khempeuh kih hi ding uh hi, a ci hi.
